jobs.title: AI/ML Data Knowledge Graph Engineer
jobs.description: Sapience AI is the collective intelligence platform for professional communities. We sit above the CRMs, AMS platforms, and knowledge bases that organizations already run, and we turn the expertise scattered across them into something every member can search, act on, and share. The intelligence a community needs is already inside it. Most organizations just cannot reach it. Knowledge lives in silos, in legacy systems, in the heads of a few experts, and in fragmented records no one can connect. We change that. Our work is grounded in four commitments: technology elevates people and never replaces them, the best expertise is already inside the community, everything is built on trust, and every deployment is purpose\-driven for the organization it serves. **Let's achieve more, together.** **Where this role sits** ======================== This role builds the structured knowledge that collective intelligence reasons over. You own the KO (knowledge object) graph: the layer that turns a community's scattered expertise into connected, queryable knowledge the COGENT architecture can use. You work where messy real\-world data becomes trustworthy structure: ingesting, resolving, connecting, and modeling knowledge so reasoning has something solid to stand on. You partner closely with neuro\-symbolic AI and applied AI, and you are the reason the platform can answer questions that span a community's knowledge instead of isolated documents. **Why this role exists** ======================== Language models are fluent, but fluency is not knowledge. To reason over a community's expertise with rigor, the platform needs that expertise structured, connected, and trustworthy, not just retrieved as text. Building a knowledge graph from real, fragmented sources is hard: entities to resolve, relationships to infer, quality to enforce, and provenance to preserve. The graph is only as good as the engineering behind it. The AI/ML Data and KO Graph Engineer builds that foundation. You turn scattered knowledge into a graph the COGENT architecture can reason over, so members get answers grounded in their community's real expertise. **What you will own (Areas of Responsibility)** =============================================== You hold seven areas of responsibility across the knowledge layer. Each one is yours to set direction on, build, and measure. **1\. Knowledge graph engineering** ----------------------------------- * Build and maintain the KO graph that structures a community's knowledge for reasoning. * Design schemas, ontologies, and relationships that reflect how expertise actually connects. * Make the graph queryable, performant, and reliable at scale. **2\. Ingestion and knowledge extraction** ------------------------------------------ * Build pipelines that extract knowledge from documents, systems, and community sources into the graph. * Turn unstructured and semi\-structured content into structured knowledge objects. * Keep the graph current as a community's knowledge changes. **3\. Entity resolution and quality** ------------------------------------- * Resolve entities, deduplicate, and connect knowledge across fragmented sources. * Enforce quality so members can trust what the graph tells them. * Detect and handle conflicts and gaps in the knowledge. **4\. Provenance and trust** ---------------------------- * Preserve provenance so every piece of knowledge can be traced to its source. * Build the structure that lets the platform show its work and earn member trust. * Protect sensitive community knowledge with correct access and governance. **5\. Serving knowledge to COGENT** ----------------------------------- * Partner with neuro\-symbolic and applied AI to serve the graph into reasoning and retrieval. * Shape the graph so it supports both symbolic reasoning and neural retrieval. * Make knowledge access fast enough for production answers. **6\. Data pipelines and platform** ----------------------------------- * Build the data pipelines and platform the knowledge layer depends on. * Instrument the pipelines so quality and freshness can be measured. * Turn recurring ingestion needs into reusable connectors. **7\. Evaluation of knowledge quality** --------------------------------------- * Measure the quality, coverage, and freshness of the graph against what communities need. * Build the evaluation that tells whether the knowledge layer is improving. * Use evidence to steer where to invest next. **AI\-augmented ways of working** ================================= You use AI to build the knowledge layer, from extraction and entity resolution to schema suggestions, while you own the correctness, structure, and trustworthiness of the graph. The standard is human in partnership: AI accelerates the work, you own the judgment, the interpretation, and the call. The people who create the most value here are not the ones producing the most output. They are the ones turning evidence into clear, durable decisions. **What this role is n l well. * **Reusable ingestion.** New sources come online faster because ingestion is reusable. * **Measured quality.** Coverage, quality, and freshness are measured and improving. **Who you are** =============== **Required qualifications** --------------------------- * Five or more years in data engineering, knowledge graph engineering, or a related field. * Hands\-on experience building and operating knowledge graphs or graph databases. * Strong data pipeline engineering, including ingestion and transformation. * Experience with entity resolution, deduplication, and data quality. * Solid grounding in knowledge representation, ontologies, or schema design. * Strong Python and SQL, plus graph query languages. * Care for provenance, trust, and protection of sensitive data. ***Preferred qualifications*** ------------------------------ * Experience serving graphs into retrieval or reasoning systems. * Familiarity with neuro\-symbolic AI and how structure supports reasoning. * Experience with embeddings, vector search, and hybrid retrieval. * Experience integrating CRM, AMS, or knowledge\-base sources. * Domain understanding of knowledge\-intensive or professional communities. **How you work** ---------------- * You name the real problem in the data before reaching for a structure. * You care about quality, provenance, and trust as much as coverage. * You build pipelines others can run and extend. * You measure the knowledge layer honestly. * You share reusable connectors and patterns. **Skills \& Competencies** ========================== * Knowledge graph and ontology engineering. * Ingestion, extraction, and transformation pipelines. * Entity resolution, deduplication, and data quality. * Provenance, governance, and protection of sensitive knowledge. * Serving graphs into retrieval and reasoning. * Evaluation of knowledge quality and coverage. * Turning recurring ingestion into reusable capability. **Services \& Tools Experience** ================================ * Graph databases (for example Neo4j\-class systems) and graph query languages (Cypher, SPARQL, or GQL). * Data pipeline and orchestration tools. * Entity resolution and data\-quality tooling. * Vector databases and embedding models for hybrid retrieval. * Python and SQL as primary languages. * Cloud data platforms and storage. * Building and serving the KO graph into the COGENT architecture and MINERVA. **Prior Experience \& Background** ================================== * Prior data or knowledge graph engineering at a software or AI company. * Experience building knowledge structures from messy, real\-world sources. * A track record of production data systems with quality and provenance. * Experience supporting reasoning or retrieval systems is a plus. **Cross\-functional partners** ============================== You work most closely with Neuro\-Symbolic AI, Applied AI, Data Engineering, and Platform Engineering. You build the KO graph that the COGENT architecture reasons over inside MINERVA. **How we hire** =============== We review every application, and we encourage you to apply even if you do not match every line above. Research shows that talented people, especially those from underrepresented communities, often hold back when they do not meet every qualification. If that is the only thing holding you back, apply anyway. Sapience AI is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to a workplace where everyone, regardless of background, has a voice in building what comes next. **Compensation** ================ Base Salary: $204,000 \- $216,000 \+ early stage equity Generous health and wellness benefits *Sapience AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. If you need an accommodation to complete our application process, let your recruiter know.*

jobs.title: Application Technical Delivery Manager
jobs.description: Job Title: Application Technical Delivery Manager Experience: Min: 15\+ years Certifications: Few Certifications from this list mandatory (Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Azure DevOps Engineer Expert, Azure Data Engineer Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Fundamentals, Salesforce Administrator, Salesforce Platform Developer, PMP, Agile Scrum) Location: King of Prussia, PA (Hybrid, 3/2\), Mandatory. Role Overview The Application Technical Delivery Manager will lead end\-to\-end IT delivery of Microsoft Azure \& SaaS cloud program, ensuring alignment with business objectives and technical DevOps best practices. This role combines deep technical know\-how and data expertise with strong leadership and program management skills to drive successful migrations, integrations, and greenfield developments across the ecosystem on Azure. Key Responsibilities Delivery Leadership: Own the technical delivery of custom projects from Requirement through hyper care. Ensure adherence to DevOps framework, Data Governance, Change Management and Security standards. Ability to build consensus and drive offshore global development teams. Work with product owners and managers to track scope, requirements closure, UAT closure, deployment, hyper care, communication, and Training. Own end tend IT ownership of large programs encompassing global IT team. Able to run daily calls to manage global team \& be able to articulate action items, owners, ETA and build consensus. Solution Architecture: Review solutions and provide guidance to the Technical Leads. Oversee integration with third\-party systems (Kafka, MuleSoft middleware, SaaS platforms (like Salesforce), and legacy on\-prem applications. Review data migration strategies; possess deep\-dive knowledge of ETL/ELT activities (Azure Data Factory) and environment rollouts. Provide directions on solutioning, technical delivery guidance, and manage AD/ JIRA dashboards. Team Management: Lead and mentor technical leads, business analysts, quality assurance teams \& offshore project managers. Foster collaboration between product owners, business stakeholders, and technical infrastructure teams. Build strong relationships with business stakeholders, data migration leads, cross functional team to achieve outcome. Stakeholder Engagement: Act as the primary technical point of contact for business and IT leadership regarding customer program initiatives. Provide status on progress and monitor milestones and task delivery across multiple workstreams. Report on weekly status to executives (strong communication and written skills must have) Report daily status to team leaders and follow DevOPs best practices and standards. Quality Assurance \& Compliance: Work with QA management to align on schedule and execution of testing adhering to organizational goals. Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on program roadmaps, new services, and emerging cloud technologies. Be Technical liaison with product team and cross functional program management. Required Skills \& Qualifications 14\+ years in IT with at least 4 years of experience as project or program manager and 6 years focused on the Salesforce and or Microsoft Azure ecosystem. Proven track record of delivering complex cloud migrations and integrations in enterprise environments. Minimum of three large\-scale M\&A , Salesforce \& or Azure implementation experiences (e.g., Master Data Management, Customer Portal, Sales Cloud or complex Integration Hubs). Flexible work from home options available.

jobs.title: Business Operations Lead - Coaching + Digital Programs
jobs.description: Part\-Time Business Operations Lead \| Executive Coaching \+ Digital Programs **Remote, U.S.\-Based \| Contract \| 25 Hours/Week \| $40\-$50/Hour** \*\*\*Note: no need to apply if you haven’t directly ran ops and launches for a coach / digital programs before. Direct experience require. Evolve is looking for an experienced **Business Operations Lead** to run the day\-to\-day operations of our executive coaching and digital programs business. I’m looking for someone who has **already done this work**. You’ve run launches. You understand the moving pieces behind a founder\-led digital business. You know how to take a goal, reverse engineer the plan, coordinate the people and technology, watch the numbers, make decisions, and get it across the finish line. At Evolve, I lead the business and serve as the visionary and coach. Our Business Development \+ Client Experience lead focuses on growing the business and serving our clients. **You will run the operating engine behind it.** You should be the kind of person who looks at what’s coming, reverse engineers what needs to happen, and makes sure I’m fully prepared before I ever have to ask. What you'll own * Day\-to\-day business operations, priorities, and operating cadence * Launch planning, timelines, execution, and post\-launch reviews * Project management across team members, agencies, contractors, and vendors * CRM ownership, including understanding what we need from HubSpot and figuring out how to make it happen * Funnels, email marketing operations, workflows, automations, and customer journeys * KPI dashboards, reporting, and using data to recommend and make business decisions * Client and program operations * Webinars, retreats, events, and digital program execution * Systems, SOPs, documentation, and continuous process improvement * Executive calendar oversight and proactive preparation for upcoming priorities * Making operational decisions and moving work forward without waiting for founder approval on every detail You do **not** need to personally be an expert HubSpot developer. You do need to be highly technical and resourceful. If we need HubSpot to do something, I expect you to figure out what needs to happen, learn how to do it, build it, or find the right resource to get it done. More importantly, you should be able to look at our data and say: **“Here’s what’s happening, here’s what I think it means, and here’s what I recommend we do next.”** You need to have run launches before I’m specifically looking for someone with experience inside a **coaching, consulting, course, membership, digital education, or similar founder\-led business.** I want someone who has **personally owned and run launches**, not simply been on a team during one. You should also have experience working with a CRM such as HubSpot and be comfortable learning technology quickly. Our current tech stack includes HubSpot, Kajabi, Kit, WordPress, Showit, Microsoft 365, Teams, Slack, Zoom, and other digital tools. You don’t need to know every platform on day one. You do need to be the person who can figure out almost any platform. AI is a requirement You need to be an **early adopter and power user of AI**. We use ChatGPT, Claude, Wispr Flow, AI agents, automations, scheduled tasks, and other tools to work smarter and faster. This is not a “willing to learn AI” role. I’m looking for someone who is already deeply immersed, experimenting with new tools, building bots and automations, creating AI workflows, and constantly asking: **“How could we do this faster, better, or with less friction?”** Ideally, you’ll be teaching me things too. I’m obsessed with efficiency. We don’t do things the way they’ve always been done just because that’s the way they’ve always been done. We’re constantly improving how we operate and figuring out how to get our clients bigger results faster. The person we're looking for You are: * Proactive and highly self\-directed * Excellent at turning big goals into executable plans * Comfortable making decisions independently * Strong with data and business judgment * Highly organized without needing everything to already be organized * A clear, professional communicator * Comfortable working directly with a founder * Good at seeing around corners and anticipating what comes next * Able to move between strategy and rolling up your sleeves to get something done * Energized by building better systems rather than maintaining inefficient ones Because you’ll work closely with me, there will also be **occasional executive and personal administrative support as needed**, such as calendar coordination, travel, appointments, or other administrative details. About Evolve I’m Shayla King, executive coach and founder of Evolve. I help ambitious leaders in corporate America increase their **Performance \+ Happiness**, succeeding at a high level without sacrificing the rest of their lives to do it. You’ll be joining a team with support across client experience, business development, podcast production, ads, and video. This is a role with real ownership and autonomy. I want you running the day\-to\-day business, solving problems, improving how we work, and making decisions so I can spend more of my time leading the business, coaching, creating, selling, and doing the work only I can do. The details * **Part\-time contract role** * **Remote, U.S.\-based** * **Approximately 25 hours/week** * **Monday\-Friday** * **Five working hours per day between 9:00 AM and 5:00 PM Central** * **$40\-$50/hour, depending on experience** * Austin\-area candidates are a plus, but not required Interested? Email **careers@evolve\-career.com** with your resume and a short note about why this role interests you. Please specifically tell us: * About a launch you personally ran and what you owned * What type of coaching, consulting, digital, or founder\-led business you’ve worked in * Which CRM and technology platforms you’ve managed * About a business decision you made based on data * How you’re currently using AI to improve the way you work Please put **Business Operations Lead** in the subject line. Pay: $40\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour Expected hours: 25\.0 per week Benefits: * Flexible schedule Application Question(s): * Are you in the U.S. and available to work approximately 25 hours per week, Monday through Friday, with five working hours each day scheduled between 9 AM and 5 PM Central? * Have you personally owned and run a launch for a coaching, consulting, course, membership, digital education, or similar online business? * Have you worked with a CRM such as HubSpot, Salesforce, ActiveCampaign, GoHighLevel, Keap, or a similar platform? * Are you comfortable with executive and personal administrative support as part of this role? Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Business Strategy and Development
jobs.description: **The role** ============ You'll build the channels, relationships, and market standing that let enterprises find, evaluate, buy, and deploy Applied Compute. Our customers run on Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure, and AWS, and many of them want to use committed cloud spend, existing procurement paths, and their own cloud environments when they work with us. You'll build those partnerships from the ground up, own the pipeline they produce, and make the hyperscalers' field teams a real source of new business for us. This role owns the partnerships and market signals that help enterprises find, evaluate, buy, and deploy Applied Compute—cloud marketplaces and private offers, co\-sell programs, analyst relations, SI/channel relationships, and preferred vendor status. **What you'll do** Cloud partnerships * Own our relationships with major cloud providers, including partner program tiers, co\-sell motions, joint business planning, and executive sponsorship * Get Applied Compute listed and transactable on each cloud marketplace, including private offers, so customers can buy through the procurement paths and committed spend they already have * Build relationships with the hyperscalers' field sellers, partner managers, and AI specialists, and give them the sales plays and enablement they need to bring us into their accounts Business development * Source and close partner led opportunities, and own the forecast for partner sourced and partner influenced revenue * Develop relationships with systems integrators, consultancies, and software vendors that deliver AI work for enterprises, and structure resale, referral, and co\-sell partnerships where they make sense * Identify new distribution opportunities and make the case for which ones to pursue and which ones to stop Market standing and enterprise readiness * Own our analyst relations, including briefings with firms like Gartner, Forrester, and IDC and inclusion in the reports and evaluations enterprise buyers rely on * Track the indicators enterprises use to judge a vendor, such as cloud partner tiers, marketplace and co\-sell eligibility, industry recognition, and preferred vendor status, and build a plan to earn the ones that matter * Bring field and market intelligence back to our founders, product, and GTM teams so it shapes what we build and how we sell Operations * Structure partner agreements with our business operations team and outside counsel * Report on partner pipeline and revenue, and run regular business reviews with each partner **What we're looking for** * A track record of generating revenue and opportunities through partners, not only managing relationships * A working understanding of how cloud marketplaces, co\-sell programs, and committed spend function in practice, or the ability to learn them quickly * Judgment about which relationships, programs, and market signals will actually move enterprise deals, and the discipline to set the rest aside * Enough technical curiosity to hold a credible conversation with an engineering team about where our platform runs and how it deploys * Comfort being measured on outcomes, including pipeline and revenue **Strong candidates also have** * Experience at an AI infrastructure, data, or developer tools company that sells through cloud marketplaces * Previous work at Google Cloud, Microsoft, or AWS in a partner facing role * Experience running analyst relations or earning inclusion in industry reports * Relationships with global systems integrators and AI consultancies The U.S. base salary range for this full\-time position is **$120,000–$240,000**. Total compensation for this role also includes meaningful equity in a fast\-growing startup, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you both personally and professionally. Base salary is determined by a range of factors including individual qualifications, experience, skills, interview performance, market data, and work location. The listed salary range is intended as a guideline and may be adjusted. **About us** ============ Applied Compute builds Specific Intelligence for the enterprise. We provide the continual learning infrastructure for companies to build agent workforces trained on proprietary data and institutional expertise. Our researchers and platform embed directly within customer environments to build custom evals, train models, and deploy agents that get better with use. * **Why we’re excited:** We get to work at a rare intersection. Our product team builds the platform powering a new generation of digital coworkers. Our research team pushes the frontier of post\-training and reinforcement learning. Our applied AI team sits side\-by\-side with customers as they ship agents into production. This combination of strong product, deep research, and boots on the ground is what we believe it takes to bring AI to the enterprise. We are product\-led, research\-enabled, and forward\-deployed. * **Who we are**: We’re a team of engineers, researchers, and operators. Many of us are former founders. We've built RL infrastructure at OpenAI, data foundations at Scale AI, and systems at Together, Two Sigma, Watershed, and others. We work with F50 customers and are fortunate to be backed by partners like Kleiner Perkins, Benchmark, Sequoia, Lux, and Greenoaks. * **Who Thrives Here**: We're looking for people who are excited about applying novel research and complex systems to real\-world problems. Our team genuinely enjoys working with customers: listening, empathizing, and understanding how work actually gets done in their organizations. Former founders, people who've built a lot of side projects, or anyone who's shown they can own something end\-to\-end, tend to do well here. **Benefits \& Logistics** ========================= This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our office in the Mission. We offer: * Competitive compensation and equity * 100% employer\-paid health insurance coverage for you and your family * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave * Daily lunches and dinners * Transportation and relocation support * 5% 401k match We sponsor visas. While we can't guarantee success for every candidate or role, if you're the right fit, we're committed to working through the process with you. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. As set forth in Applied Compute’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer, Infrastructure & Platforms
jobs.description: Ricursive Intelligence is a frontier AI lab building self\-improving systems, starting with chip design. We are reinventing chip development and closing the loop between AI and the hardware that fuels it, recursively accelerating the path to artificial superintelligence. Backed by $335M from Sequoia, Lightspeed, DST, and NVIDIA Ventures, we are a growing, fast\-paced team where every hire shapes the work. The company has unmatched talent density, including IMO, IPHO, and IOAA gold medalists, pioneers who made prior breakthroughs in chip design: AlphaChip (Nature 2021\), ePlace (DAC Best Paper Nominee 2014\), RL\-CCD (DAC Best Paper 2023\), INSTA (DAC Best Paper 2025\), and C3PO (ASP\-DAC Best Paper 2026\), chip leads for Apple Silicon (multiple generations of iPhone and iPad) and Google (TPU, OpenTitan), and top researchers and engineers from Anthropic, Google DeepMind, Stanford, and MIT. **ABOUT THE ROLE** Ricursive's research runs on infrastructure that has to keep pace with the research itself: ML training and evaluation workloads, EDA tool flows, and a fast\-growing team that needs everything from cloud environments to developer workflows to just work. This role owns that foundation — the pipelines, platforms, and systems that let a small team move like a much larger one. You will own our infrastructure\-as\-code (IaC), continuous integration \& deployment (CI/CD), and cloud platform end\-to\-end that keeps the lab running day to day. Additionally, you will be collaborating closely with the team to build out the right observability stack for their needs while working around environment security limitations. **WHAT YOU WILL DO** * Design, build out and extend our self\-managed cloud platform with Terraform, setting the IaC patterns the rest of the team builds on. * Own our platform deployments spanning various environments day to day, including performance, security, reliability, scalability, and adapting to evolving business requirements. * Design, implement, and operate CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions for mission\-critical repositories, working within strict security and deployment restrictions. * Architect scalable AI tooling and developer experience workflows across multiple distinct user environments, working closely with our physical design (PD) engineers. * Build out the observability stack with the team, covering pipeline health, application\-level metrics, and ML workloads. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** * BS in CS, CE, EE, or a closely related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 4\+ years of hands\-on infrastructure/platform engineering, with ownership of systems others depend on. * Owned production IaC architecture including maintenance and new features, not just consumed modules. * Designed and implemented production CI/CD pipelines that build and ship reproducible artifacts, with attention to performance, scalability, and security. * Prior experience with observability tooling for monitoring pipeline health as well as application\-level metrics. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Hands\-on experience with GCP, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions, including custom runner setups. * Experience running ML infrastructure for training and evaluation workloads, including GPU/TPU compute. * Familiarity with LLM observability tooling: tracing, evaluations, and cost \& latency monitoring. * Security depth: dependency supply\-chain hardening, OIDC\-based auth, least\-privilege secrets, and compliance work such as SOC 2 or penetration testing. * Early\-stage startup experience: built infrastructure from zero or near\-zero. **Location** ------------ Palo Alto **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- On\-site **Department** -------------- Engineering

jobs.title: Partnerships
jobs.description: **The role** ============ You'll build and run Applied Compute's relationships with the companies that shape the open model ecosystem, including hyperscalers, chip makers, and the labs and teams releasing open weight models. Our view is that there should be as many models in the world as there are companies, and that most token spend will eventually run on open models that companies own in the same way they own their code and data. Whether that happens depends on more than model quality. It depends on how quickly new open models become usable in production, on the hardware and infrastructure they run on, and on how well the companies building each layer work together. Those working relationships are still early across the industry, and this role is responsible for ours. You'll be one of our first dedicated partnerships hires. **What you'll do** Hardware and infrastructure partners * Own our relationships with the chip makers, hardware vendors, and infrastructure companies our platform is built on, from the day to day working relationship up to executive sponsorship * Turn those relationships into things that matter to our customers and our team, such as early access to new hardware and software, joint launches, co\-marketing, and technical collaboration with our researchers * Represent Applied Compute in partner ecosystem initiatives like open model coalitions and startup programs, and make sure commitments on both sides are tracked and delivered Open model labs * Build relationships with the labs releasing open weight models so that we hear about important releases early and can support them on our platform quickly * Work with our research team to plan day zero support for new models, and coordinate joint announcements when our customers train on them * Keep a clear view of which models our customers want, which ones we support today, and where the gaps are, and bring that view to our founders and product team Building the function * Decide which new partnerships are worth pursuing, make the case for them internally, and structure the agreements with our business operations team and outside counsel * Run the operating side of our partnerships, including credits and program benefits, partner reporting, and regular internal updates * Work with marketing on partner launches, events, and content, and with sales to put partner relationships to work in customer deals **What we're looking for** * A record of building relationships with senior people at other organizations and turning them into concrete outcomes * Real curiosity about model development and the drive to become fluent in it quickly. You should be able to follow model releases, read the accompanying papers and technical reports, and hold your own with researchers about what supporting a new model requires * Excellent judgment about people and about which opportunities deserve your time * A strong operator who keeps the commitments, dates, and details behind every relationship in order **Strong candidates also have** * Experience working with a chip maker, hyperscaler, or AI lab on the partner side * Built a partnerships function early at a company that went on to scale * Relationships in the open source and open model community * Experience running launches or programs with an external partner The U.S. base salary range for this full\-time position is **$125,000–$260,000**. Total compensation for this role also includes meaningful equity in a fast\-growing startup, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you both personally and professionally. Base salary is determined by a range of factors including individual qualifications, experience, skills, interview performance, market data, and work location. The listed salary range is intended as a guideline and may be adjusted. **About us** ============ Applied Compute builds Specific Intelligence for the enterprise. We provide the continual learning infrastructure for companies to build agent workforces trained on proprietary data and institutional expertise. Our researchers and platform embed directly within customer environments to build custom evals, train models, and deploy agents that get better with use. * **Why we’re excited:** We get to work at a rare intersection. Our product team builds the platform powering a new generation of digital coworkers. Our research team pushes the frontier of post\-training and reinforcement learning. Our applied AI team sits side\-by\-side with customers as they ship agents into production. This combination of strong product, deep research, and boots on the ground is what we believe it takes to bring AI to the enterprise. We are product\-led, research\-enabled, and forward\-deployed. * **Who we are**: We’re a team of engineers, researchers, and operators. Many of us are former founders. We've built RL infrastructure at OpenAI, data foundations at Scale AI, and systems at Together, Two Sigma, Watershed, and others. We work with F50 customers and are fortunate to be backed by partners like Kleiner Perkins, Benchmark, Sequoia, Lux, and Greenoaks. * **Who Thrives Here**: We're looking for people who are excited about applying novel research and complex systems to real\-world problems. Our team genuinely enjoys working with customers: listening, empathizing, and understanding how work actually gets done in their organizations. Former founders, people who've built a lot of side projects, or anyone who's shown they can own something end\-to\-end, tend to do well here. **Benefits \& Logistics** ========================= This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our office in the Mission. We offer: * Competitive compensation and equity * 100% employer\-paid health insurance coverage for you and your family * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave * Daily lunches and dinners * Transportation and relocation support * 5% 401k match We sponsor visas. While we can't guarantee success for every candidate or role, if you're the right fit, we're committed to working through the process with you. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. As set forth in Applied Compute’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

jobs.title: Program Manager
jobs.description: **Program Manager** The Program Manager leads complex engineering design projects, directs multi\-disciplinary technical teams, and develops and maintains strong client relationships. Operating as a technical leader and program director, this role ensures all engineering assignments achieve technical excellence, strict regulatory compliance, budget adherence, and on\-time project delivery. Technical engineering expertise is required to supervise technical work, perform quality assurance/quality control (QA/QC) reviews, and solve complex site design or infrastructure challenges along with other engineers. **Core Responsibilities** ========================= * Technical Direction: Lead and oversee civil engineering designer's efforts, including site layout, grading, drainage infrastructure, utility distribution systems (water, storm sewer, sanitary sewer, conduit/dry utilities), and stormwater management/hydrologic analysis from conceptual phase through construction. * QA/QC Oversight: Conduct thorough quality control and quality assurance reviews for accuracy, design completeness, engineering soundness, and compliance with local municipal, state, and environmental permitting standards. * Design Specifications: Oversee the production of detailed technical reports, engineering specifications, hydrologic/hydraulic calculations, contract documents, and complete permit application packages for local and state regulatory approval. * Engineering Judgment: Provide high\-level engineering judgment, technical decision\-making, and field support during conceptual development, final plan delivery, and construction administration. * Project Execution: Serve as primary Delivery Manager on a major infrastructure program, or multiple mid\-sized projects or a portfolio of small projects simultaneously. * Project Accounting: Maintain complete project accounting oversight, including schedule tracking, budget management, fee structures, invoicing support, profitability, and cost control. * Resource Management: Coordinate internal engineering teams, cross\-functional staff allocations, and external sub\-consultants to meet critical deadlines efficiently. * Staff Development: Supervise technical work, hire, train, and mentor engineers, with a focus on professional growth and high performance. * Client Relations: Act as key point of contact for external clients, facilitating plan review meetings, agency presentations, and long\-term partnerships. * Business Development: Participate in proposal writing, scope and fee negotiations, marketing initiatives, and cross\-selling firm\-wide services to expand pipeline opportunities. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree in Civil or Structural Engineering * Professional Engineer (P.E.) License (DC) preferred or acquired within 90 days * Minimum 10\+ years of engineering design and project management experience * Demonstrated experience in Transportation Engineering (roadways, traffic, bridges, utilities, DOT projects) OR Land Development (site design, grading, SWM, ESC, utilities) * Technical engineering expertise * Microstation knowledge * Working knowledge of industry calculation software * Demonstrated ability to manage project budgets, schedules, and fee structures * Strong written and verbal communication **Compensation:** $165,000 to $200,000 annually. Actual compensation offers are determined based on candidate credentials, role complexity, internal equity, relevant skills, and total direct experience. Total compensation includes bonus opportunities. **Location:** Hybrid work environment. Company\-wide policy. Candidates are expected in the office 3 days a week. **Benefits:** Our comprehensive and competitive benefits package includes Health, Vision, and Dental insurance, commuteparking expenses, annual bonus potential, 401(k) plans with Company match, Holidays, and Paid Time Off. **Other Requirements:** * Applicants must be eligible to work in the United States. H1B VISA sponsorship is not available. * Verification of background checks, references, work history, and Department of Motor Vehicles records will be required prior to employment. * Candidates with Military experience are encouraged to apply. We are an Equal Opportunity Employer.

jobs.title: Sales Account Executive
jobs.description: **This postion reports to:** Chief Growth Officer **Overview** ------------ meshIQ delivers middleware and agentic AI governance solutions to some of the world’s leading organizations. The company operates in a high\-growth market segment and is hyper\-focused on customer acquisition. It is looking to hire a Sales Account Executive, a role that will focus on customer acquisition to enable meshIQ’s ‘land and expand’ initiatives. This is a high\-visibility and high\-impact role that will play a key role in delivering revenue growth by driving customer acquisition through partners. The role requires a strong sales background and collaboration with Marketing, Business Development, Customer Success, Technology Services, and Marketing functions. **The Role:** Reporting to the Chief Growth Officer, the Sales Account Executive will be responsible for expanding and driving relationships with existing customers, partners, and prospects to build a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities. The Sales Account Executive will work with the CGO to continue executing the defined partner strategy and related initiatives. **Sales Account Executive Responsibilities** -------------------------------------------- **As a Sales Account Executive, you will:** * **Enterprise consultative selling:** Ability to uncover business problems – such as operational risk, outages, migration delays, compliance gaps, and high infrastructure costs – and connect them to measurable business outcomes. * **Middleware and integration fluency:** A working understanding of technologies such as IBM MQ, Kafka, RabbitMQ, TIBCO EMS, Solace, APIs, event streaming, hybrid cloud, legacy\-to\-cloud modernization and Agentic AI (Applied AI). You do not need to be an engineer, but you must learn to speak credibly with architects and infrastructure leaders. meshIQ’s platform spans multiple middleware technologies and environments. * **Technical discovery and value articulation:** Skill in translating technical capabilities – observability, automation, governance, auditability, self\-service, and transactional integrity – into executive\-level value, including lower risk, faster incident resolution, reduced costs, and accelerated modernization. * **Executive and multi\-stakeholder relationship building:** Enterprise deals typically involve middleware administrators, platform engineering, enterprise architects, security, compliance, application owners, procurement, and C\-level sponsors. The AE must build consensus across these groups and establish trusted\-advisor relationships. * **Complex opportunity and pipeline management:** Strong qualification, forecasting, account planning, CRM discipline, next\-step management, and ability to move opportunities through long enterprise sales cycles. meshIQ’s sales roles emphasize opportunity identification, qualification, progression, account planning, and CRM maintenance. * **Partner, solution, and cross\-functional collaboration:** Ability to coordinate with systems integrators, resellers, sales engineers, marketing, professional services, and customer success. This is especially important for land\-and\-expand strategies and middleware modernization projects, where partners can influence both technical design and purchasing decisions. **The successful candidate will possess:** * Exceptional relationship\-building and management skills to establish rapport, trust, and meshIQ brand preference with channel partners. Strong organizational skills and demonstrated ability to work in a fast\-paced environment and manage multiple tasks. * Excellent written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills. * Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills. Demonstrated ability to take initiative and interact with all levels of management. * Ability to act autonomously, self\-starter. Quick learner with high energy and creative problem\-solving skills. Detail\-oriented with the ability to adapt to a changing environment. Energetic, enthusiastic, and organized. **Desired Skills and Experience** --------------------------------- **Required:** * Problem\-solving, Communication, Teamwork, Quick learning * 3\+ years’ experience in sales * Proficient in the Microsoft Office suite, with strong PowerPoint and Excel skills * Ability to travel up to 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and partners you serve **Preferred:** * Experience with managing and supporting IBM Business Partners * Experience with HubSpot CRM * Extensive sales experience with integration/middleware software * Extensive sales experience with observability/monitoring software * Multilingual – esp. French/Spanish/German ### **Disclaimer** The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals assigned to this position. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. **Apply for Sales Account Executive** ------------------------------------- To apply for this opportunity, email the following information to careers@meshiq.com. * Include "Sales Account Executive" and your full name in the subject line * Cover letter * Resumé or link to an updated Linkedin profile * Contact Information, email, and phone number

jobs.title: Shipping & Facilities Coordinator
jobs.description: TOPTICA Photonics Inc. (TPI) founded in 2001, is TOPTICA’s strongest location outside Germany and a hub for innovation and engineering excellence in North America. Our 40\+ team members work alongside leading institutions like the University of Rochester (NY) and RIT, developing advanced products such as optical isolators and OPO laser systems. We believe great ideas come from passionate people. At TPI you’ll find an open, supportive environment that encourages curiosity, teamwork, and initiative. Engineers, technicians, scientists, and customer support professionals all contribute to advancing photonics worldwide—while enjoying Rochester’s affordable living, vibrant innovation scene, and excellent quality of life. **Shipping \& Facilities Coordinator** ====================================== We are seeking a detail\-oriented and motivated Shipping and Facilities Coordinator to join our growing warehouse team. In this entry\-level role, you will help prepare, document, and release outgoing shipments to ensure our products reach customers safely and on time. You will also support the day\-to\-day operation and upkeep of our facility by performing routine maintenance and minor repairs, identifying facility needs, and coordinating with external contractors and service providers as needed. This is an excellent opportunity for an organized individual to build a career in supply chain, logistics, and facility management. ### **What can you expect in the role of Shipping \& Facilities Coordinator?** * Load and unload shipping trucks * Learn and maintain fluency in all IT software as it relates to department deliverables * Verify shipping documents, print packing slips, and accurately enter shipment tracking data into our ERP and order management system * Verify and keep records on the weight and cost of each outgoing shipment as well as the condition of the contents received in incoming shipments * Receive and distribute incoming shipments for all departments * Prioritize shipments as company/departmental needs change * Evaluate customer shipping orders to determine the type of transportation needed * Prepare shipping documents, mailing labels for domestic orders * Ensure the accuracy of all shipping documents, gather, and maintain all data relative to shipping activities * Organize and arrange warehouse for safety and straightforward manageability * Coordinate and perform quarterly cycle count and annual physical inventory in collaboration with other departments * Support facility operations by performing routine maintenance, addressing minor repairs, and ensuring the facility remains safe, clean, functional, and well * maintained * Serve as a liaison between office personnel and external contractors * Serve as a liaison between customers and internal departments (Sales, Service, Finance) to resolve shipment\-related issues * Maintain accurate, well\-organized records to support audits, reporting, and customer inquiries * Identify improvement opportunities and escalate recurring issues or process gaps ### **Must\-haves: What you’ll need for this role?** #### **Qualifications:** * High school diploma required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred * 1–3 years of experience in shipping / receiving or a related role * Experience with ERP systems, Navision or Navision Business Central preferred * Experience using shipping portals or software (i.e. Fedex, UPS) * Strong attention to detail and organizational skills * Excellent written and verbal communication skills * Ability to lift up to 50lbs * Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks in a fast paced environment * Operate equipment such as forklift, pallet jacks and more safely and efficiently #### **Key Skills:** * Documentation and recordkeeping * Problem\-solving and process coordination * Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Word) and comfort learning new software systems. ### **What would be a plus in this role?** * Familiarity with tax\-exempt and payment term compliance requirements * Familiarity with shipping terms and conditions preferred ### **It’s a plus if you’ve heard of the following terms:** * Incoterms * Bill of Lading * Space Planning \& Allocation ### **What do we offer:** * Medical Coverage: TOPTICA provides 100% employer\-paid medical insurance through Excellus with a fully funded HRA for in\-network expenses * Dental Coverage: Employees receive 100% employer\-paid dental coverage through Excellus Dental with a $600 annual HRA * Life Insurance: TOPTICA offers a basic term life policy through Unum equal to two times the employee’s salary (up to $300,000\) at no cost, effective after 30 employees can participate in the 401(k) plan, with company matching up to 6% after six months * Paid Time Off: Employees receive 7 sick days, 3 personal days, and accrue vacation starting at 10 days per year, increasing to 15 days after two years * Observed Holidays: Employees receive 12 paid U.S. federal holidays each year * Company Shutdown: TOPTICA observes a year\-end shutdown between Christmas and New Year’s * Salary range: $45,000–$55,000 **Interested? jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Who Are We?** Prolaio believes that continuous learning and collaboration can make a significant difference in how heart care is administered. We are creating smarter ways to address heart disease and heart risks by uniting patients, care teams, and researchers on a secure, technology\-enabled platform that drives clinical innovation and offers a path towards better patient outcomes. This is precision cardiology, and we know it's within reach. **What Will You Do?** **The Overview** The Site Reliability Engineer will ensure that Prolaio's cardiovascular data platform reliably captures, transports, and delivers continuous biosensor data from participants to the clinical researchers and trial sponsors who depend on it. In this role, you will build and operate the monitoring, service level objectives, incident response, and automation needed to keep critical data flows healthy, identify failures before they impact studies, and ensure that device downtime never goes unnoticed simply because a shipment record says a device was delivered. This role is ideal for a self\-starter who thrives at the intersection of software reliability, connected devices, and clinical data. You will investigate incidents across the full participant\-to\-platform stack, combining service telemetry with device data and participant reports to determine whether an issue originated with the hardware, phone, firmware, mobile application, connectivity, or the platform itself. You will turn those investigations into durable improvements, automating manual checks, strengthening observability, reducing operational toil, and building the reliability practices that keep Prolaio's clinical data complete and trustworthy at scale. **The Specifics** * Build monitoring that treats missing data as a failure rather than a quiet day — freshness, volume and quality checks that verify delivery from outside the system instead of trusting a job's exit code. * Define and maintain SLIs, SLOs and error budgets for customer\-facing data services, and report attainment honestly, including when the news is bad. * Join the on\-call rotation, run incident response, and write blameless postmortems that produce owned follow\-up actions. * Investigate device failures end to end: correlate discharge curves, Bluetooth disconnects and wear detection against the participant's complaint, and establish or exonerate each candidate cause on evidence. * Treat the fleet as a population — failure rates per device\-month, clustering by build lot, firmware version or site — rather than as a queue of individual tickets. * Close the loop. When an analysis cannot reach a verdict, name the missing metric or threshold and route it back into the diagnostics pipeline so the next case is answerable from telemetry alone. * Build reliability tooling in Python and SQL on BigQuery, and keep monitors and probes defined as code rather than configured by hand. * Retire manual checks by automating them. Operational toil should shrink quarter over quarter, not accumulate. **Why Prolaio?** * **Impactful Work:** You will join in the fight against heart failure (HF) and hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) with the goal of extending and saving the lives of our patients while also being at the forefront of changing the healthcare industry through technology. * **Innovative Environment****:** You will be part of an organization doing something that's never been done before. * **Professional Growth****:** You will join a growing team and have a substantial impact on our daily and future operations with the opportunity to continuously learn and grow. * **Collaborative Team****:** You will be part of a team of collaborative, curious, and committed individuals focused on the collective good, inclusiveness, scientific excellence, and advancing digital health for cardiology. **Who You Are?** * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 2–5 years in reliability engineering, production operations, hardware or systems test, field failure analysis, or data engineering — in a role where you were accountable for something that had to keep working. * Working SQL and Python: able to pull a dataset, characterize it, and defend the query behind a number. * Experience with a cloud data platform (Google Cloud and BigQuery preferred; AWS or Azure equivalents are fine). * Ability to write up a technical investigation clearly — what was observed, what was ruled out and how, and what remains unknown. **Additional Qualifications (Nice to Haves)** * Hands\-on exposure to Bluetooth Low Energy (GATT services and characteristics, connection intervals, pairing and bonding, disconnect behaviour), Wi\-Fi or cellular data standards — and how each one fails in the field rather than how it is specified to behave. * Battery and power behaviour: discharge characterisation, charge\-state interpretation, and telling a measurement artefact from a real capacity defect. * Formal reliability method — FMEA and risk priority numbers, FRACAS practice, and standards such as IEC 60812 or ISO 13485\. * Observability tooling (Datadog, Grafana or similar) and synthetic monitoring. * Android device telemetry, mobile application diagnostics, or embedded firmware experience. * Prior work in medtech, digital health, clinical trials or another regulated, patient\-facing environment. **Why You'll Love Working Here** * **Meaningful Compensation**: Competitive salary, performance bonus, and equity so you can share in what we build. * **Great Health Coverage:** Medical, dental, and vision plans with multiple options and strong company contributions. * **Flexible Spending Perks:** HSA, FSA, commuter benefits, and a $1,200 annual Lifestyle Spending Account to support wellness, commuting, family needs, and more. * **Time to Recharge:** Generous paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays. * **Family\-First Benefits**: Paid parental leave, caregiver leave, and support for growing families. * **Security \& Peace of Mind**: Company\-paid life insurance and short\- and long\-term disability coverage. * **Plan for the Future**: 401(k) plan to help you build long\-term financial security. * **Care When You Need It:** Easy access to telehealth and optional supplemental coverage for life's unexpected moments. Starting Salary is at $ 118,000\.00 (Exact Compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location)

jobs.description: **Software Application Engineer \- Compact Equipment Machine Controls** Yanmar Compact Equipment North America designs, manufactures and supports a complete range of compact equipment including compact track loaders, mini excavators, wheel loaders and construction equipment for use in such markets as construction, landscaping, utility, land management and agriculture. The products are sold primarily through a third party, independent dealer network. **OVERVIEW:** **Responsibilities** * This job involves developing and using system requirements to design, develop, and test software components used in machine control platforms, engine control platforms, display, and telematics platforms * Specific responsibilities include requirements development and analysis, software design, software implementation, interface between software layers, and development/execution of test procedures * Additional responsibilities may include interfaces between hardware and software as well as evaluating operational performance of an overall system * Writing and implementing source codes of embedded systems and enhancing code samples of existing systems * Testing and debugging embedded system software using different tools/methods available to improve code quality and optimize system performance * Collaborating with other teams both internal and externally to provide post\-production support **Qualifications** * Requires a 4\-year degree in an accredited Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering or Computer Science curriculum * Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems * Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors * Teamwork: Knowledge of the necessity and value of teamwork; jobs.title: Software Developer
jobs.description: **Build software that makes everyday work easier** Growing businesses often rely on disconnected tools to manage projects, track approvals, and coordinate their teams. At Northvia Technologies, we build cloud\-based software that brings those activities together and reduces the time people spend on repetitive administrative tasks. We are looking for a Software Developer who enjoys turning practical business problems into useful, reliable features. You will contribute across the stack, help shape technical decisions, and see your work move from an initial idea into the hands of customers. This is a fully remote position for candidates based in the United States. **The product and the people behind it** Our platform helps small and midsize businesses organize projects, automate workflows, and understand how work moves through their organizations. Customers use it to assign responsibilities, manage approval processes, track progress, and connect information from other business applications. You will join a small engineering team working closely with product management and design. Engineers participate early in planning, contribute to estimates, and help identify simpler solutions when requirements become unnecessarily complex. We use written proposals, code reviews, and focused meetings to keep work moving. We value clear communication, thoughtful questions, and a willingness to share knowledge. **Your role on the team** As a Software Developer, you will own moderately complex features from technical planning through implementation, testing, and release. Your work will include both customer\-facing interfaces and the services that support them. You might build a configurable approval workflow, improve the performance of a reporting page, or develop an integration that keeps customer data synchronized across systems. You will also spend time improving existing code and investigating issues that affect the customer experience. You will report to an Engineering Manager and work alongside developers who can provide feedback and support. We expect you to work independently on familiar problems and ask for help when requirements, risks, or technical constraints need clarification. **What you will work on** Your responsibilities will cover several parts of the development process: * **Feature development:** Build responsive interfaces in React and TypeScript, implement backend functionality in Node.js, and connect both through well\-defined APIs. * **Data and integrations:** Work with PostgreSQL, design database changes, improve queries, and integrate external services with appropriate validation and error handling. * **Software quality:** Write meaningful automated tests, review pull requests, and help keep the codebase understandable and maintainable. * **Reliability and performance:** Investigate bugs, use logs and monitoring tools to diagnose problems, and address performance issues across the application. * **Security and accessibility:** Apply secure coding practices, handle customer information carefully, and build interfaces that people with different accessibility needs can use. * **Planning and collaboration:** Discuss requirements with product managers and designers, break work into manageable tasks, and communicate progress and blockers. * **Documentation:** Record technical decisions, explain important tradeoffs, and maintain guidance that helps teammates work with the systems you build. You will also participate in release support during your scheduled working hours. This position does not include a scheduled overnight on\-call rotation. **Our engineering environment** Our current stack includes: **Frontend** \- React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS **Backend** \- Node.js, TypeScript, REST APIs **Database** \- PostgreSQL **Infrastructure** \- AWS and Docker **Version control and delivery** \- GitHub and GitHub Actions **Testing** \- Vitest, React Testing Library, and Playwright You do not need prior experience with every tool listed. Strong development fundamentals and experience with a comparable stack are valuable. **What you should bring** We are looking for someone with approximately **2–4 years of professional software development experience** who can demonstrate: * Strong working knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript. * Experience building and maintaining applications with React. * Experience developing backend services with Node.js or a comparable backend framework. * An understanding of HTTP, API design, authentication, and common web application patterns. * Practical experience with relational databases and SQL. * Familiarity with Git, pull requests, and collaborative code review. * Experience writing automated tests and diagnosing failures. * The ability to break an unfamiliar problem into smaller steps and explain your approach. * Clear written communication and consistent follow\-through in a remote environment. A degree in Computer Science or a related field is welcome, but equivalent professional e ment. **By the end of your third month**, we expect you to deliver moderately scoped work with increasing independence, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and help maintain the areas of the application you have worked on. We evaluate success through the usefulness and reliability of your work, your collaboration with others, and your ability to learn and follow through. **How remote work works here** You may work from anywhere within the United States where Northvia Technologies can employ you. This role requires no regular office attendance or business travel. Our core collaboration hours are **10:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m. Eastern Time, Monday through Friday**. Outside those hours, you can organize your schedule around focused work and personal commitments while meeting the expectations of a full\-time, approximately 40\-hour workweek. We use written updates and shared documentation to keep decisions accessible. Meetings are intended for discussion, planning, and problems that benefit from working together in real time. We provide company equipment and onboarding support. You will need a reliable internet connection and a workspace suitable for focused work and confidential conversations. **Pay, benefits, and professional growth** The annual base salary for this position is **$100,000–$145,000**. The final offer will reflect relevant experience, demonstrated technical ability, and the scope of responsibility you are ready to take on. A discretionary annual performance bonus may be awarded in addition to base salary. Our benefits package includes: * Medical, dental, and vision insurance. * A 401(k) retirement plan with employer matching. * 20 days of paid time off, plus company holidays. * Paid parental leave. * A company\-provided laptop. * A one\-time home office setup allowance and monthly internet reimbursement. * An annual learning budget for approved courses, books, certifications, or conferences. * Regular development conversations with your manager and opportunities to take on broader technical responsibilities. **What to expect when you apply** Our interview process has four stages: * **Introductory conversation — 30 minutes.** Discuss your experience, interests, availability, and expectations with our recruiting team. * **Project discussion — 45 minutes.** Walk through a project you have worked on, including your contribution, technical decisions, and lessons learned. You do not need to share confidential code or materials. * **Practical technical session — 60 minutes.** Collaborate with an engineer on a small coding or debugging task that reflects everyday development work. You may use documentation and ask questions throughout. * **Engineering manager conversation — 30 minutes.** Discuss collaboration, ownership, professional development, and any remaining questions about the role. There is no unpaid take\-home project. We will explain each stage in advance and provide an update after every interview. **Apply to Northvia Technologies** Submit your résumé through the application form accompanying this posting. A short introduction describing your interests and relevant experience is welcome, but a cover letter is not required. You may include a portfolio, GitHub profile, or other work samples you are permitted to share. Public projects are optional; we recognize that much professional engineering work takes place in private repositories. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position. Northvia Technologies considers qualified applicants from all backgrounds. If you need an accommodation during the application or interview process, let our recruiting team know so we can arrange appropriate support. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $145,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * AD\&D insurance * Dental insurance * Disability insurance * Family leave * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid parental leave * Parental leave * Partner benefits * Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Strategy & Operations
jobs.description: **The role** ============ As a member of our strategy and operations team, you'll help design the commercial model that connects our product and go to market teams, and you'll build and run the systems that let Applied Compute sign, deploy, and support enterprise customers without slowing down. Working alongside our founders and GTM leaders, you'll help decide how we package and price what we build. You'll also run much of the operational path from first conversation to live deployment, and you'll help make it faster and cleaner every time we run it. You’ll sit at the center of how we sell and operate: building the internal systems and operating cadence that help our sales team move faster and close more reliably. You’ll work directly with GTM, product, engineering, and finance to turn bespoke go\-to\-market work into clear workflows—improving handoffs, decision\-making, data quality, and execution across the funnel. **What you'll do** You'll own both the commercial model (pricing, packaging, comp, planning) and the operational engine that gets deals signed and customers live. Strategy * **Pricing \& packaging:** build and maintain deal models (costs, margin, resourcing) and help structure complex enterprise deals * **Segmentation \& planning:** define ICP/segmentation, learn from wins/losses, and feed market/customer signal into product \+ GTM planning * **Commercial systems:** turn bespoke deal requirements into repeatable tooling and workflows (calculator, approvals, handoffs) so the team moves faster Operations * **Contracting \& deal desk:** run contracts end\-to\-end (NDA MSA/DPA/order forms), manage outside counsel \+ redlines, and scale templates/approvals for non\-standard terms * **Engagements \& deployments:** coordinate scoping, staffing, timelines, and the path to production (security reviews, questionnaires, cloud access, vendor onboarding) * **Compliance \& systems:** build intake/tracking \+ contract repository; keep SOC 2/ISO evidence and vendor/policy workflows current * **GTM ops \& reporting:** keep CRM/GTM tools clean, build the operating cadence/reporting leaders use, and take on high\-impact projects that don’t yet have a clear owner **What we're looking for** * Strong modeling skills and the judgment * Experience designing pricing, sales compensation, or GTM plans, not only analyzing them * Comfort reading contracts and understanding what a clause means for the business * A strong operator who creates structure out of ambiguity and keeps many threads moving without dropping any of them * Clear, careful writing and good judgment about when to escalate * Real interest in AI, including how our technology works, where a model runs and what data it touches, and how compute costs and model economics shape a business **Strong candidates also have** * Experience at a usage based, consumption, or infrastructure company with a technical sales motion * Experience with enterprise procurement, security reviews, or data protection agreements * Training in consulting, banking, law, or growth investing, followed by time in an operating role at a startup * Comfort with SQL or working directly with data * AI built into your own analytical workflow, or internal tools and automations you've built to take work off your own plate The U.S. base salary range for this full\-time position is **$120,000–$240,000**. Total compensation for this role also includes meaningful equity in a fast\-growing startup, along with a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you both personally and professionally. Base salary is determined by a range of factors including individual qualifications, experience, skills, interview performance, market data, and work location. The listed salary range is intended as a guideline and may be adjusted. **About us** ============ Applied Compute builds Specific Intelligence for the enterprise. We provide the continual learning infrastructure for companies to build agent workforces trained on proprietary data and institutional expertise. Our researchers and platform embed directly within customer environments to build custom evals, train models, and deploy agents that get better with use. * **Why we’re excited:** We get to work at a rare intersection. Our product team builds the platform powering a new generation of digital coworkers. Our research team pushes the frontier of post\-training and reinforcement learning. Our applied AI team sits side\-by\-side with customers as they ship agents into production. This combination of strong product, deep research, and boots on the ground is what we believe it takes to bring AI to the enterprise. We are product\-led, research\-enabled, and forward\-deployed. * **Who we are**: We’re a team of engineers, researchers, and operators. Many of us are former founders. We've built RL infrastructure at OpenAI, data foundations at Scale AI, and systems at Together, Two Sigma, Watershed, and others. We work with F50 customers and are fortunate to be backed by partners like Kleiner Perkins, Benchmark, Sequoia, Lux, and Greenoaks. * **Who Thrives Here**: We're looking for people who are excited about applying novel research and complex systems to real\-world problems. Our team genuinely enjoys working with customers: listening, empathizing, and understanding how work actually gets done in their organizations. Former founders, people who've built a lot of side projects, or anyone who's shown they can own something end\-to\-end, tend to do well here. **Benefits \& Logistics** ========================= This role is based in San Francisco. We work from our office in the Mission. We offer: * Competitive compensation and equity * 100% employer\-paid health insurance coverage for you and your family * Unlimited PTO * Paid parental leave * Daily lunches and dinners * Transportation and relocation support * 5% 401k match We sponsor visas. While we can't guarantee success for every candidate or role, if you're the right fit, we're committed to working through the process with you. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. As set forth in Applied Compute’s Equal Employment Opportunity policy, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected group status under any applicable law.

jobs.description: Alignment Health is breaking the mold in conventional health care, committed to serving seniors and those who need it most: the chronically ill and frail. We have built a team of talented and experienced people who are passionate about transforming the lives of the seniors we serve. Working at Alignment Health provides an opportunity to do work that really matters, not only changing lives but saving them. Together. The Principal Artificial Intelligence \& Automation Engineer is a senior subject matter expert responsible for defining and executing the AI and automation strategy that powers Alignment Health’s Medicare Advantage business. across the organization.**Job Duties/Responsibilities** =============================== ### **Set AI \& Automation Strategy Aligned to Medicare Advantage Priorities** * Define and maintain a multi\-year AI and automation roadmap that supports strategic goals in Stars, risk adjustment, payment accuracy, prior authorization, clinical quality, and member experience. * Partner with C\-suite and senior leaders to identify and prioritize high\-ROI use cases where AI and intelligent automation create durable competitive advantage. ### **Drive Intelligent Automation** * Lead the design and Services. * Establish standards and governance for automation development, documentation, and change management to ensure scalability and maintainability. ### **Establish Platforms, Tooling, and Engineering Best Practices** * Own the selection and adoption of AI/ML platforms, cloud services (AWS/Azure/GCP), and automation tools (e.g., UiPath, Power Automate), ensuring they integrate with DTS data platforms and security controls. * Define and enforce engineering best practices, including CI/CD, MLOps, testing, observability, and documentation, that raise the bar for reliability and time\-to\-value across all AI and automation initiatives. ### **Partner Cross\-Functionally to Deliver Measurable Business Impact** * Collaborate with Product, Data Engineering, Clinical Operations, Finance, Compliance, and Security to translate business requirements into technical solutions and track realized value (e.g., cycle time reduction, accuracy improvement, cost\-to\-serve). * Regularly communicate AI and automation strategy, progress, and ROI to senior executives and governance bodies. ### **Embed Responsible AI and Regulatory Compliance** * Work with Legal, Compliance, and Privacy to ensure all AI and automation solutions meet CMS, HIPAA, and internal governance standards. * Implement frameworks for bias detection, model explainability, auditability, and change control, Engineering, including cloud spend, third\-party platforms, and external partners. * Evaluate and manage vendor relationships to ensure investments reflect labor market realities and maximize ROI.
