Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation. **Work you'll do** As a PROJECT \- Data Engineer II on the AI \& Data team, you will be responsible for... * Designing, developing, and maintaining batch and streaming data pipelines that support reporting, analytics, and artificial intelligence use cases * Building and optimizing extract, transform, and load processes using SQL, Python, and data engineering frameworks * Integrating data from structured and unstructured sources across cloud and on\-premises environments * Supporting data quality, validation, monitoring, and issue resolution activities for production data assets * Collaborating with cross\-functional teams to implement data models, improve platform performance, and support client delivery objectives A successful candidate would possess these skills: * Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team * Effective written and verbal communication skills * Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product * Ability to build and sustain professional relationships * Ability to lead projects or workstreams * Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast\-paced and dynamic environment * Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor * Ability to meet deadlines * Ability to provide clear guidance to others **The team** Deloitte's Government \& Public Services (GPS) practice \- our people, ideas, technology and outcomes \- is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, \& local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise. Our AI \& Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting\-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively. The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery\-focused professionals. **Qualifications** Required: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a similar quantitative field * 0\-2 years of experience working in Agile delivery environments * 1\+ years of experience in extract, transform, and load architecture and development * 1\+ years of experience using Python and Structured Query Language to build or support data pipelines * 1\+ years of experience working with relational database management systems * Ability to travel 0\-10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred: * Experience supporting federal, state, or local government clients * Experience with Apache Spark, Databricks, Snowflake, or Apache Airflow * Experience with application programming interfaces and request handling * Experience with Docker * Experience supporting machine learning workflows * Experience with Microsoft Azure SQL Server or Power Platform The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

jobs.title: Product Forward Deployed Engineer (pFDE)-Innovation_Delivery_Transformation
jobs.description: **The Team** ConvergeSPORTS is a product\-driven business combining Deloitte's sports industry experience with proprietary data, AI\-native decision intelligence, and reusable Converge capabilities. We help sports organizations grow revenue, deepen fan engagement, optimize partnerships, and improve commercial performance while operating with the focus of a product company. Our teams work with leagues, teams, venues, rights holders, media organizations, sponsors, and brands across fan data, digital experiences, and commercial analytics. Cross\-functional product teams turn market needs into scalable products and repeatable decision workflows rather than one\-off solutions. **Position Summary** Are you energized by both winning the work and delivering it? As a Product Forward Deployed Engineer on ConvergeSPORTS, you will sit between the market and the product, helping shape data strategy for sports organizations while feeding what you learn in the field straight back into what we build. If you want to be close to clients and close to the product at the same time, we would like to talk with you. Recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/2026\. **Work you'll do** As a Product Forward Deployed Engineer, you will split your time between supporting go\-to\-market for the ConvergeSPORTS portfolio and delivering the work once it is sold, with an emphasis on data strategy and data\-product delivery. Your work will include: * Support product demonstrations and client conversations, translating ConvergeSPORTS data and digital products into a clear business case. * Contribute to go\-to\-market materials such as demo scripts, one\-pagers, and case studies that Sales and Product teams reuse across engagements. * Partner with Product Managers and Market Makers to qualify product fit and help scope delivery engagements. * Deliver client\-facing data work, including data discovery, segmentation, audience definition, and activation support. * Support customer data platform, identity, and audience workstreams alongside Data Engineering and Data Science partners. * Document client workflows, data sources, and integration needs, and turn them into requirements the product team can act on. * Bring field observations back into product development, including gaps, workarounds, and repeated client requests. * Build dashboards and reporting that make delivery progress and client outcomes visible. * Support scope, timeline, and issue tracking across active engagements. The successful candidate would possess these skills: * Comfort being client\-facing and hands\-on in the same week, without needing the boundary drawn for you. * Instinct for distinguishing a genuine product gap from a one\-off client request. * Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and commercial audiences. * Willingness to work in ambiguity on an early\-stage product portfolio and pick up whatever is needed. * Curiosity about how sports organizations actually make commercial and fan\-engagement decisions. **Qualifications** Required: * Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Analytics, Sport Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * 2\+ years of professional experience in data consulting, analytics, delivery, product, or technology implementation. * 1\+ years of hands\-on experience with data tooling, such as SQL, a customer data platform, a CRM platform, or a BI tool such as Tableau or Power BI. * Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred: * Experience in sports, media, or entertainment organizations. * Experience with customer data platform implementation, identity resolution, or audience segmentation. * Experience supporting sponsorship or partnership activation programs. * Hands\-on experience with Python or generative AI application tooling. * Client\-facing consulting or pre\-sales experience. The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. Our teams work with leagues, teams, venues, rights holders, media organizations, sponsors, and brands across fan data, digital experiences, and commercial analytics. Cross\-functional product teams turn market needs into scalable products and repeatable decision workflows rather than one\-off solutions. **Position Summary** Are you energized by both winning the work and delivering it? As a Product Forward Deployed Engineer on ConvergeSPORTS, you will sit between the market and the product, helping shape data strategy for sports organizations while feeding what you learn in the field straight back into what we build. If you want to be close to clients and close to the product at the same time, we would like to talk with you. Recruiting for this role ends on 10/31/2026\. **Work you'll do** As a Product Forward Deployed Engineer, you will split your time between supporting go\-to\-market for the ConvergeSPORTS portfolio and delivering the work once it is sold, with an emphasis on data strategy and data\-product delivery. Your work will include: * Support product demonstrations and client conversations, translating ConvergeSPORTS data and digital products into a clear business case. * Contribute to go\-to\-market materials such as demo scripts, one\-pagers, and case studies that Sales and Product teams reuse across engagements. * Partner with Product Managers and Market Makers to qualify product fit and help scope delivery engagements. * Deliver client\-facing data work, including data discovery, segmentation, audience definition, and activation support. * Support customer data platform, identity, and audience workstreams alongside Data Engineering and Data Science partners. * Document client workflows, data sources, and integration needs, and turn them into requirements the product team can act on. * Bring field observations back into product development, including gaps, workarounds, and repeated client requests. * Build dashboards and reporting that make delivery progress and client outcomes visible. * Support scope, timeline, and issue tracking across active engagements. The successful candidate would possess these skills: * Comfort being client\-facing and hands\-on in the same week, without needing the boundary drawn for you. * Instinct for distinguishing a genuine product gap from a one\-off client request. * Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and commercial audiences. * Willingness to work in ambiguity on an early\-stage product portfolio and pick up whatever is needed. * Curiosity about how sports organizations actually make commercial and fan\-engagement decisions. **Qualifications** Required: * Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Analytics, Sport Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. * 2\+ years of professional experience in data consulting, analytics, delivery, product, or technology implementation. * 1\+ years of hands\-on experience with data tooling, such as SQL, a customer data platform, a CRM platform, or a BI tool such as Tableau or Power BI. * Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve. * Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future. Preferred: * Experience in sports, media, or entertainment organizations. * Experience with customer data platform implementation, identity resolution, or audience segmentation. * Experience supporting sponsorship or partnership activation programs. * Hands\-on experience with Python or generative AI application tooling. * Client\-facing consulting or pre\-sales experience. jobs.title: INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY SPECIALIST I
jobs.description: Job Posting: ASP.NET Web Developer Department of Social Services JC\-533752* ASP.NET Web Developer INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY SPECIALIST I $6,513\.00 \- $10,537\.00 per Month New to State candidates will be hired into the minimum salary of the classification or minimum of alternate range when applicable. **Final Filing Date:** **10/13/2026** **Application Methods:**Electronic (Using your CalCareer Account) By Mail Drop\-off Print Job Save Job ### **Job Description and Duties** If you have a passion to be a part of a team that works to serve, aid and protect needy and vulnerable children and adults in ways that strengthen and preserve families then is this is the place for you! The Information Systems Division works in collaboration with programs and county agencies, to provide solutions to systems that assist families access essentials such as, but not limited to, medical services, care providers, groceries, and transportation. Under direction of the Information Technology Supervisor II, the incumbent acts as a technical lead and developer supporting critical systems for the Disability Determination Service Division (DDSD) and broader California Department of Social Services (CDSS) programs. The incumbent performs full\-life cycle web application development, maintenance, and production support. The incumbent will also provide software testing, resolve any complex technical issues in both modern and legacy mainframe environments, maintain databases, and execute batch processes. The Department of Social Services does not participate in E\-Verify for employment authorization purposes. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship by the start date of employment. If you would like to share how you learned about this career opportunity, please take a moment to complete our brief Recruitment Survey. Need help with applying for positions, taking an examination, or preparing for interviews? Our team is here to support you, reach out anytime at Recruiter@dss.ca.gov. For guidance on applying for a state job, visit Three Steps to a State Job Follow us on LinkedIn to stay updated on our latest opportunities. You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**. ### **Working Conditions** In office requires staff to be assigned to California Department of Social Services (CDSS) 744 P Street, Sacramento, CA 95814\. Position has a hybrid telework schedule which can be subject to change. This work location is very convenient! This location is two blocks from the light rail and public transportation: within walking distance to the State Capitol, parks, restaurants, farmer’s markets and the Golden 1 Arena. Our building has easy access to I\-5, Highway 50, and Highway 80\. This position may be eligible for Hybrid work. jobs.title: Engineering Technician 1
jobs.description: **The Company** Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health. We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing\-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us. **Meet the team:** Founded in 1999, Dexcom, Inc. provides continuous glucose monitoring technology to help patients and their clinicians better manage diabetes. Since our inception, we have focused on better outcomes for patients, caregivers, and clinicians by delivering solutions for people with diabetes \- while empowering our community to take control of diabetes. You will be part of the Operations Global Engineering team, which is tasked with end\-to\-end technical oversight of our manufacturing technologies spanning our suppliers, contract manufacturers, automation \& integration houses, and internal manufacturing. You will bring your passion for the development of complex manufacturing processes, using objective data to integrate cutting\-edge technology into our strategy. As part of this team, you will collaborate closely across multiple functions and activities, gaining broad exposure to our entire product life cycle. You will play a pivotal role in ensuring robust processes are being delivered to our manufacturing sites for new product introduction, capacity expansion, and sustained on\-market performance in support of Dexcom's thrilling growth trajectory in delivering life\-changing products to our valued customers. **Where you come in:** * You will set up and operate laboratory test equipment and instrumentation per released procedures, protocols, or plans. * You will execute and provide feedback on engineering studies for process and test method development. * You will execute qualification protocols with high attention to detail for equipment, processes, and test methods. * You will analyze and record test results, prepare written documentation, communicate findings and recommend solutions. * You will support induction of new equipment and fixtures into Dexcom systems including: writing equipment user requirements, coordinating placement with Facilities, preparing equipment binder documents, and setting up calibration and preventive maintenance schedules. * You will support troubleshooting and diagnosis of process\-related problems, recommend corrective actions, and implement solutions. * You will assist in creating and revising Manufacturing Process Instructions, Test Instructions, and other technical documentation. * You will conduct out of tolerance, out of calibration, and other similar preliminary investigation activities. * You will support acquisition and staging of materials for engineering studies and other manufacturing builds. * You will perform routine verifications of equipment and laboratory areas and report any issues to engineers or supervisors; engage with equipment vendors when external support is required. * You will support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimize process and test methods steps. You will comply with safety, environmental, and quality requirements; highlight safety concerns in the working areas. * **What makes you successful:** * You have strong attention to detail and organizational skills * You have basic computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office applications * You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills * You have commitment to safety and quality standards * You have understanding of manufacturing processes and equipment * You have basic mechanical and electrical skills Additional preferred qualifications: * Able to read and interpret technical drawings and schematics * Experience with PLCs, automated production equipment \& processes, pneumatics, electro/mechanical systems and packaging/ kitting equipment * Proficient in learning new equipment functions, setups, software and tools * Able to read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical documents related to equipment specifications * Technical writing skills as applied to manufacturing documentation and process development * Experience operating precision measurement and inspection systems to verify product dimensions, features, and quality requirements Experience collecting, documenting, and analyzing measurement data for quality control and process verification * **What you’ll get:** · A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave \#dexcomwarriors community . · A full and comprehensive benefits program. · Growth opportunities on a global scale. · Access to career development through in\-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement. · An exciting and innovative, industry\-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve. **Travel Required:** 0\-5% * **Experience and Education** Typically requires a minimum of 0\-2 years of related experience and a High School diploma/certificate or equivalent. * Please note: The information contained herein is not intended to be an all\-inclusive list of the duties and responsibilities of the job, nor are they intended to be an all\-inclusive list of the skills and abilities required to do the job. Management may, at its discretion, assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. The duties and responsibilities in this job description may be subject to change at any time due to reasonable accommodation or other reasons. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions. An Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact Dexcom Talent Acquisition at talentacquisition@dexcom.com. jobs.title: Platform Engineer (Project Hire)
jobs.description: The Platform Engineer is a skilled, independent contributor who designs, implements, and supports core platform and infrastructure capabilities that power magical Disney Experiences across parks, resorts, cruises, and consumer products. You will focus on data pipelines, on\-prem server architecture, observability, and DevOps automation, ensuring robust, scalable, and reliable environments that enable teams to deliver seamless guest and cast experiences. We are seeking an individual to take full ownership of a large\-scale Splunk environment supporting mission\-critical operational and engineering systems. This role will be responsible for managing the entire Splunk ecosystem from the infrastructure layer (bare metal) through application\-level development, in direct support of software engineering teams responsible for complex physical systems and real\-time operations. This is a hands\-on role requiring deep technical expertise across infrastructure, data ingestion, and observability, with a strong emphasis on reliability, scalability, and performance. **Responsibilities** In this role, you will act as a proficient problem\-solver and effective partner to engineering and product teams, owning platform components from design through operations while mentoring colleagues and working with minimal guidance. You will emphasize automation, observability, and lifecycle management platforms to improve reliability, reduce operational toil, and support data\-driven decisions that enhance Disney Experiences worldwide. * Own and manage the full Splunk stack * End\-to\-end responsibility from bare metal infrastructure OS Splunk architecture dashboards and analytics * Design, deploy, and maintain Splunk infrastructure * Install, configure, and optimize Splunk components (indexers, search heads, forwarders, clustering) * Manage both on\-premise/physical server environments and hybrid integrations * Support real\-time operational systems * Enable monitoring and observability for high\-availability, real\-time engineering systems * Build dashboards and alerts used by engineering and operations teams * Develop data pipelines and ingestion strategies * Integrate data from diverse sources (logs, sensors, applications, control systems) * Optimize parsing, indexing, and search performance * Partner with software engineering leadership * Work closely with Software Engineering Managers and system teams * Translate operational requirements into scalable Splunk solutions * Performance tuning and system reliability * Identify bottlenecks across infrastructure and data pipelines * Ensure high availability, redundancy, and system resilience * Security, governance, and access control * Implement role\-based access and data governance best practices * Maintain compliance with enterprise security standards * Continuous improvement * Recommend architecture improvements and modernization strategies * Evaluate tools within the Splunk ecosystem (e.g., ITSI, ES, Cribl, etc.) **Required Qualifications** * 3\+ years of experience with Splunk administration and development * Proven experience owning a Splunk environment end\-to\-end * Strong hands\-on experience with: * Splunk Enterprise architecture (indexers, search heads, clustering) * Data ingestion, parsing, and optimization * Dashboard and alert development * Experience managing on\-prem / bare\-metal infrastructure * Linux administration (preferred) * Server provisioning, performance tuning, and system monitoring * Experience supporting real\-time, high\-availability systems * Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, or similar) **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience supporting engineering, industrial, or operational technology (OT) environments * Familiarity with observability and logging tools beyond Splunk (e.g., Cribl, ELK, Prometheus) * Experience with event\-driven systems, telemetry data, or IoT/sensor integrations * Exposure to high\-throughput environments with large\-scale data ingestion * Splunk certifications (Admin, Architect, or Developer) **Required Education** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical field or relevant work experience The hiring range for this position in Orlando, FL is $92,900 to $124,500 per year. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate’s geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

jobs.title: Desktop Engineer II Full time Days
jobs.description: **Position will support Dolly Children's locations in southeastern TN** ======================================================================= **BASIC PURPOSE OF THE JOB** ============================ Under general supervision, this position will provide technical support for incidents and service requests related to Information Services equipment. Responsible for planning, scheduling, and installation of new hardware and software. Performs tasks that present medium risk to the environment and will analyze and resolve moderately complex problems relating to desktop applications, network connectivity, printers for peripheral connectivity issues, and mobile devices to include smartphones, laptops, and iPads. Will learn assigned systems and gain baseline knowledge of the environment. **REPORTS TO** ============== * Manager, Information Systems Operations **JOB REQUIREMENTS** ==================== **Supervisory Responsibilities:** No **Minimum Education:** High School Diploma **License/Certification** **Required:** None **Minimum Work Experience:** Four years’ experience in Information Technology, Desktop Support, Service Desk, or related field. **REQUIRED KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES** ============================================= * Excellent oral and written communication skills. * Service oriented. * Able to work independently. * Is proactive and makes routine decisions independently. * Must have above average problem\-solving skills. * Excellent organizational, time management and customer service skills. * Proficient in MS Office, Outlook, Excel and PowerPoint and other computer applications. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES** =============================== * Provides support and resolution for basic hardware, network, software, and application problems. * Evaluates and/or escalates calls for urgency, complexity, and organizational impact when technical support and resolution fails. * Responsible for recording all user inquiries, from initial call to incident resolution using our services desk system. * Ensures that the computer environment is secure, clean, and all maintenance and shift turnover procedures are followed. * Ensures that all problems have been assigned to the appropriate individuals for resolution. * Monitors the progress of all service requests including prioritizing and tracking requests assigned to other staff members. * Provides feedback to IT personnel on the use of departmental service agreements and effectiveness of the "first\-call" personnel within client areas. * Provides feedback regarding time, nature, and frequency of client calls. Recommends system modifications to reduce user problems. * Provides excellent customer service and develops client relationships through follow\-up and client contacts. * Helps create and expand the knowledge database through documentation of day\-to\-day problems. * Recommends or continuously adds to and updates procedural and resolution information within the help desk software. * Uses software and hardware pertinent to the detection and resolution of desktop computers and network problems. * Adheres to established department and organizational security policies. * Follows procedures in dealing with violations of security experienced during the work shift. * Performs preventative maintenance as specified by the device manufacturer’s standards. * Ensures all housekeeping and maintenance functions are performed in a timely and scheduled manner. * Communicates effectively with other shifts to ensure a smooth shift transition. **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS** ========================= * Note: Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position. * Light lifting, pushing, and pulling is required for 10\-20 lbs occasionally and frequent moving of objects of less than 10 lbs is required. Frequent sitting with some walking, standing, squatting, bending, and reaching is required. Keyboard/computer use and/or repetitive motions may be required. *Come work where you can make a difference everyday.*

jobs.title: Sr. Director of Product Management - DV Publisher Suite
jobs.description: **Company Overview** ==================== Founded in 2008, DoubleVerify (DV) is the leading independent provider of marketing measurement software, data and analytics that authenticates the quality and effectiveness of digital media for the world's largest brands and media platforms. DV provides media transparency and accountability to deliver the highest level of impression quality for maximum advertising performance by bringing transparency and accountability to the market and ensuring ad viewability, brand safety, fraud protection, accurate impression delivery and audience quality across campaigns to drive performance. DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies across every major vertical, including financial services, telecom, automotive, retail, CPG, travel, luxury and pharmaceuticals gain the most value out of their media spend by delivering best\-in\-class solutions across the digital ecosystem. Let's build a better industry. **Position Overview** ===================== The Sr. Director, Product Management — DV Publisher Suite owns the product strategy, roadmap and delivery for DoubleVerify Publisher Suite, a comprehensive suite of revenue analytics, quality \& performance measurement, and inventory curation tools. DV Publisher Suite customers include some of the most recognized names in media spanning Broadcasters, News, Retailers and Device Manufacturers The portfolio is broad and technically deep. It spans revenue analytics — a suite of tools for all publisher monetisation needs, managing both direct and programmatic datasets, letting clients build reports, dashboards, and forecasts across their entire revenue base– and the Inventory Quality \& Targeting Suite is DVPS's analytics and curation suite that lets publishers discover and prove out their high\-performing, authentic inventory. It measures across the same quality and performance pillars advertisers value. Publishers are a fundamentally different customer than advertisers: different economics, different buying centers, different definitions of success. This role exists to make sure DV builds for them on their terms. You will lead a team of five Product Managers, partner closely with a dedicated publisher engineering organization and a dedicated publisher sales and client support team, and operate as the product leader of a focused, entrepreneurial unit with a single goal — profitable growth in the publisher business. The mandate is ambitious. You will set a multi\-year product vision for how premium publishers monetize in an environment reshaped by streaming, curation, AI\-driven content discovery and continued pressure on open\-web economics. You will make hard portfolio calls about where to invest, where to simplify and where to stop. And you will be accountable for delivery: clear requirements, realistic scope, and products that ship and get adopted. This is a role for a product leader who can innovate against a long\-term vision and a quarterly commercial reality at the same time — who is energized by owning a business, comfortable making decisions with incomplete information, and credible with publishers, engineers and executives alike. **Job Responsibilities** ======================== * Own and be accountable for the DVPS product vision, strategy, roadmap and revenue outcomes across the full portfolio — Revenue Analytics and Inventory Quality \& Targeting product suites * Lead, coach and grow a team of five Product Managers; raise the bar on product craft, customer discovery and delivery discipline, and develop the next generation of product leaders on the team. * Partner with the GM of the Publisher business as the product leader, jointly setting priorities against revenue and customer commitments while owning product strategy and prioritization. * Drive delivery velocity in close partnership with the dedicated Publisher engineering organization; establish clear requirements, make explicit prioritization decisions, and manage scope. * Define and analyze the metrics that determine whether DVPS products are winning — adoption, revenue attach, retention, and publisher\-side yield impact — and use them to reallocate investment. * Own competitive and market position for publisher\-side analytics, delivery and quality; ensure DV remains the best publisher product in market. * Engage directly and frequently with premium publishers and industry bodies, including IAB working groups; represent DV at industry events, standards groups and customer executive reviews. * Coordinate with DV's broader product organization on shared platform capabilities — classification, fraud, measurement infrastructure and reporting — to ensure DVPS benefits from company\-wide investment rather than rebuilding it. * Become the organization's go\-to authority on publisher monetization, sell\-side verification, and the DV Publisher Suite. **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * 10\+ years of total professional experience, including 7\+ years in Product Management. * 3\+ years of people management experience with Product Managers as direct reports, including hiring, performance management and career development. * 3\+ years of product experience in publisher\-side advertising technology — publisher ad servers, order and inventory management systems, header bidding, SSPs, yield management, revenue analytics or programmatic monetization. * Demonstrated ownership of a product line with direct revenue accountability, including the tradeoffs between long\-term platform investment and near\-term commercial commitments. * Track record of leading products from strategy through launch and adoption, including complex platform migrations and modernization of mature products. * Superior data analysis skills; able to personally derive insight and action from data rather than delegating it. * Experience partnering effectively with a distributed engineering organization, including across time zones and cultures. * Excellent written and verbal communication; able to present credibly to executives, to engineers, and to publisher customers. * Organized with rigorous attention to detail and a demonstrated bias toward decisiveness under ambiguity. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Direct experience at a premium publisher, SSP, ad exchange or publisher\-side monetization platform. * Deep working knowledge of media quality measurement — invalid traffic and fraud, brand safety and suitability, viewability, attention — applied to sell\-side use cases. * Familiarity with CTV and streaming supply, and with how premium publishers package and sell it. * Experience building/developing a high\-caliber product team. * Experience with agile development at scale, and with UX partnership on research, prototyping and usability. * Hands\-on SQL and data analysis capability. * B.S. or higher in Computer Science, a quantitative discipline, or equivalent practical experience. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined by a number of non\-discriminatory factors, including qualifications for the role, level, skills, experience, location, and internal equity relative to peers at DV. The estimated salary range for this role, based on the qualifications set forth in the job description, is between $219,000 \- $336,000\. This role will also be eligible for bonus/commission (as applicable), equity, and benefits. The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles and recognize that the person we hire may be more or less experienced than this job description as posted

jobs.title: Co-Op Student Engineering
jobs.description: **Overview:** Draper is an independent, nonprofit research and development company headquartered in Cambridge, MA. The 2,000\+ employees of Draper tackle important national challenges with a promise of delivering successful and usable solutions. From military defense and space exploration to biomedical engineering, lives often depend on the solutions we provide. Our multidisciplinary teams of engineers and scientists work in a collaborative environment that inspires the cross\-fertilization of ideas necessary for true innovation. For more information about Draper, visit www.draper.com. **Job Description Summary:** Engineering Co\-Op Students support the research and development of new or existing systems, hardware and software. The candidate will work with Draper’s Software Engineering Division with the focus on low level software for real\-time embedded systems. This is an excellent opportunity for college students who would like to apply their skills to practical applications. The ideal candidates for this position are enthusiastic about developing infrastructure and application software for resource constrained systems. Domains include sensor, vehicle and infrastructure systems. This internship will be onsite at Draper’s Cambridge, MA campus, with the ability to occasionally work from home.**Job Description:** **Duties/Responsibilities** --------------------------- * Design, develop, and enhancement engineering solutions for challenging problems. * Implement, test, perform analysis, and provide documentation support. * Generate and present test reports including plots, tables, evaluation criteria, and conclusions from data collected and analyzed throughout the test process. * Complete assignments designed to develop a practical knowledge of processes, procedures, equipment, facilities, and systems as well as their interrelationships within engineering disciplines. * Performs other duties as assigned. **Program Requirements** ------------------------ * Enrolled in an accredited engineering curriculum full\-time undergraduate or graduate degree program required. * Co\-op Students must be able to work full\-time for a 6 month period. * There is flexibility regarding hours and program duration based on applicant’s school schedule and availability. **Skills/Abilities** -------------------- * Excellent written and oral communication skills. * Excellent work ethic with the ability to work independently or in a team environment. * Ability to adapt to ever\-changing environments, risks, and vulnerabilities. * Strong computer skills including MS Word, PowerPoint and Excel. **Additional Job Description:** Connect With Draper for Future Opportunities! jobs.title: Technical Business/Product Analyst
jobs.description: About the Organization: **E2 Consulting Engineers, LP (E2\)** is a professional services firm established in 1988 specializing in a full spectrum of engineering services including, project engineering and design, federal base operations and infrastructure support services, gas pipeline construction and inspection services, environmental consulting and remediation, and information technology services. At E2, we value safety, innovation and collaboration, and we are dedicated to excellence. E2M2M® is an AI\-driven field infrastructure platform serving industries including Oil \& Gas, Construction, Civil \& Infrastructure, Electrical Engineering, Renewables, and Telecom. jobs.title: Senior/Staff AI Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **About Echelon** ================= Echelon is building the AI platform for Business Operations. Our goal is to automate the knowledge work of BizOps so one exceptional operator can deliver the leverage of an entire team, as Ramp and Rippling have done for Finance and HR. Our platform combines passive process mining with a living ontology that maps how work happens across people, systems, documents, decisions, and outcomes. It connects structured and unstructured data trapped in fragmented, duplicative, and legacy enterprise systems, then turns that context into automated workflows and AI agents. We are an early\-stage company tackling a difficult technical problem at high speed. Engineers work directly with founders and customers, make decisions with incomplete information, ship production systems, and own the results. The pace, rate of change, and standards are high. **The mandate** =============== Build the secure execution substrate for Echelon's agents. You will scale ephemeral sandboxes, optimize filesystem and startup performance, and make long\-running agent work durable under load without weakening tenant isolation or operational control. **What you'll own** ------------------- * Design and operate sandbox lifecycle systems for agent code execution, browser work, document processing, and tool use. * Improve sandbox startup time, density, scheduling, warm pools, caching, and resource utilization. * Build fast, reliable filesystem primitives for ephemeral and persistent agent state, large artifacts, and concurrent workloads. * Enforce tenant isolation, network policy, secrets boundaries, quotas, and least\-privilege access. * Make long\-running agent jobs durable through checkpointing, retries, idempotency, cancellation, and recovery. * Scale orchestration and control\-plane services through rapid workload growth and unpredictable bursts. * Build observability for resource pressure, execution failures, queue health, noisy neighbors, cost, and end\-to\-end latency. * Run load tests, capacity plans, failure drills, and incident reviews; fix root causes rather than adding fragile workarounds. **What you bring** ------------------ * 5\+ years building production infrastructure, distributed systems, developer platforms, or execution runtimes. * Hands\-on ownership of containerized or virtualized workloads in a multi\-tenant production environment. * Strong Linux systems knowledge across processes, filesystems, networking, resource isolation, and performance debugging. * Experience with Kubernetes or a comparable scheduler, infrastructure as code, and cloud primitives on AWS or Azure. * Strong programming ability in Go, Rust, TypeScript, Python, or another systems\-oriented language. * Experience designing for retries, idempotency, backpressure, load shedding, observability, and safe rollouts. * Security instincts appropriate for executing untrusted or model\-generated work. **Useful experience** --------------------- * Firecracker, gVisor, Kata Containers, namespaces/cgroups, seccomp, or eBPF. * Sandbox products such as E2B, Modal, Fly Machines, or custom ephemeral compute platforms. * FUSE, overlay filesystems, content\-addressed storage, snapshotting, distributed caches, or object storage. * Agent runtimes, code interpreters, browser automation, remote development environments, or CI execution systems. * BYOC, private networking, customer\-managed deployments, or enterprise security reviews. * Inngest, Temporal, Kafka, NATS, or other durable workflow and event systems. **Benefits** ============ * **Team lunches and dinners in the office.** * **On\-site Gym access for all employees.** * **Fully covered health, dental, and vision insurance.** * **401(k) plan.** * **Access to AI Tooling of your choice.** * **Unlimited PTO.** Compensation Range: $180K \- $250K

jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
jobs.description: **Job Summary:** The Assistant Project Manager supports Project Managers in the total management of projects assigned to the Electrical Division, including planning, budgeting, scheduling, customer interaction, and internal reporting and coordination. The Assistant Project Manager carries substantially the same responsibilities as a Project Manager but, given less tenure and experience in the role, works under the close supervision of a Project Manager on all project requirements. Position offers career path to Project Management. **Essential Responsibilities:****Project Execution \& Coordination:*** Support the Project Manager in the successful execution of assigned commercial electrical construction projects from pre\-construction through closeout, ensuring work is delivered on schedule, within scope, and within budget. * Assist with developing project scopes, objectives, schedules, and detailed project plans; monitor progress against key milestones and deliverables. * Coordinate with Project Managers, Foremen, Superintendents, Engineering/CAD teams, and other project stakeholders to support efficient day\-to\-day project execution. * Help identify, track, and resolve project issues, escalating significant concerns to the Project Manager, Project Supervisor, or Superintendent as appropriate. * Provide concise and timely project reporting to support project accountability and decision\-making. **Project Documentation \& Administration:*** Manage and maintain accurate project documentation, including submittals, RFIs, change orders, transmittals, correspondence, and other project records using applicable project management systems and software. * Support the development and review of shop drawings and coordinate with Engineering/CAD teams to facilitate timely approvals. * Apply appropriate processes and controls to help manage changes to project scope, schedule, and cost. **Scheduling, Materials \& Procurement:*** Assist with maintaining project schedules, tracking milestones, and coordinating daily activities with electrical Foremen and other field personnel. * Track procurement and material deliveries to ensure materials are ordered, received, and available at the jobsite when needed for construction. * Verify that materials and equipment meet contract specifications, quality requirements, and project needs. * Assist with managing vendors, subcontractors, and manufacturers to support timely and efficient project execution. **Cost Management \& Billing:*** Assist with monitoring project costs, reviewing job cost reports, and identifying variances or potential cost concerns. * Support the preparation of quarterly job projections, forecasts, and other project financial reports using appropriate cost analysis techniques. * Assist with timely monthly billing, including tracking percent complete and supporting negotiations with clients regarding progress billing. * Support the preparation, pricing, negotiation, and processing of change orders with clients and other project stakeholders. **Client \& Subcontractor Relationships:*** Support the Project Manager in maintaining strong, professional relationships with clients and project stakeholders. * Communicate professionally and collaboratively with subcontractors, vendors, manufacturers, engineers, architects, and clients. * Assist in addressing and resolving project\-related issues while maintaining positive working relationships and a focus on project objectives. **Risk, Safety \& Compliance:*** Assist with identifying and managing project risks and implementing appropriate actions to minimize potential impacts to cost, schedule, quality, and project delivery. * Support the development of Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs) and other required safety documentation. * Assist with the management and oversight of M/W/DBE requirements and other applicable project compliance obligations. **Field \& Construction Support:*** Work closely with the Foreman to discuss and help resolve daily project and construction issues, escalating matters when appropriate. * Support coordination between field operations and project management to ensure construction activities remain aligned with project plans, schedules, and client requirements. * Assist with coordinating resources and supporting effective allocation of labor, materials, equipment, and other project resources. * Help ensure timely communication of field conditions, changes, constraints, and other issues that may affect project performance. **Required Qualifications:*** Education \& Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Construction Management, Electrical Engineering, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant industry experience. * Relevant Experience: 2–5 years of experience in electrical construction, commercial construction, project engineering, or a related field. * Technical Knowledge: Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, blueprints, specifications, and schematics. * Project Coordination: Working knowledge of project scheduling, cost tracking, procurement, change management, submittals, RFIs, billing, and project documentation. * Computer Skills: Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and Outlook. * Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate professionally with clients, field personnel, subcontractors, vendors, engineers, architects, and other stakeholders. * Organization: Strong organizational and time\-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks, meet deadlines, and manage changing priorities in a fast\-paced construction environment. * Problem Solving: Ability to identify project issues, gather relevant information, develop practical solutions, and escalate matters appropriately. * Professionalism \& Integrity: Demonstrated honesty, integrity, accountability, sound judgment, and a commitment to quality and project success. * Relationship Management: Ability to work collaboratively and maintain professional relationships with clients, colleagues, subcontractors, vendors, and other project stakeholders. * Field Requirements: Ability to visit active construction sites, attend project and progress meetings, and travel locally as required. * Work Environment: Ability to work effectively in both an office and active construction\-site environment. **Preferred Qualifications:*** *Experience with* \*commercial electrical construction\*\* and familiarity with electrical contracting practices, means and methods, and project delivery processes. * *Experience with construction management and project documentation platforms such as* \*Procore, Bluebeam, or similar software\*\*. + Experience with project cost control, forecasting, job projections, change orders, and progress billing. + Familiarity with construction scheduling software and project management tools. + Experience coordinating vendors, subcontractors, material procurement, and jobsite logistics. + Familiarity with M/W/DBE requirements and other construction contract compliance requirements. * *Experience preparing or supporting* \*Job Hazard Analyses (JHAs)\*\* and other construction safety documentation. * Demonstrated ability to work under the direction of a Project Manager while progressively taking on greater responsibility and developing toward independent project management.

jobs.description: **Position Summary** The Senior Systems \& Network Engineer is responsible for the administration, maintenance, security, and optimization of the organization’s servers, networks, cloud platforms, cybersecurity tools, and associated infrastructure. This role serves as an advanced escalation point for complex technical issues and participates in infrastructure projects, technology deployments, and strategic initiatives. The ideal candidate brings broad technical expertise across systems administration, networking, Microsoft cloud technologies, cybersecurity operations, and troubleshooting. The position requires the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams, vendors, software providers, and business stakeholders. **Key ResponsibilitiesInfrastructure Administration** · Administer Windows servers and related infrastructure. · Manage virtualization platforms and virtual workloads. · Administer Microsoft 365 services and configurations. · Administer Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID. · Manage enterprise backup systems and support recovery activities. · Monitor platform health, capacity, performance, patching, and availability. **Network Administration** · Manage firewalls, security policies, and supporting configurations. · Administer virtual private network connections and remote\-access services. · Manage wireless infrastructure and troubleshoot connectivity issues. · Coordinate ISP troubleshooting and service restoration. · Administer WAN and SD\-WAN connectivity. · Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot network switches. **Cybersecurity Operations** · Perform security monitoring and review alerts. · Support vulnerability identification, prioritization, and remediation. · Administer endpoint protection platforms. · Perform and document access reviews. · Support incident investigations and response activities. · Apply infrastructure security standards and recommended practices. **Project Engineering** · Execute infrastructure upgrades and modernization activities. · Support technology deployments and store openings. · Implement new technologies in coordination with business and technical stakeholders. · Plan and perform system migrations and integrations. · Validate deployments, document changes, and support operational handoff. **Escalation Support** · Receive and manage escalations from HRC Tier 1\. · Diagnose and resolve advanced technical issues. · Coordinate with vendors, software providers, and service providers. · Perform root cause analysis and recommend corrective action. · Communicate issue status, impact, resolution, and follow\-up requirements. **Documentation Ownership** · Maintain current network documentation and diagrams. · Maintain system runbooks and operational procedures. · Create support procedures and knowledge articles. · Maintain disaster recovery documentation. · Review and improve knowledge base accuracy and usability. **Qualifications or Required Experience** · Five or more years of progressively responsible experience supporting business infrastructure and network environments. · Hands\-on experience administering Microsoft cloud and on\-premises technologies. · Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex systems, network, identity, cloud, backup, and security issues. · Experience coordinating technical work with vendors and external service providers. **Education** · Associate degree in information technology, computer science, information systems, or a related field preferred. · Equivalent relevant work experience may be considered in place of formal education. Technical Competencies **Platforms \& Infrastructure** **Networking \& Security** Microsoft 365 Firewalls and VPN technologies Active Directory and Entra ID Switching, wireless, WAN, and SD\-WAN Windows Server Security monitoring and vulnerability management Virtualization platforms Endpoint protection solutions Backup and disaster recovery platforms Advanced diagnostic and root cause analysis **Preferred Certifications** · Microsoft Azure or Microsoft 365 certification · CompTIA Network\+ or Security\+ · Cisco CCNA · VMware certification · Fortinet or comparable firewall certification · Other relevant infrastructure, cloud, networking, or cybersecurity certification **Professional Attributes** · Strong analytical, diagnostic, and troubleshooting skills. · Clear written and verbal communication. · Strong documentation habits and attention to detail. · Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently. · Professional customer service and stakeholder coordination. · Composure and sound judgment during outages and security events. · Commitment to continuous technical learning and improvement. **What We Offer** · Competitive compensation based on experience and qualifications. · Professional development, certification, and training opportunities. · Exposure to modern infrastructure, cloud, networking, and cybersecurity technologies. · A collaborative environment with opportunities for increased technical responsibility and career advancement. · Challenging work that directly supports business operations and growth. Pay: From $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Flexible schedule * Health insurance Experience: * Network engineering: 7 years (Required) Ability to Commute: * Thomasville, GA 31757 (Required) Ability to Relocate: * Thomasville, GA 31757: Relocate before starting work (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer I
jobs.description: **Senior Site Reliability Engineer** Are you passionate about building resilient, scalable systems that power mission\-critical applications? Do you thrive on automating operations, improving reliability, and ensuring exceptional system performance? **About the team:** Embedded Innovation Teams are cross\-functional squads embedded within our segments to rapidly turn internal AI experimentation into validated, reusable solutions, building the capabilities we need to deliver customer value and growth. We work problem\-first rather than tool\-first, directly inside segment and function teams, improving the internal workflows that help our people deliver better outcomes for customers, faster. **About the role:** As a **Senior Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)** , you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, scalability, and performance of our critical platforms and services. You will lead complex reliability initiatives, drive automation efforts to reduce operational toil, and help build resilient systems that deliver exceptional customer experiences. You will leverage your expertise in observability, incident response, and distributed systems to proactively identify and resolve reliability challenges. Working closely with engineering teams, you will design and implement solutions that improve service availability, streamline operations, and enhance system recovery capabilities. You will hold a high bar on code quality, flag risks and blockers early, and work alongside host\-function stakeholders to make sure what you build fits real workflows, not assumed ones. You will also support handover and capability\-building so the solution is owned and operable after the squad moves on. **Key Responsibilities:** * Creating monitoring queries and establishes service level baselines. * Supporting senior engineers during incidents. * Making contributions during post\-mortems and RCAs. * Participating in disaster recovery tests. * Implementing automation and executes code in production environments. * Contributing to SRE knowledge documentation. * Supporting the deployment, monitoring, and reliability of services integrating AI tools. * Supporting architecture and senior engineers in the creation of infrastructure topology drawings and deployment workflows. * Carrying out the testing of availability, reliability, and recoverability in non\-production environments. **Requirements:** * **Advanced Terraform:** Expertise in modules, providers, state management, lifecycle controls, drift detection, safe refactoring, and remote state (S3, locking, cross\-stack dependencies). * **AWS Operations:** Hands\-on experience managing production, multi\-account, multi\-region AWS environments across ECS, RDS, ALB, VPC, IAM, Route53, ECR, S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, Secrets Manager, KMS, and CloudWatch. * **GitHub Actions CI/CD:** Experience building and troubleshooting reusable workflows, OIDC authentication, approval gates, runners, Terraform deployments, application deployments, and migration pipelines. * **ECS Fargate \& Containers:** Knowledge of Docker, ECR, ECS task definitions/services, IAM roles, health checks, autoscaling, ALB integration, and deployment rollbacks. * **AWS Networking \& Security:** Proficiency in VPCs, networking, ALBs, Route53, ACM/TLS, IAM, OIDC, Secrets Manager, KMS, and cloud security best practices. * **Incident Response \& Observability:** Skilled in troubleshooting using logs, metrics, alarms, deployment history, root cause analysis, rollback decisions, and operational runbooks. * **Linux \& Automation:** Strong Linux and Git fundamentals with Bash/Python scripting for AWS CLI automation, CI/CD, and operational tooling. * **AI Tooling Deployment:** Hands\-on experience integrating and operating AI services and APIs in production, including monitoring, reliability, and security practices for AI\-powered features. * **Developer Enablement:** Ability to support multiple engineering teams, troubleshoot across infrastructure and application layers, document solutions, and enable secure self\-service practices. jobs.title: QAQC Manager
jobs.description: **Job Summary** The QA/QC Manager is responsible for leading and managing quality assurance and quality control programs across assigned projects, business operations, fabrication activities, and field execution environments. This position ensures that work is performed in accordance with company quality standards, customer specifications, contract requirements, applicable codes, and operational expectations while promoting workmanship excellence, consistency, and continuous improvement. The QA/QC Manager serves as the operational leader for quality execution and is responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining quality systems, inspection programs, testing protocols, documentation standards, and corrective action processes that support successful project delivery and customer satisfaction. This role partners closely with Project Management, Superintendents, Operations Leadership, Engineering, Prefabrication, Safety, and customers to proactively identify quality risks, reduce rework, improve operational performance, and strengthen overall project outcomes. The position provides leadership and oversight for QA/QC personnel, field inspections, turnover documentation, audits, and quality performance initiatives while ensuring quality expectations are embedded throughout project planning, procurement, fabrication, installation, commissioning, and project closeout activities. The QA/QC Manager plays a key role in driving accountability, operational discipline, and a culture of quality across assigned operations and projects. **Essential Functions, Duties, and Responsibilities** **Tasks may include, but are not limited to the following:** * Lead and manage quality assurance and quality control programs across assigned projects, business units, fabrication operations, or field activities. * Develop, implement, and maintain project and operational quality plans, inspection procedures, testing requirements, and quality documentation standards. * Provide leadership, direction, and oversight for QA/QC Coordinators, Specialists, Technicians, Inspectors, and project\-based quality personnel. * Coordinate inspections, testing activities, commissioning support, and turnover requirements to ensure compliance with contract specifications and company quality standards. * Conduct and oversee quality audits, field observations, and compliance reviews to verify workmanship and operational consistency. * Lead investigations related to nonconformance issues, customer concerns, rework events, and quality deficiencies while implementing corrective and preventive actions. * Monitor and analyze quality metrics, punch list trends, turnover performance, inspection findings, and rework data to drive continuous improvement initiatives. * Partner with Project Managers, Superintendents, Engineering, and Operations Leadership to proactively address quality risks and execution challenges. * Support customer inspections, owner reviews, engineer evaluations, and third\-party testing or compliance activities. * Ensure quality documentation, inspection records, testing reports, and project closeout packages are completed accurately and maintained in accordance with project and company requirements. * Develop and support quality training, field coaching, and workforce development initiatives related to quality expectations and workmanship standards. * Provide quality reporting, project status updates, and strategic recommendations to Operations and Quality Leadership. **Knowledge, Skills and Abilities** **Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:** * Strong knowledge of quality assurance and quality control principles, inspection practices, and continuous improvement processes. * Working knowledge of electrical construction methods, fabrication processes, commissioning activities, and project execution practices. * Knowledge of applicable construction codes, specifications, contract requirements, and regulatory standards. * Ability to interpret drawings, specifications, testing procedures, and technical documentation. * Strong leadership and employee development skills with the ability to build accountability and performance within quality teams. * Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills with the ability to investigate and resolve complex quality issues. * Ability to manage multiple projects, priorities, and deadlines in fast\-paced operational environments. * Effective communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to influence field teams, customers, and leadership stakeholders. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and construction, project management, and quality reporting systems. * Ability to lead change, drive operational improvement, and promote a culture of quality and continuous improvement. **Supervisory Responsibilities** * Provides leadership, direction, and oversight for QA/QC Coordinators, Specialists, Technicians, Inspectors, and project\-based quality personnel. * Responsible ety, or project management certifications are preferred and may include: o OSHA 30\-Hour Construction Safety certification or equivalent safety training o Certified Quality Engineer (CQE), Certified Quality Auditor (CQA), or related quality certifications o Quality Management, Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement certifications o Commissioning, testing, or inspection\-related certifications as applicable o Project Management Professional (PMP) or related project leadership certifications considered beneficial * Electrical industry, construction, or trade\-related certifications are considered advantageous. * Valid driver’s license with the ability to maintain insurability under company standards may be required based on travel and operational responsibilities. * Additional customer, project\-specific, safety, commissioning, or site\-required certifications may be required depending on assigned work locations and business needs. **Experience Requirements:** * Minimum of 7 years of progressively responsible experience in quality assurance, quality control, construction operations, electrical construction, commissioning, manufacturing, or related technical environments required. * Minimum of 3 years of leadership, supervisory, or quality program management experience preferred. * Demonstrated experience developing, implementing, or managing quality assurance and quality control processes, inspection programs, or operational quality initiatives. * Experience supporting commercial, industrial, mission critical/data center, manufacturing, or complex construction projects preferred. * Strong working knowledge of construction drawings, specifications, contract jobs.description: **About Flow** -------------- Flow Engineering is an AI\-native requirements platform for modern engineering organizations, enabling hardware teams to collaborate with AI agents to design, validate, and evolve complex systems with speed and rigor. **About the role** ------------------ Flow is seeking full stack senior software engineers to build AI\-powered capabilities that help teams author, review, and manage requirements more effectively. You will work on agentic systems engineer and agentic domain engineer workflows—bringing AI into the center of how teams reason about their systems. This role sits at the intersection of AI, product, and full\-stack engineering: you will take ideas from prototype all the way to stable, observable features in production. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Design and ship AI\-powered features such as assisted requirement drafting, consistency checks, impact analysis, and intelligent suggestions for systems and domain engineers. * Build agentic workflows that help “agentic systems engineers” and “agentic domain engineers” explore designs, simulate changes, and validate requirements. * Evaluate and integrate language models and related tooling, optimizing for reliability, latency, cost, and debuggability in production. * Build and maintain the surrounding infrastructure: data pipelines, evaluation harnesses, prompt and model management, observability, and safety/guardrails. * Work across the stack—from backend integrations and APIs to simple UI hooks—to deliver complete AI features, not just model endpoints. * Partner patterns). * Familiarity with prompt design, retrieval\-augmented systems, evaluation methods, and safety/guardrail approaches. * Ability to reason about tradeoffs between different models, architectures, and deployment patterns and make pragmatic decisions. * Comfortable working in a high\-ownership, fast\-paced environment where experiments and iteration are the norm. **Our stack (AI\-leaning)** --------------------------- * TypeScript/Node.js and Python for AI and backend services. * Modern LLM APIs and orchestration libraries for building agentic workflows. * Postgres and other managed cloud services for data and state. **How we work \& values** ------------------------- * Speed over everything: prototype AI workflows quickly, then harden what works. * Own, downscope, ship, iterate: one clear owner per feature, from prototype to production. * Fundamentals done well: evaluation, observability, and safety are part of the first version, not an afterthought. *
