As a Quantitative User Experience Researcher (Quant UXR), you make this possible. You will join a multi\-disciplinary team, collaborating closely with Engineering and Product Management to create industry\-leading, innovative products. You will drive impact at all stages of development by investigating user behavior through empirical methods like logs analysis, survey research, and regression. We value diverse educational experiences—from Computer Science to Psychology—and require a blend of behavioral research design, statistical proficiency, and programming skills to uncover actionable insights. Beyond the work, you will grow within a supportive Quant UXR community offering mentorship, regular meetups, and exclusive internal tools to help you thrive. As part of the Google.org Tech for Social Impact team, you will accelerate sustained social impact through technology. You will support Google.org and the wider ecosystem of nonprofits and civic entities through data infrastructure, data visualization tools, and products that help them accomplish their missions. You will unify Google.org’s data and operational workflows into a single, trusted source of truth across global giving, and enable Google.org global pillars and leadership to track and maximize the organization's overall philanthropic impact. You will achieve this by designing impact surveys deployed to Google.org funding recipients and partners, developing validated outcome scales, and performing statistical analysis of survey results to inform Google.org’s reporting initiatives. User experience is at the forefront of how we create intuitive, innovative, and beautiful products that people love. We strive to learn and understand our users’ needs, behaviors, and emotions to gather insights that inform product strategy and design. Our UX teams include designers, researchers, content strategists, and engineers who are passionate about quality, usability, and simplicity. We work on collaborative teams to solve complex challenges and craft experiences that highlight our products’ unique capabilities and personalities. Our work touches billions while exemplifying a key principle that is core to Google’s philosophy: “Focus on the user and all else will follow.”Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $132000 \- $189000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Define and measure quantitative UX goals and metrics in collaboration with Designers, Qualitative Researchers, Data Scientists, Engineers and Program Managers. * Develop code and statistical models to understand user experience. * Conduct empirical research using methods from computer science, quantitative social science, statistics, econometrics, and other fields to understand user behavior and extract meaningful patterns from large data sets. * Examine existing data and product designs to generate hypotheses and plans for high\-impact research. * Prioritize and drive research to improve user experience. Communicate findings to stakeholders in the company. Make research findings convincing and actionable for both research experts and non\-experts. jobs.title: Applications Engineer
jobs.description: **Are you passionate about matching water technology solutions to real\-world engineering challenges?** Then join us in our mission to pioneer smarter solutions for moving and transforming water, reducing energy consumption, and enhancing quality of life for people. As our new **Applications Engineer**, you will be providing expert technical guidance on product selection, system design, and application optimization to ensure Grundfos solutions meet the precise needs of customers and projects. You'll be part of a diverse, supportive and inclusive culture, that celebrates our differences and puts people first by fostering growth, well\-being, and a sense of belonging. **What you will be doing:** As a key part of the Applications Engineering team, you'll create impact by bridging the gap between customer requirements and Grundfos technology to deliver reliable, energy\-efficient solutions that advance sustainable high\-purity water solutions worldwide. Your main responsibilities include: * Evaluate customer inquiries, specifications, and operating requirements to define the technical and commercial scope of proposed high\-purity water treatment solutions. * Develop conceptual system designs and perform preliminary engineering calculations to support equipment sizing, selection, and estimating. * Prepare detailed cost estimates and identify value\-engineered alternatives that optimize system performance, cost, and overall customer value. * Research and evaluate equipment and component options based on technical suitability, availability, lead time, and pricing. * Explore innovative approaches to customer application challenges and recommend practical, technically sound solutions. * Partner with Sales to determine the best path forward for Grundfos\-proposed solutions and align the technical and commercial strategy presented to the customer. * Participate in customer meetings, including pre\-bid discussions, bid reviews, and technical\-clarification meetings, to provide technical support alongside Sales. * Prepare and deliver comprehensive technical and commercial turnover packages to Project Management, Engineering, and Manufacturing. * Lead technical review and turnover meetings to communicate project requirements and confirm the scope of supply with downstream teams. **What makes you a great fit:** Above all, you are a technically sharp engineer with strong customer\-facing communication skills and a genuine enthusiasm for solving complex high\-purity water system challenges. We would also imagine that you have: * A Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, or a related discipline * A minumim of 5\+ years of experience in applications engineering, technical sales support, or system design. * Strong understanding of high\-purity water treatment processes, system hydraulics, sanitary design principles, and high\-purity water\-quality requirements. * Proficiency with engineering selection and sizing tools and ability to read technical drawings and specifications It is a plus if you also have: * Experience with Grundfos product lines or comparable water technology platforms * Familiarity with building services, water utility, or industrial process applications * Professional Engineer (PE) license or working toward certification The salary range for this position is $ 70,000\.00 \- $94,000\.00 per year. Individual pay will be determined based on market location and the candidate’s profile. The range listed is just one component of the total compensation and benefits package for employees. Total compensation includes paid time off, paid holidays, merit increases, bonuses, and employee stock purchase programs, etc. The salary rates are benchmarked and reflect the target for new hire salaries for the position in this region. Why you will love working here: * A working environment built around your needs, with flexible hours, home working opportunities and parental support. * Annual bonuses, health insurance and a strong focus on well\-being activities. * Three days' additional paid leave for volunteering in your community. * Access to on\-demand training and learning sessions and carefully structured programs to pursue personal and professional development opportunities. To get to know us better, follow us on LinkedIn or YouTube. Check out Meet our people to get to know some of your future colleagues and why they love working at Grundfos. Qualified candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment\-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. If you require an accommodation to complete your application or interview, please contact hrservices@grundfos.com. We are committed to providing a fair and accessible hiring process. jobs.title: Control Law Systems Engineer II
jobs.description: Date: Sep 29, 2026 Location: Savannah, GA, US Company: Gulfstream Aerospace Corporation Employment Type: Full\-time **Control Law Systems Engineer II in GAC Savannah** **Unique Skills:** **Control Law Systems Engineer II** **WHY WE NEED YOU** The Flight Sciences division is responsible for the development and certification of Gulfstream Flight Control Laws and Automated Guidance Systems—complex, safety\-critical systems that require rigorous validation and verification to ensure performance, reliability, and regulatory compliance. We are seeking a **Control Law Systems Engineer focused on Validation \& Verification (V\&V)** to join our Flight Dynamics team in Savannah, GA. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring control law system requirements are correct, complete, and properly verified in accordance with SAE ARP4754A processes. You will work across a highly cross\-functional environment, partnering with Systems Engineering, Flight Controls, Software, Test, Flight Operations, and external stakeholders to validate requirements, define verification strategies, and support certification activities, including FAA audits. **WHAT YOU’LL DO** * Author, review, and validate **control law system\-level requirements** in IBM DOORS * Ensure **complete requirements traceability** (aircraft system software) * Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to ensure requirements are **clear, testable, and technically accurate** * Develop and execute **verification strategies** using multiple methods: * + Test bench (flight control computer / unit\-level testing) + Linear and nonlinear analysis + Hardware\-in\-the\-loop (HIL) and integrated “ironbird” testing * Design and execute **test procedures and verification cases** * Participate in **system integration, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis** * Identify gaps in requirements, test cases, or procedures and **drive corrective actions** * Generate **verification reports, analysis reports, and certification artifacts** * Support **FAA certification activities and System Design Reviews (SDR)**, including: * + Audit preparation and execution + Demonstrating compliance to ARP4754A processes + Disposition of verification or process deviations * Contribute to continuous improvement of **V\&V processes, tools, and methodologies** **WHAT YOU BRING** * Bachelor’s degree in Aerospace, Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or related field * 18 months of related Engineering experience. Experience credit will be considered for related advance degrees limited to 2 years for Master's and 4 years for PhD in a field applicable to the job position. * Experience in **requirements\-based development, validation, and verification** * Hands\-on experience with **IBM DOORS (or equivalent requirements tools)** * Experience writing or executing **test plans, procedures, and reports** * Familiarity with **system integration and verification environments** * Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills * Ability to work independently and collaboratively in cross\-functional teams * Excellent technical communication skills **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience with **flight control systems or control law architectures** * Familiarity with **SAE ARP4754A development processes** * Knowledge of **DO\-178C and DO\-331** * Experience with **hardware\-in\-the\-loop or system integration labs (ironbird)** * Background in **linear or nonlinear system analysis** * Experience supporting **FAA certification efforts or audits** * Familiarity with **Matlab/Simulink** for analysis or verification support * Experience troubleshooting verification discrepancies and implementing fixes **WHAT SETS YOU APART** * Strong ownership mindset over **requirements quality and verification completeness** * Ability to identify gaps or inconsistencies and proactively implement solutions * Comfort working in structured, certification\-driven engineering environments * Attention to detail combined with big\-picture system awareness **Education and Experience Requirements** ----------------------------------------- Bachelor's Degree Engineering or a related curriculum required or equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to perform the essential functions of the job. 18 months related Engineering experience. Experience credit will be considered for related advance degrees limited to 2 years for Master's and 4 years for PhD in field applicable to the job position. **Position Purpose**: Performs engineering work related to the investigation and the solution of technical problems associated with research, design, development, service and manufacture of Gulfstream aircraft. **Job Description** ------------------- Principle Duties and Responsibilities: Essential Functions: * Solves typical engineering problems within assigned discipline . * Provides technical assistance to engineering staff and contributes to completion of project milestones . * Responsible for a complex engineering assignment, or a full project of lesser complexity . * Follows established schedules while developing plans for engineering assignments . * Obtains appropriate level of supervisor approvals for work accuracy and adequacy . * Proficiently applies company/organization policies and procedures . Additional Functions: * Actively works to improve daily processes, and ensures all work meets customer requirements . * Maintains a current and up\-to\-date knowledge of developments and application of technical principles, theories, and concepts in assigned field of expertise . Perform other duties as assigned. Other Requirements: * The level of technical skills and abilities appropriate for this grade will be established by each discipline. * Applies knowledge to provide solutions to a variety of technical problems of moderate scope and complexity, using a combination of judgment with defined practices and procedures. * Failure to achieve results, or erroneous decisions or recommendations, may cause delays in program schedules and/or allocation of additional resources. * Ability to convey technical concepts in both written and verbal formats. * Contacts are primarily within the organization, with occasional customer contacts on routine issues. * Works under general supervision for routine tasks of minor complexity. * With supervision/mentorship, can coordinate the activities for lower level engineering staff. This job requires one to be able to read, write, speak, and understand the English language. **Additional Information** Requisition Number: 234036 Category: Engineering Percentage of Travel: Up to 25% Shift: First Employment Type: Full\-time Posting End Date: 10/23/2026 Equal Opportunity Employer / Individuals with Disabilities / Protected Veterans Gulfstream does not provide work visa sponsorship for this position, unless the applicant is a currently sponsored Gulfstream employee. Gulfstream Aerospace Corporation, a wholly\-owned subsidiary of General Dynamics (NYSE: GD), designs, develops, manufactures, markets, services and supports the world's most technologically\-advanced business jet aircraft **Nearest Major Market:** Savannah **Job Segment:** Systems Engineer, Compliance, Controls Engineer, R\&D Engineer, Testing, Engineering, Legal, Technology

Responsibilities * Design, develop, test, and maintain control software for gas turbine and power generation systems. * Translate customer requirements, P\&IDs, process narratives, and control diagrams into DCS/PLC control logic and HMI functionality. * Develop and modify control logic, sequencing, monitoring, alarms, and operator interfaces. * Support turbine performance, efficiency, startup, shutdown, and protection control algorithms. * Participate in software and control\-system design reviews with customers, project managers, and engineering teams. * Develop and execute software validation and functional testing. * Support Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT), including testing with simulation or closed\-loop environments. * Troubleshoot control\-system and software issues and identify root causes. * Support equipment commissioning, startup, field testing, and customer troubleshooting. * Work with mechanical, electrical, controls, software, and project engineering teams. * Prepare technical documentation, test procedures, and engineering deliverables. * Provide technical support and training to customers and field\-service personnel when required. Required Qualifications * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field. * 5\+ years of experience in controls engineering, control software, industrial automation, or related engineering. * Strong understanding of control systems, automation, and control theory. * Experience with DCS, PLC, HMI, or SCADA systems. * Experience developing or modifying industrial control logic. * Experience with PID/control algorithms, sequencing, interlocks, alarms, and instrumentation. * Programming experience in one or more of C, C\+\+, Python, MATLAB, or similar languages. * Experience with industrial communication protocols such as Modbus, OPC, Ethernet/IP, Profibus, or similar. * Ability to read and interpret P\&IDs, control diagrams, and engineering specifications. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to work effectively with engineering, customers, and cross\-functional teams. Preferred Qualifications * Direct experience with gas turbine controls or turbine control systems. * Experience with gas turbine governor/control systems. * Experience with turbine startup and shutdown algorithms. * Experience with hydraulic valve positioners, servo systems, LVDTs, or related turbine instrumentation. * Experience with hydraulic trip and overspeed protection systems. * Experience with turbine vibration monitoring systems. * Experience with lube oil, control oil, turning gear, or related turbine auxiliary systems. * Experience with gas turbine simulation and closed\-loop testing. * Experience with FAT, commissioning, startup, and field support. * Experience in power generation, energy, or industrial automation. * Familiarity with SAMA diagrams and control\-system design methodologies. * Willingness to travel for customer support, commissioning, or testing as required. Pay: $55\.00 \- $80\.00 per hour Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Applied AI
jobs.description: **About the company** ===================== Headstart is built for people who want to think like founders. We work inside real enterprises ($100M\+ ARR), shipping production AI systems that change how they operate. Every engagement is a different industry, problem, and set of constraints. We're bootstrapped, cash\-flow positive, and growing fast, and we're building our own platform to deliver truly agentic systems. **Why join us** =============== Enterprise clients bring us messy, high\-stakes problems, often with no clear picture of what the AI system should be. Our engineers work out what to build, build it, and run it in production. Most of the time, they're the experts in the room. This role is part player, part coach, part staffing partner. Most of your time stays on a client engagement, hands\-on, close to the work and to where engineers get stuck. You'll manage a group of engineers across a few engagements and grow with the team as we do. **Level:** Reports to the Head of Engineering. You run a team inside our system: you apply the bar, keep your engineers growing, and stay close to the work. **What you'll own** =================== * **Your engineers.** Manage engineers up to senior, hold a high bar, and give direct, actionable feedback. Coach on execution and help strong engineers step up toward tech lead. * **Technical leadership.** Review architecture, agent, prompt, and eval design on your engagements. Step into hard technical and client situations, like production regressions and unclear requirements, and make the call. Raise trouble early, while it's cheap to fix. * **Engagement delivery.** Run the engagement\-level relationship with clients and their stakeholders, alongside product and client partners, so each engagement lands. * **Staffing.** Manage transitions on your team, plan ahead, and flag risks before they reach a client. Escalate conflicts across engagements to the Head of Engineering. * **Hiring.** Interview, calibrate, close, and onboard new engineers against the bar the Head of Engineering sets. * **Practice.** Follow the team's practices and tell us what isn't working. Bring patterns you see to the wider team so they can become standing practice, and make sure your engineers use what exists. **Your background** =================== * 3\+ years managing engineers, with real experience giving feedback and developing people. * 5\+ years in software engineering, deep enough to review designs and challenge the team's approach. Hands\-on with Python. * Experience delivering software in real client environments. * Curious about agents, evals, and multi\-agent systems, with a sense of where they're reliable and where a person needs to take the wheel. Fluent with AI coding tools. Depth matters more than prior title. **Bonus:** management experience in a consulting, services, or forward deployed engineering organization, or experience taking a team or practice from zero to one. **How we work** =============== High trust, high agency, low ego. We push back when something isn't right and share what we learn, so good instincts spread fast. * **We are our first client.** We built Friday, our coding agent, and Statum, our knowledge infrastructure, and we run them on ourselves. * **AI\-first, human\-accountable.** Agents write nearly all our client code. Every output is reviewed, and the person is accountable. * **Partners, not a vendor.** You're in the room when hard calls get made, and you're expected to have a point of view. * **Breadth that compounds.** You'll see more industries and problems in a year than most people see in a career. * **Weekends are yours.** Pay is transparent, and we don't confuse long hours with good work. **What to expect** ================== * **Initial screen (30 min):** with our recruiting partner. * **Technical screen (30 min):** a short, real\-world coding exercise with an engineer. * **Hiring manager interview (45 min):** behavioral and past work. * **Technical interviews (2\.5 hrs, two sessions):** coding and systems design. Use AI tools in the coding interview, since it reflects how we work. * **Case study (75 min):** a live, scenario\-based discussion covering staffing, feedback, technical review, and closing the loop. No prep needed. **What we offer** ================= * Base salary of $285,000 USD plus competitive equity * 401k with 4\.5% employer match, and fully covered medical, dental, and vision premiums * Monthly wellness stipend, Citi Bike, and pre\-tax commuter benefits * 12 weeks parental leave, with an optional 4\-week ramp\-up at 50% * Loft office in Soho with lunch and snacks * Hybrid in NYC. We're open to fully remote candidates in the US or Canada. Compensation Range: $285K

jobs.title: AVP IAM & Governance
jobs.description: Our Mission: **Our mission is to SAVE AND IMPROVE LIVES BY EMPOWERING HEALTHCARE CONSUMERS.****Come be part of remarkable.** Overview: **How You Can Make a Difference** ================================= The AVP, Identity \& Access Management, the enterprise authority on identity — the architect, evangelist, and operational owner of an identity\-first security model in which identity is the control plane for a cloud\-first, zero trust enterprise. This leader defines and executes a multi\-year B2E IAM strategy spanning identity governance and administration (IGA), privileged access management (PAM), customer and workforce access management, non\-human/machine identity, and identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and is accountable for the engineering rigor, control effectiveness, and audit posture of the entire identity fabric. This is a role for a practitioner\-leader and recognized thought leader: someone who has designed and operated identity programs at scale, who is fluent in modern identity standards and protocols (OAuth 2\.0, OIDC, SAML 2\.0, SCIM, FIDO2/WebAuthn), who can whiteboard an authorization model one hour and defend a control posture to auditors and executives the next, and who actively shapes the direction of the identity discipline — inside the organization and in the broader industry — through published points of view, standards engagement, and community leadership. **What You’ll be Doing** ======================== * **Identity Strategy \& Thought Leadership:** + Own and evangelize a multi\-year AI led identity strategy and reference architecture that treats identity as the primary security perimeter, aligned to zero trust principles (NIST SP 800\-207\) and enterprise business objectives. + Serve as the organization's most senior voice on identity: publish internal position papers and architectural decision records, brief executive leadership and the Board on identity risk, and represent the company externally through industry forums, standards bodies, conference speaking, and peer communities. + Anticipate and translate emerging shifts — decentralized identity, verifiable credentials, passwordless/phishing\-resistant authentication, AI\-agent and workload identity, continuous access evaluation (CAEP/Shared Signals) — into pragmatic roadmap decisions with clear build/buy/retire rationale. * **Organizational Leadership:** + Build, lead, and mentor a high\-performing team of IAM architects, engineers, and analysts; establish engineering career paths, on\-call/operational maturity, and a culture of automation\-first identity operations. + Operate identity as a product: define OKRs and SLOs for identity services (provisioning latency, certification completion, authentication availability, orphaned\-account rates), and manage a prioritized backlog with IT, HR, Legal, Compliance, and business\-line stakeholders. * **Identity Governance \& Administration (IGA):** + Architect and operate the full identity lifecycle — joiner/mover/leaver (JML) automation driven by authoritative HR sources, birthright provisioning, SCIM\-based downstream integration, and deprovisioning SLAs measured in minutes to hours. + Design and mature the enterprise access model using Agentic AI capabilities: role engineering and role mining, RBAC evolving toward attribute\- and policy\-based access control (ABAC/PBAC), segregation\-of\-duties (SoD) rulesets, and risk\-based, evidence\-quality access certifications that eliminate rubber\-stamping. + Own governance of entitlement sprawl across SaaS, IaaS, and on\-prem estates, including cloud infrastructure entitlement management (CIEM) and least\-privilege enforcement in AWS/Azure environments. * **Authentication, Authorization \& Directory Architecture:** + Set the enterprise standard for authentication: phishing\-resistant MFA (FIDO2/WebAuthn), passwordless adoption, adaptive/risk\-based authentication, and session management policies calibrated to data sensitivity. + Own federation and SSO architecture (SAML 2\.0, OIDC/OAuth 2\.0\), token security and lifetime strategy, and conditional access policy design across the enterprise application portfolio. + Govern jobs.title: Project Engineer – New Graduate (June 2027)
jobs.description: At Henderson, We're About More Than Just Buildings We're about the people, experiences, and longevity of a building. We’re a company of problem\-solvers and innovators known for our technical excellence and ability to provide come up with out\-of\-the\-box solutions when it comes to design and construction. We love the process of bringing buildings to life – and keeping them in shape long after the doors open. As an ESOP, each of our employee\-owners are an essential part of our mission to lead the industry in innovation, sustainability, and client experience. With a vision to build a better world, Team Henderson has a people\-first culture and diverse portfolio of world\-class facilities. It's What We Do We provide total building system design and construction services across multiple high\-growth markets throughout the country for industry leaders. You'll get to use your talent to work on projects for some of the biggest names in mission\-critical, higher education, sports, healthcare, grocery, restaurant, and retail within the sectors we serve in business, community, grocery, health, retail, and venue. It's How We're Different We're about more than just buildings. We're about you. You, and the hundreds of passionate employee\-owners who make us who we are. We’ve always been committed to providing an inclusive workplace where people can bring their full self to work and helps people reach their full potential – both as professionals and individuals. Together, we provide dream\-up innovative solutions for our clients industry\-wide problems, design and construct spaces that become landmarks, and toast the good life at our happy hours. Take a peek into what makes us different here: https://youtu.be/AIt17t\_uJ\-A?si\=oSMy5zQeUcb\_faE3 About This Opportunity This opportunity is specifically intended for upcoming college graduates who will be available to begin full\-time employment in June 2027\. Henderson Building Solutions is seeking individuals ready to start their careers in construction project management as Project Engineers. This entry\-level opportunity provides hands\-on experience supporting construction projects while learning from experienced professionals across project management, field operations, scheduling, safety, and preconstruction. Position Summary The Project Engineer performs routine aspects of field coordination, project management, and cost engineering in support of mission critical construction projects, with a focus on data centers. Working under close supervision, the Project Engineer applies basic engineering and construction principles while gaining hands\-on experience in the delivery of complex, fast\-paced projects. The Project Engineer works closely with project teams and various departments to learn the fundamentals of construction project management, site operations, scheduling, safety, preconstruction, and cost management. They will support projects through coordination with clients, trade partners, engineers, and other project stakeholders while developing professional relationships and building their knowledge of the mission critical construction industry. This position is intended as an entry\-level opportunity for individuals to gain foundational experience across multiple aspects of managing a construction project. Duties, project assignments, and travel requirements may vary based on project needs. Key Role Responsibilities * Assist Project Managers with logistical tasks, including budgeting and client management. * Attend meetings, both internal and external when called upon by the primary construction manager. * Assist in updating and maintaining the project management software. * Assist in the assembly and distribution of equipment and construction bid packages. * Works closely with the project team monitoring the safety, cost and scheduling of construction projects. * Coordinate materials and change orders and expedite material on the job. * Coordinate with clients to understand project requirements. * Assist in the oversight of project design and deliverables, collaborating with project staff in preparing contract documents such as drawings and specifications. * Assist in the preparation of monthly pay applications and monitoring project financial status. * Maintain thorough documentation and updated project folders. * Coordinate with engineers and other professionals to ensure project alignment. * Monitor and document project progress and alert construction managers of any issues that arise. * Implement effective time management strategies to optimize workflow. * Record meeting notes and distribute as needed. * Research contractors for the project bid process. * Contact subcontractors to obtain project documents. * Process contractually required documentation, including certificates of insurance, daily logs, RFIs, change order requests, etc. * Contact clients regarding service quality and client satisfaction and obtain reference letters and testimonials for mar red. * Ability to work in a collaborative environment and to recommend and analyze pragmatic solutions for clients. * Possesses efficient communication skills. * Adaptable to changing work environments, work priorities and organizational needs. * Generates ideas for improvement, takes advantage of opportunities, suggests innovations. * Ability to prioritize and execute multiple tasks in a dynamic environment. * Must demonstrate proficiency in all core competencies as described and characterized in this job description. Work \& Physical Environment * Travel requirements will vary depending on assignment. * Ability to work varying shift times depending on the project, i.e., night or weekends. * Ability to constantly move, traverse, navigate, ascend, descend, position oneself, etc. throughout worksites and precarious areas. * Prolonged periods of sitting or standing at a desk and working on a computer. * Ability to read, write and communicate in English. Let's Talk Perks We take care of our people. As a Henderson employee, you'll enjoy some pretty awesome perks. Trust us, your friends will all have work envy. Culture * Flexible Work Hours (Because we all need to balance work and life.) * Casual Dress Code (Be yourself, please.) * Paid Volunteer Time (We literally pay you to volunteer.) * Paid Parental Leave (Because we know both parents deserve to be there for a new child.) * Health and Wellness Initiatives (Get Fit and Stay Fit.) * Receptive and Forward\-Thinking Leadership (Our doors are always open.) * Clear Career Path Options (We want you to excel.) Benefits * Industry\-leading 401K match and profit sharing (When the company succeeds, we all share in that success.) * Employee Stock Ownership Plan (Yes, our employees are the owners.) * Paid Training for Professional Development (We’ll pay for the time you take getting better at what you do.) * Performance Bonuses (When you do well, we reward you for your work.) * Comprehensive and Extensive Insurance (We’ve got you covered.) * Paid Term Life and Disability (We’ve got your family covered, too.) * Health Savings Account \& Flexible Spending Accounts (We'll help you take advantage of tax savings.) * Paid Time Off and Sick Time off (Take a break. You deserve it!) * Financial Wellness \& Coaching Program (Financial security makes you a happier team member.) More information can be found here \- https://www.hendersonengineers.com/careers/. Henderson Engineers, Inc. and Henderson Building Solutions are EEO Employers/Vet/Disabled and participate in the E\-Verify program. Applicants for positions with Henderson Engineers/Henderson Building Solutions must be legally authorized to work in the United States, and verification of eligibility will be required at the time of commencement of employment. All offers will be contingent upon completion of the hiring process including verifications and background checks as required for employment. To All Recruitment Agencies Henderson does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms or agencies. Any resume submitted to any employee of Henderson without a prior written search agreement will be considered unsolicited and the property of Henderson. Please, no phone calls or emails. **NOTICE TO CANDIDATES:** RECRUITMENT FRAUD ALERT Henderson representatives conduct all email communications exclusively through a company email address that ends with @hendersonengineers.com, @hendersonbuilding.com. We extend offers of employment only after a comprehensive interview process and will never ask you for a payment of any sort nor offer one for any reason. Henderson will not ask any applicant to purchase equipment, nor offer to reimburse any applicant for expenses incurred prior to employment. We will not request personal information until a legitimate offer of employment has been extended. If you suspect a recruitment attempt is fraudulent, you should cease communications. All legitimate job opportunities are posted on our company website’s careers page.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: Hilltop Holdings is looking for a Senior Data Engineer! The Senior Data Engineer is a key technical leader responsible for the design, maintenance, and optimization of enterprise data systems across on\-premises and cloud environments. This hybrid role combines traditional DBA responsibilities with advanced engineering work in Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric. The ideal candidate brings deep experience in database administration, data platform modernization, and cloud\-based architecture, particularly in leading on\-prem to Azure migrations. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field preferred. Combination of equivalent relevant work experience and high school diploma or GED required. * 7\+ years of experience as a Database Administrator or Data Engineer. * 2\+ years of hands\-on experience with Azure Data Services * Experience leading on\-prem to Azure migrations. * Experience with replication tools: Qlik Attunity, Shadowbase, SQL log shipping * Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric, including Lakehouse and Data Warehouse workloads. * Strong T\-SQL skills and knowledge of indexing, partitioning, and query optimization. * Experience with CI/CD, scripting, and automation in PowerShell, Python, or Azure DevOps. * Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and documentation skills. * Highly motivated individual with strong sense of ownership. * Must be proactive with solid organizational and time management skills. * Exceptional written and verbal skills. **\*Must be eligible to work in the U.S. without sponsorship now or in the future.\*** *The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by individuals in, or assigned to, the above position and are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties and skills required, and may be changed at the discretion of the Company.* **Traditional DBA Responsibilities:** * Administer, monitor, and maintain high\-availability SQL Server environments (OLTP/OLAP). * Perform daily operational DBA tasks: backups, restores, index maintenance, integrity checks, performance tuning, and job management. * Implement and manage HA/DR solutions (AlwaysOn, failover clustering, log shipping, etc.). * Troubleshoot database performance issues using tools like SQL Profiler, Query Store, and DMVs. * Enforce database security, compliance policies, user access controls, and role\-based permissions. * Maintain documentation for data systems, configurations, and standard operating procedures. * Maintain db replication: Qlik Attunity, Shadowbase, SQL Log Shipping * Understanding of dimensional modeling concepts. **Cloud Data Engineering (Azure):** * Maintain Azure SQL, Azure Synapse, and Azure Data Lake environments. * Execute on\-prem to Azure migration projects, including re\-platforming, data replication, and testing. * Optimize cost, performance, and scalability of cloud\-based data solutions. * Implement monitoring and alerting across cloud environments using tools like Azure Monitor and Log Analytics. * Participate in the deployment and configuration of Microsoft Fabric for enterprise data workloads. * Ensure compatibility between legacy systems and Fabric components to support unified analytics. * Collaborate with data architects to modernize data platforms and contribute to data governance initiatives. **Collaboration \& Leadership:** * Work cross\-functionally with Data Architects, BI Developers, and Infrastructure teams. * Mentor junior engineers and provide peer reviews for code, queries, and processes. * Act as SME for database infrastructure and cloud architecture in planning and strategy sessions. * Maintain awareness of industry best practices and emerging trends in data engineering.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Engineer, Reinforced Learning
jobs.description: **About The Role** ------------------ As a Fullstack Engineer at Hippocratic AI, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of AI\-powered healthcare voice agents through the development of our Generative AI SaaS products. You’ll work across the entire technology stack—front\-end and back\-end to deliver intelligent, voice\-first healthcare solutions that are safe, scalable, and transformative. This is a highly collaborative role where you will partner with AI researchers, product managers, designers, and healthcare professionals to translate complex requirements into performant, secure, and accessible digital experiences. From crafting seamless mobile interactions to building robust APIs and designing user\-facing dashboards, your work will directly impact the way patients and providers engage with AI in clinical and consumer health settings. We’re looking for experienced engineers who are passionate about innovation, thrive in fast\-paced environments, and are eager to apply their full stack skills to solve real\-world healthcare challenges with cutting\-edge AI technologies. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Architect and scale mission\-critical B2B SaaS products using TypeScript, React, Material UI, and Python/Flask to power seamless, AI\-driven clinical voice experiences. * Partner with cross\-functional engineering teams to deliver high\-performance, cross\-platform mobile apps using Flutter and React Native. * Translate complex healthcare needs and business vision into elegant, production\-ready technical architecture alongside PMs, designers, and domain experts. * Build highly available, reusable front\-end and back\-end frameworks that elevate system performance and deliver intuitive user journeys. * Champion engineering excellence by conducting high\-impact code reviews, mentoring peers, and establishing modern development standards. * Evaluate and integrate cutting\-edge AI tools and technologies to keep our product suite ahead of industry benchmarks. * Proactively diagnose and resolve complex technical bottlenecks to guarantee maximum reliability and operational uptime. * Drive rapid iteration and continuous delivery within an agile framework across sprint planning, stand\-ups, and retrospectives. **Location Requirement** ------------------------ We believe the best ideas happen together. To support fast collaboration and a strong team culture, this role is expected to be in our Menlo Park office five days a week, unless otherwise specified.. **What you’ll bring** --------------------- ### **required** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field. * 5\+ years of professional experience as a full stack developer, with a focus on Typescript/React, and Python, Ruby, or Node backends. * Experience building RESTful APIs and integrating with third\-party services. * Proficiency in database design and management using SQL and Postgres databases. * Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) * Strong problem\-solving skills and the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, collaborative environment. * Excellent communication skills and the ability to effectively collaborate with cross\-functional teams. * Familiarity with agile development methodologies such as Scrum or Kanban. ### **Preferred:** * Experience developing and publishing cross platform mobile applications using Flutter, ReactNative, or native iOS/Android SDKs * Professional experience with Flask Python servers * Knowledge of Terraform with AWS services If you are a talented full stack developer with a passion for user\-facing experiences, innovation, and a desire to work on cutting\-edge B2B products, we encourage you to apply and join our dynamic team at Hippocratic AI. Please submit your resume and portfolio showcasing your relevant experience and contributions. We look forward to hearing from you! **Why Join Hippocratic AI** --------------------------- **Reinvent healthcare with AI that puts safety first.** We’re building the world’s first healthcare‑only, safety‑focused LLM — a breakthrough platform designed to transform patient outcomes at a global scale. This is category creation. **Work with the people shaping the future.** Hippocratic AI was co‑founded by CEO Munjal Shah and a team of physicians, hospital leaders, AI pioneers, and researchers from institutions like El Camino Health, Johns Hopkins, Washington University in St. Louis, Stanford, Google, Meta, Microsoft, and NVIDIA. **Backed by the world’s leading healthcare and AI investors.** We recently raised a $126M Series C at a $3\.5B valuation, led by Avenir Growth, bringing total funding to $404M with participation from CapitalG, General Catalyst, a16z, Kleiner Perkins, Premji Invest, UHS, Cincinnati Children’s, WellSpan Health, John Doerr, Rick Klausner, and others. **Build alongside the best in healthcare and AI.** Join experts who’ve spent their careers improving care, advancing science, and building world‑changing technologies — ensuring our platform is powerful, trusted, and truly transformative. **Equal Opportunity** --------------------- Hippocratic AI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a team that reflects the patients we serve. We actively encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds. If you require accommodations during the hiring process, please contact people@hippocraticai.com. ***Please be aware of recruitment scams impersonating Hippocratic AI. All recruiting communication will come from @******hippocraticai.com*** ***email addresses. We will never request payment or sensitive personal information during the hiring process.***

jobs.title: Technical Business Analyst
jobs.description: About HireRight: HireRight is a leading global provider of technology\-driven workforce risk management and compliance solutions. Providing comprehensive background screening, verification, identification, monitoring, and drug and health screening services for approximately 37,000 customers across the globe. HireRight offers services via a global platform that tightly integrates into customers’ human capital management systems enabling highly effective and efficient workflows for workforce hiring, onboarding, and monitoring. In 2024, HireRight screened over 60 million job applicants, employees, and contractors for our customers and processed over 120 million screens. Overview: We are looking for a detail\-oriented Business Analyst to document, analyze, and improve technical and operational workflows across our organization. This role will work closely with product managers, software engineers, operations teams, SMEs, and leadership to capture how systems and processes function today and translate that knowledge into clear documentation, workflows, requirements, and process maps. The ideal candidate is highly organized, technically curious, and capable of understanding complex systems without needing to be a software engineer. Strong communication skills and the ability to interview stakeholders, identify gaps, and create structured documentation are critical. This role is especially well\-suited for someone who enjoys untangling operational complexity, documenting tribal knowledge, and helping organizations scale through better process clarity. Responsibilities: * Document technical and operational workflows across multiple departments for use in software design and automation. * Interview subject matter experts (SMEs), operations staff, and engineering teams to gather requirements and process details * Create process maps, SOPs, swim lane diagrams, decision trees, and workflow documentation * Analyze existing workflows to identify inefficiencies, gaps, bottlenecks, and automation opportunities * Translate business processes into clear functional requirements for software and AI systems * Organize and maintain centralized documentation repositories * Work with product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure documentation remains accurate as systems evolve * Assist with process standardization initiatives * Support implementation of AI\-driven workflow and operational automation initiatives * Support backlog refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization activities * Create executive\-friendly summaries and presentations explaining operational processes and proposed improvements Qualifications: * **Qualifications** + 2\+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Process Analyst, Operations Analyst, or similar role + Strong experience documenting workflows and business processes + Excellent written communication and organizational skills + Experience working in an agile environment + Experience creating: + - Process maps - Requirements documentation - Workflow diagrams - User stories or operational documentation + Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders + Strong attention to detail**Preferred** + Experience documenting legacy systems or operational modernization projects + Experience in regulated industries such as: + - Aviation - Healthcare - Background screening - Financial services - Compliance\-heavy environments + Basic understanding of APIs, integrations, databases, and software development processes**Ideal Candidate Traits** + Naturally curious and investigative + Comfortable asking detailed follow\-up questions + Structured thinker who enjoys organizing complexity + Strong listening and synthesis skills + Able to balance precision with practicality + Self\-directed and comfortable operating in fast\-moving environments What do we offer: **Please submit resume/CV in English.** **All resumes are held in confidence. Only candidates whose profiles closely match requirements will be contacted during this search.** **HireRight does not accept unsolicited resumes through or from search firms or staffing agencies. All unsolicited resumes will be considered the property of HireRight and HireRight will not be obligated to pay a placement fee.**

jobs.title: Sr Cloud Application developer - Azure I C# I Microservices
jobs.description: Honeywell Aerospace Technologies has been a leading provider of Navigation, Display systems, Flight Controls and Flight Management Systems, developing a broad and scalable portfolio of hardware and software products that provide differentiation and value for a wide range of aircraft configurations. We continue to lead the industry with Advanced Cockpit solutions and Integrated Avionics systems. Our Aviation Industry's 1st Cloud\-Connected "always\-on" Integrated Cockpit system, featuring cloud\-native communications, navigation, and surveillance systems, powered by a flexible software platform that can be customized for virtually every type of aircraft, from passenger planes and business aircraft to defense, general aviation and the rapidly emerging class of Advanced Air\-Mobility (AAM) vehicles. We are seeking an Sr. Advanced Software Engineer to join our development team in building the next generation Avionics SaaS tools to enable our users to build and integrate their critical applications within their aircraft systems. The product you will be designing and developing is a distributed, event\-driven, microservices platform. You will leverage your skills to develop features within a containerized and decoupled microservices architecture. In this role, you will design, build, test, and deployment of new features leveraging DevOps continuous delivery practices. You will be coached and mentored by senior engineers to you grow your software engineering skills through relevant and challenging on the job opportunities. **You will work out of our Phoenix, AZ location on a Hybrid work schedule. No relocation offered.**

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **\*\*\*This position is located on site in Alpharetta, GA OR El Paso, TX.\*\*\*** **A Brief Overview** The Senior Full Stack Engineer is a senior individual contributor who combines selective hands\-on software development with technical delivery leadership, architecture, and systems integration. This role reports to the CTO and partners with Program Management, Product Managers, third\-party development firms, DBAs, platform/system administrators, and L\&D. This person will help define technical direction, oversee the delivery of software components built by third\-party development partners, and selectively build or enhance application and backend components where needed. The role also includes AWS solution architecture, enterprise systems integration, data ecosystem design, quality and release participation, and helping establish new agentic workflow capabilities. **What you will do** * Leads technical delivery of software components and applications built by third\-party development firms. * Provides technical direction and collaborates on specifications, design reviews, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and release readiness. * Manages delivery at a high level, including timelines, dependencies, cross\-team coordination, and critical path awareness. * Designs and selectively builds or enhances full\-stack solutions, including React and React Native front ends and backend services/APIs. * Defines AWS target architecture, technical patterns, service selection, and secure integration approaches, then hands implementation to third\-party cloud developers. * Validates delivered AWS environments and configures cloud components within them as needed. * Designs and supports integrations across enterprise systems and data platforms, including ERP, CRM, Snowflake, Postgres/RDS, and S3\. * Ensures applications, integrations, and data pipelines are robust, scalable, secure, observable, fault\-tolerant, and, where appropriate, self\-healing. * Helps establish and deploy agentic workflows and workflow\-based automation. * Contributes to DevOps, test strategy, release management, and production support. **Qualifications** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, or a similar technical field preferred. * Master's Degree in Computer Science, or a similar technical field preferred. * 4\-6 years full stack software engineering experience required. * 4\-6 years back end and cloud engineering experience required. * 4\-6 years experience designing AWS\-based solutions and selecting appropriate cloud services and integration patterns required. * 1\-3 years strong experience with Node.js/TypeScript, Python, Java/Spring, APIs/microservices, and event\-driven architecture required. * Experience with React and exposure to or experience with React Native required. * Familiarity with AWS services such as Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, RDS, DynamoDB, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Step Functions, EventBridge, and Secrets Manager. * Strong understanding of enterprise systems integration, data flows, interoperability, and data pipeline reliability. * Experience with DevOps and delivery tooling such as GitHub, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Jira/Confluence, CI/CD, and Docker. * Experience with software testing practices, including test strategy, automated testing, integration testing, regression testing, UAT, and performance/security testing. * Strong communication and collaboration skills across product, engineering, operations, and third\-party teams. * Experience with enterprise internal platforms, SaaS products, mobile applications, data\-heavy applications, workflow automation, or regulated environments. * Experience with agentic workflow or AI\-enabled orchestration platforms. * Familiarity with Terraform or Infrastructure\-as\-Code concepts from a design perspective. **Compensation** We are committed to offering competitive and equitable compensation. Final salaries will be determined based on factors such as geographic location, skills, education, licenses, certifications, and/or experience. In addition to these factors – we believe in the importance of pay equity. We consider internal and external factors as a part of every final offer. We also offer a generous total compensation and benefits package. **Benefits** A competitive salary is only one part of your total rewards. We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, including paid time off, medical, dental, life and disability insurance, HSA/FSA accounts, retirement, rewards programs, and so much more! launch * Employ numerical analyses to better interpret and predict poorly understood physical phenomena * First principle research, including bibliographic searches and technology scouting * Assist meaningful technical solutions Personal qualifications: * Excellent communication skills in English (verbal, written, and presentation) * Strong technical leadership skills with the ability to motivate and mentor team members * Work well in progressive team environment * Strong time and project management skills, and ability to delegate tasks and projects Husky TechnologiesTM offers a competitive compensation and benefits package and excellent opportunities for growth and advancement. jobs.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
jobs.description: **POSITION SUMMARY** The Senior Cloud Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing and maintaining Azure\-based cloud infrastructure for IFG Companies while ensuring adherence to security best practices and compliance requirements. The ideal candidate will lead the design, implementation and governance of secure, scalable cloud environments in Microsoft Azure. The candidate must be highly motivated, with excellent communication skills and advanced expertise in building CI/CD pipelines and deployment environments. The candidate must be able to implement solutions in a timely, self\-directed manner with little oversight. **POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDING:** * Architecting, designing, deploying and managing robust, scalable, secure and high\-performance Azure infrastructure solutions aligned with enterprise standards and business goals. * Developing and enforcing cloud security architecture, best practices and operational controls across Azure environments, including identity, networking, data protection and monitoring, in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and industry frameworks (e.g., CIS and NIST CSF). * Driving automation, infrastructure as code (IaC), governance and standardization of infrastructure deployments using Terraform and Azure DevOps. * Developing and managing CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or related tools. * Configuring development, test and production environments and automating deployments, environment provisioning and configuration management. * Supporting containerization and orchestration using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS). * Developing internal tools and dashboards for project monitoring, resource optimization and performance tuning. * Staying current with Azure innovations and recommending improvements to architecture and practices. * Optimizing cloud cost, performance and resource utilization through proactive monitoring and capacity planning. * Representing the Azure infrastructure and security domain in strategic planning sessions and technology steering committees. * Administering and configuring core Azure services (e.g., Azure VMs, VNets, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Azure Monitor, Azure Defender, Key Vault, Azure Policy) using Terraform as the standard infrastructure\-as\-code tool. * Developing and maintaining documentation related to system configuration, processes and procedures. * Supporting disaster recovery and business continuity initiatives. * Performing other duties as requested. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES** * Deep technical knowledge and experience with complex technology environments, including applications, middleware, on\-premises and cloud storage, networks, information security and operations. * Proficiency in the use of infrastructure monitoring tools and a firm understanding of Zero Trust methodologies and technologies and how they relate to Azure services. * Advanced understanding of Microsoft Azure services (e.g., App Services, Azure Functions, Azure Storage, AKS, Azure Networking). * Proficiency with Git source control and Git branching strategies. * Proficiency in building pipelines and deploying solutions for Azure Cloud services, such as Azure Functions, API Management, Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), App Service, Azure SQL and Azure Cosmos DB. * Proven ability to work independently, identify areas for improvement, research innovative solutions and implement new methods and technologies. * Strong scripting skills in PowerShell, Bash or Python. * Proficiency with at least one Integrated Development Environment (IDE), such as Microsoft Visual Studio or Visual Studio Code. * Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with individuals at all levels of the organization, including senior executives. * Strong organizational skills, with an ability to manage multiple timelines and complete tasks quickly within the constraints of project timelines and budgets. * Growth mindset and demonstrated willingness to learn new skills, technologies and frameworks. * Deep technical expertise across Azure IaaS, PaaS, networking, identity, monitoring and automation. * Proven experience designing and securing enterprise\-scale Azure environments. * Solid understanding of compliance requirements in regulated industries (e.g., finance, healthcare, government). **EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND CERTIFICATIONS** * Required: a bachelor's degree from an accredited college/university in computer science, information systems or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience. * Required: at least 10 years of experience in cloud infrastructure engineering, with 7\+ years focused on Microsoft Azure. * Preferred: relevant Azure certifications (e.g., AZ\-104, AZ\-500 or AZ\-305\). * Preferred: property/casualty insurance industry experience. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS** * Physical demands are considered those of a climate\-controlled office environment with minimal physical exertion. * The position is hybrid and requires the ability and the willingness to work in an IFG Companies office at least three (3\) days per week. * The position requires prolonged sitting, extensive utilization of computers and interactions with others in person and via phone. * The position requires the ability and the willingness to travel as required to meet business needs. **SALARY AND BENEFITS** The salary range for this position is $160,000 to $210,000\. Additionally, the position may be eligible to earn incentive compensation. IFG Companies offers competitive compensation and benefits, currently including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), flexible spending, short\-term and long\-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, vacation and other paid time off. **WHY IFG COMPANIES** Founded in 1985, IFG Companies is one of the oldest privately held insurance groups in the United States. It combines a specialty carrier focus with long\-term stability and thinking, while promoting a culture of underwriting rigor, collaboration, strategic thinking, superior technology and strong producer partnerships. **EQUAL OPPORTUNITY** IFG Companies is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status or any other protected characteristic under applicable law. *Please note that all current openings at IFG Companies are published through our IFG Companies Careers, and legitimate recruiting correspondence will be sent from an email address ending in @**ifgcompanies.com**. If you receive a job offer or recruitment communication that you suspect may be fraudulent, please contact us directly to verify its legitimacy. We will never require payment or request sensitive personal information as part of our recruitment process. Safeguarding candidate information and maintaining your trust are priorities for us, and we are committed to providing a secure and respectful hiring experience.*

jobs.title: Security Integration Engineer
jobs.description: **We're Hiring: Systems Integration Engineer** Location: Victor, NY Full\-Time IK Systems is seeking a Systems Integration Engineer to configure, integrate, and commission enterprise security and low\-voltage systems for mission\-critical clients. This role serves as the technical bridge between field installation and advanced enterprise configuration, ensuring that video management, access control, intrusion, and supporting server and network infrastructure operate reliably before customer handoff. ### **What You'll Do** * Configure and integrate video management, access control, intrusion, intercom, and analytics platforms with underlying server and network infrastructure. * Implement system configurations, including user and group structures, permissions, alarm rules, recording schedules, event workflows, and reporting within approved design standards. * Validate engineering designs and submittals, ensuring bills of material, drawings, and configurations align with project scope and performance requirements; identify and escalate discrepancies as needed. * Collaborate with Field Deployment Engineers to bring devices online, complete system commissioning checklists, and transition projects from installation to full system operation. * Perform advanced system testing, including end\-to\-end functional tests, failover and redundancy tests, and performance tuning to ensure stability and reliability. * Troubleshoot complex issues escalated from the field using logs, diagnostics, and vendor tools to drive problems to root cause and permanent resolution. * Configure and support server and network components related to integrated systems (e.g., Windows Server, virtual machines, basic routing and switching, VLANs, firewall rules) within established design guidelines. * Maintain accurate and current system documentation, including IP addressing schemes, database information, configuration backups, logical diagrams, and as\-built records. * Coordinate with Project Managers on cutovers, migrations, and go\-lives, including occasional after\-hours work to minimize customer impact. * Provide training and knowledge transfer to Field Deployment Engineers, Technicians, and customer stakeholders on system operation, workflows, and basic troubleshooting. ### **What You Bring** **Education and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * 5\+ years of combined experience with low\-voltage systems, IT infrastructure, or security system deployment, including at least 3 years focused on configuration, integration, or commissioning. **Skills** * Strong working knowledge of IP networking concepts (TCP/IP, subnets, VLANs, basic routing, DHCP/DNS) and switch configuration. * Experience configuring and supporting Windows\-based servers, virtual machines, and storage for security or enterprise applications. * Hands\-on experience integrating at least one enterprise security platform (such as video management, access control, or unified security systems). * Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, riser diagrams, and system schematics, and to troubleshoot issues across device, application, server, and network layers. **Certifications / Licenses** * Valid Driver's License and ability to travel regionally to customer sites as needed. **Preferred Qualifications** Preferred qualifications include vendor or platform certifications with major security system manufacturers (for example, Genetec, Milestone, Lenel, Avigilon, Axis, Bosch) and networking or server certifications such as BICSI, NICET, Cisco, CompTIA, or Microsoft. Experience with SQL/database fundamentals, AutoCAD or Revit for reviewing and marking up system drawings, scripting or automation tools to support configuration and deployment, and prior experience mentoring technicians or junior engineers is also beneficial. ### **Why Join IK Systems?** We offer a stable, growth\-oriented environment where engineering and technical excellence are valued. * Competitive salary * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Retirement plan with company match * Paid time off and company holidays * Professional development and certification support * Clear technical career progression: Field Deployment Engineer Systems Integration Engineer Principal Deployment Engineer * Opportunity to work with security, networking, and low\-voltage technologies across diverse customer environments ### **About IK Systems** IK Systems delivers integrated security and low\-voltage solutions for mission\-critical industries. Our expertise includes IP video, cameras, access control, intrusion alarms, perimeter security, WAN/LAN connectivity, and complex networked systems. We design, deploy, and support solutions that protect people, facilities, and critical operations. ### **Apply Today** If you have experience in systems integration, low\-voltage security systems, IP video, access control, alarm platforms, and networked infrastructure, and you are looking for a role focused on system performance and reliability, we invite you to apply for the Systems Integration Engineer position at IK Systems.

jobs.title: Sales Hunter, US
jobs.description: ### **The role** We are hiring a hungry, driven **Sales Hunter** to grow Ideas2IT's AI and product engineering revenue in the US. You will own the whole motion, from first conversation to signed SOW, across a track that carries quota. Your responsibility will be to acquire **net\-new logos**. You will build that pipeline yourself through account\-based prospecting into named targets, direct outreach to CXOs, and the executive forums and industry events where our buyers actually are. Marketing's engine will not fill half your funnel, and you should want it that way. **Your buyers** are CXOs who have sat through two years of AI pitches and have become very good at spotting the ones with nothing behind them. You can open with a free codebase scan, data readiness review or use case sprint, run by a senior consultant rather than an SDR, returning a prioritized plan and cost estimates in one to two weeks that the prospect keeps whether or not they sign. Most of your competition cannot match that, because most of them do not have the platform tooling to do discovery for free. **When the conversation gets technical**, you are not alone in it. Ideas2IT has proprietary platforms and 700\+ forward\-deployed engineers, domain\-matched to a client's stack before an engagement starts. AI POCs reach a working demonstration in two to four weeks and production in sixty to ninety days. Modernization starts with a one\-week codebase assessment and incremental delivery from the next sprint. ### **Why here** We started by solving hard problems and building products, and that is still how the firm behaves. Four of the products we built for ourselves, Pipecandy, Element5, IdeaRx and Carefi.in, were spun out as separately funded companies. A Sales Hunter's role is only as good as what happens after the signature. At most typical services firms you close a logo, delivery underwhelms, and you spend the next year selling around the damage instead of expanding into it. Our 99% renewal rate is why that does not happen here. Whatever you land compounds instead of leaking, and that compounding is a real part of your number rather than someone else's. Six proprietary platforms handle the most expensive parts of an engagement, meaning discovery, analysis, architecture and test generation, so engineers work only on the twenty to thirty percent that needs human judgment. * **Anticlock** runs the AI\-native SDLC * **Explayn** does source code intelligence * **Legacyleap** handles agentic modernization * **MigratiX** does data estate migration * **DataStoryHub** is conversational BI * **Qadence** auto\-generates around 70% of test cases. Delivery runs forty to seventy percent faster than a conventional engineering team, and our forward\-deployed engineers embed inside the client organization, share their OKRs and work on their stack rather than reporting in from a delivery center. Just two of the many outcomes you will carry into a room: * **Medtronic LABS** saw sixty percent faster patient information retrieval and a threefold increase in concurrent users. * **For St. Louis University** we took a data processing job that would have run four and a half years down to a week. For regulated buyers we hold SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, HIPAA compliance and AWS Healthcare Competency. Leadership has carried P\&L, written code and shipped products. **Murali Vivekanandan** is Founder and Chairman, **Gayathri Vivekanandan** is CEO, **Robert Lang** is Chief Revenue Officer, and **Arunkumar Ganesan** is Co\-Founder and Senior Director of Technology. ### **Why this, why now** In August 2026, Ideas2IT was named an **OpenAI Select Partner**. That gives us early access and direct support, so new frontier capability reaches client systems close to when it exists rather than a year later. For you, it is leverage in a room and a credential the prospect's own board will recognize, and it arrived exactly as enterprise buyers stopped experimenting and started committing production budget. Sell for a bloated consultancy and the brand opens doors, the deal desk is mature, and you are one of thirty business development directors working a carved\-out patch. At Ideas2IT, you get **real influence** over which verticals we chase and how we price, because there is no committee between you and the people who decide. You will work directly with leadership, speak without filters, and have your growth personally championed by the people who founded and grew this company. ### **What you own** * Net\-new logo acquisition across the US market * Account\-based prospecting into a named target list, and the research and multi\-threading that makes it work * Direct outreach to CXOs and senior decision\-makers, self\-sourced rather than inbound * Ideas2IT's presence at executive forums and industry events, and the pipeline that comes out of them * The full cycle, from first conversation to signed SOW * Multi\-million\-dollar, multi\-year AI and modernization programs * Converting free assessments into scoped, paid engagements * Proposal shaping alongside Practice Heads and Solution Architects * Forecasting and CRM discipline that leadership can plan against ### **What you bring** * 8 to 15 years in US enterprise sales * A track record of closing $3M to $10M\+ in annual new revenue, with the attainment numbers to back it * Experience selling AI, data, cloud, modernization or platform engineering services * A working ABM discipline: you build the target list, do the research, and multi\-thread rather than working a single contact * The ability to build pipeline yourself rather than waiting on inbound * Comfort running complex, multi\-stakeholder enterprise deals, with MEDDICC, Challenger or something comparable behind you * Executive presence and real consultative range ### **What sets you apart** * You have sold AI\-led transformation or GenAI programs and know where those deals actually stall * You have a live CXO network in healthcare, financial services or SaaS, which is where our strongest references sit * You work events properly, meaning a target list going in and a follow\-up motion coming out * You have sold in regulated environments and use compliance credentials as an accelerant rather than a checkbox ### **The numbers matter** To Sales Hunters at this level, whether a quota is credible tends to matter more than a headline OTE, so we are happy to walk you through the math before our first conversation, if you'd like. Write to us and we will share everything relevant. *Ideas2IT is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from every background.* ### **About Us:** Ideas2IT stands at the intersection of Technology, Business, and Product Engineering, offering high\-caliber Product Development services. Initially conceived as a CTO consulting firm, we've evolved into thought leaders in cutting\-edge technologies such as Generative AI, assisting our clients in embracing innovation. Our forte lies in applying technology to address business needs, demonstrated by our track record of developing AI\-driven solutions for industry giants like Facebook, Bloomberg, Siemens, and others. Harnessing our product\-centric approach, we've incubated several AI\-based startups—including Pipecandy, Element5, IdeaRx, and Carefi. in—that have flourished into successful ventures backed by venture capital. With fourteen years of remarkable growth behind us, we're steadfast in pursuing ambitious objectives.‍ P.S. We're all about diversity, and our doors are wide open to everyone. Join us in celebrating the awesomeness of differences!
