jobs.description: Posted Date 9/29/2026 Description Sr. Staff Engineer (Reliability Engineering) As a Senior Staff Engineer at Capital One, you will be part of a community of technical experts working to define the future of banking in the cloud. You will work alongside our talented team of developers, machine learning experts, product managers and people leaders. Our Senior Staff Engineers are leading experts in their domains, helping devise practical and reusable solutions to complex problems. You will drive innovation at multiple levels, helping optimize business outcomes while delivering strong technology solutions. At Capital One, we believe diversity of thought strengthens our ability to influence, collaborate and provide the most innovative solutions across organizational boundaries. You will promote a culture of engineering excellence and strike the right balance between lending expertise and providing an inclusive environment where the ideas of others can be heard and championed. You will lead the way in creating next\-generation talent for Capital One Tech, mentoring engineers and actively recruiting to keep building our community. Senior Staff Engineers are expected to lead through technical contribution. You will operate as a trusted advisor for our key technologies, platforms and capability domains, creating clear and concise communications, code samples, blog posts and other materials to share knowledge both inside and outside the organization. You will specialize in a particular subject area, but your input and impact will be sought and expected throughout the organization. The Resilience Engineering team is dedicated to safeguarding our enterprise critical platforms by preventing, managing, and resolving high\-severity technology incidents. In this team, you will serve as the technical authority, providing architectural vision and leading cross\-functional teams during critical outages to drastically minimize downtime. Beyond immediate incident response, you will spearhead systemic root cause analyses to ensure underlying architectural weaknesses are fundamentally and permanently resolved. You will proactively define and champion enterprise\-wide standards for observability, disaster recovery, and chaos engineering to build a robust, fault\-tolerant infrastructure. This is a highly visible, strategic leadership role where your expertise will mentor engineering teams and directly shape the long\-term reliability and operational maturity of our entire organization. implementation * Serve as an authoritative expert on non\-functional system characteristics, such as performance, scalability and operability * Continue learning and injecting advanced technical knowledge into our community * Handle several projects simultaneously, balancing your time to maximize impact * Act as a role model and mentor within the tech community, helping to coach and strengthen the technical expertise and know\-how of our engineering and product community * Drive modernization of monolithic systems into microservice architectures and event\-driven platforms * Collaborate with senior engineering and architecture leaders to define long\-term platform strategy and API standards * Serve as a force\-multiplier for the team, balancing deep, hands\-on technical computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud) + Data architecture * 12\+ years of professional experience coding in commonly used languages like Go, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Rust, C\#, architecture, implementation, testing, deployment and production support * 10\+ years of experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), c + years of experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cloud\-based productivity tools, or virtualization technologies * 12\+ years of experience with Networking protocols and integration with third party distributed systems * 7\+ years of experience mentoring senior engineers and driving professional development within technical teams * 3\+ years of experience leading cross\-domain architectural reviews or establishing coding and design standards * Expertise in the strategic application of agentic AI coding tools to solve systemic development challenges *Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position****.*** The minimum and maximum full\-time annual salaries for this role are listed below, by location. Please note that this salary information is solely for candidates hired to perform work within one of these locations, and refers to the amount Capital One is willing to pay at the time of this posting. Salaries for part\-time roles will be prorated based upon the agreed upon number of hours to be regularly worked. This role is also eligible to earn performance based incentive compensation, which may include cash bonus(es) and/or long term incentives (LTI). Incentives could be discretionary or non discretionary depending on the plan. Capital One offers a comprehensive, competitive, and inclusive set of health, financial and other benefits that support your total well\-being. Learn more at the Capital One Careers website. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.No agencies please. This entry\-level role is ideal for someone eager to grow in the field of test automation and software development, with a strong focus on Python\-based development. With its simple, wearable design, the tubeless disposable Pod provides up to three days of non\-stop insulin delivery, without the need to see or handle a needle. jobs.title: Packaging Module Development Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Details:** ================ **Job Description:** -------------------- Intel Corporation is one of the world's leading semiconductor companies, driving innovation that shapes the future of computing, connectivity, and intelligence. With a legacy of over 50 years of technological breakthroughs, Intel is committed to creating world\-changing technology that improves the lives of every person on the planet. Our culture is built on inclusion, collaboration, and a relentless pursuit of what's next. At Intel, your work matters — and so do you. Are you passionate about advancing semiconductor packaging technology? Intel's Substrate Packaging Technology Development (SPTD) organization is seeking a Packaging Module Development Engineer specializing in Laser and Optical Processing to join our pilot line in Chandler, Arizona. In this role, you will develop and integrate next\-generation laser and optical process technologies that enable Intel's most advanced packaging solutions. Working with world\-class engineers and researchers, you will directly influence the performance, reliability, and manufacturability of future semiconductor products. **Key Responsibilities** * Develop and optimize laser, optical, and advanced packaging processes for next\-generation semiconductor technologies. * Design and execute experiments, analyze data, and drive process improvements using scientific and statistical methods. * Support the installation, qualification, and ramp of new equipment and process technologies. * Investigate process and equipment issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and implement solutions to improve yield and reliability. Collaborate across engineering teams and document technical findings to support technology development and manufacturing readiness. * **As a Successful Candidate, You Will Bring:** * A natural collaborator – You thrive in team environments and build strong relationships across functions and disciplines. * Curious and innovative – You approach challenges with an open mind and a drive to find creative, data\-driven solutions. * Detail\-oriented – You take pride in precision and thoroughness in everything from experimental design to documentation. * An effective communicator – You can translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable insights for diverse audiences. * Resilient and adaptable – You remain focused and solutions\-oriented in a fast\-paced, ever\-evolving environment. * A self\-starter – You take ownership of your work and proactively identify opportunities for improvement without waiting to be asked. **Qualifications:** ------------------- You must possess the below minimum qualifications to be initially considered for this position. jobs.title: Manager 3 (Manager of Managers), Product Security
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Lead and grow a team of senior security engineers in Intuit's Product Security organization. This is a technical leadership role with a Day 1 mindset: reinventing how product security operates in the AI era rather than running an established playbook. Product Security is a trusted partner to business leaders across Intuit, appraising them of security risks so their investments are prioritized correctly while reducing overall risk for our customers. The team's work spans security reviews, design consults, exception and risk evaluations, security standards, and AI/agentic system security. You will own the delivery and quality of this portfolio across the entire Intuit ecosystem, and lead its transformation from human\-first processes to continuous, agent\-first ones, while defining and raising the security bar for Intuit products, including emerging AI and agentic experiences. The ideal candidate has a strong product security background, experience leading senior IC talent, a builder's mindset toward automation and reinvention, and strong verbal and written communication skills. **Responsibilities** * Lead, mentor, and grow a team of security engineers at the staff, senior staff, and principal engineer levels * Own delivery and quality of the full product security portfolio across the entire Intuit ecosystem, including security reviews, design consults, and exception and risk evaluations, ensuring recommendations are timely, actionable, and grounded in business context * Reinvent product security processes with a Day 1 mindset, questioning inherited defaults and rebuilding workflows around automation and agents rather than incrementally improving manual ones * Drive the shift from human\-first to agent\-first across reviews, consults, and exception processing, with human oversight reserved for real judgment calls * Ensure security work produces durable, structured context and artifacts that both engineers and AI agents can consume, so findings and decisions compound over time instead of living in one\-off documents * Define and evolve baseline security controls that set the security bar for products across the Intuit ecosystem, and partner with platform teams to embed them into paved paths so whole classes of risk are engineered out by default * Raise the security bar for AI and agentic systems, including standards for MCP, agents, and agentic identity, and unify AI security into the core review and consult pipeline * Partner with business and engineering leaders across Intuit to surface security risks early, inform investment decisions, and build durable trust through consistent leadership engagement * Define and manage program effectiveness metrics, including coverage, cycle time, and control adoption, reporting them on a regular cadence to leadership **Qualifications** **Required Experience / Skills** * Proven track record of building and leading high\-performing security engineering teams, including senior and principal\-level ICs * Deep technical proficiency in application security, secure design review, threat modeling, and cloud security (AWS, GCP, and/or Azure) * Demonstrated experience transforming or rebuilding security programs, not just operating them, with hands\-on automation of security processes such as review tooling, policy\-as\-code, or AI\-assisted triage and analysis * Experience defining security standards, baselines, or control frameworks and driving their adoption across large engineering organizations * Experience partnering with senior business and engineering leaders and influencing decisions through risk\-based recommendations rather than gatekeeping * Strong understanding of modern development practices, CI/CD pipelines, and how to integrate security upstream into build environments * Ability to manage effective relationships with organizational leaders, build a roadmap, and drive broad initiatives to completion * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical risk into business terms for executive audiences **Preferred Skills** * Experience securing AI/ML and agentic systems (LLM integrations, MCP, agent authorization and identity models) * Experience with security automation or software development (e.g., Python, Go) * Experience running consult and exception/risk\-acceptance processes at scale in ecosystem\-wide or company\-wide security roles * Ability to navigate hard conversations and disseminate information to team members * Effective organizational and planning skills, with the ability to successfully guide projects through to completion * CISSP, CISM, or equivalent certification preferred **Required Education / Experience** * BA/BS degree or higher in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or equivalent work experience * 8\+ years industry experience in security engineering, application security, or product security * 3\+ years leadership experience managing managers and/or leading teams of principal and staff\-level security engineers. Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender. The expected base pay range for this position is: Mountain View $255,000 \- $345,000 San Diego, CA $240,000\- $324,500

jobs.title: Senior Staff Technical Data Analyst – Finance Technology
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ The Intuit FLP (Finance, Legal, and Privacy) Tech team builds Intuit's core capabilities across enterprise finance, legal, and privacy applications. Within FLP Tech, the Finance Data \& Analytics team is the trusted source of truth for how Intuit's Finance organization sees its own business — from month\-end close and SOX\-certified financial reporting to workforce, revenue, and expense analytics used across the company. Finance data at Intuit is in the midst of a rapid shift toward AI\-assisted and agentic approaches to financial reporting, controls testing, and business intelligence. We are hiring a Staff Technical Data Analyst to help lead this shift. This is not a report\-writing role. You will own report and dashboard architecture and strategy across a large, SOX\-sensitive portfolio spanning Revenue, Expense, Workforce, and Compliance reporting, partnering directly with Finance, SOX/Internal Audit, and Data Engineering to make sure that portfolio is accurate, governed, and audit\-ready — while also pushing it forward: consolidating redundant reporting, modernizing the underlying data architecture, and identifying where GenAI and agentic tooling can remove manual effort from financial control work rather than just producing more dashboards. You are accountable for the outcome, not just the artifact. If a report is technically correct but doesn't survive an audit walkthrough, or a dashboard ships but nobody adopts it, that is your problem to solve. **Responsibilities** * **Report \& Dashboard Portfolio Ownership:** Own the architecture, roadmap, and health of a large\-scale reporting portfolio (SOX and non\-SOX) spanning multiple Finance domains. Maintain a single, authoritative view of what exists, who owns it, and where consolidation or retirement opportunities exist, and drive that consolidation rather than letting the portfolio grow indefinitely. * **SOX Control Design \& Compliance Reporting:** Design and maintain the data validation and control frameworks that keep SOX\-certified financial reporting accurate, traceable, and audit\-ready. Partner directly with Internal Audit and external auditors on control design, evidence, and walkthroughs, and build the automated validation and lineage tooling that lets the business scale compliance without scaling headcount. * **Data Architecture \& Migration:** Lead the technical design and execution of large\-scale data migrations, including legacy BI platform to governed cloud data lake/warehouse migrations, catalog and access\-control modernization, and the report\-logic migrations that follow. Ensure every migration preserves data lineage, auditability, and business continuity. * **Data Discovery for New Engagements:** Partner with product managers, data engineers, and AI/data scientists at the start of new product and AI initiatives to explore, analyze, and profile the underlying data first, understanding what data exists, its quality, and any gaps, before it's used to build models, products, or pipelines. * **Data Asset Management \& Governance:** Manage financial and business data as a governed asset across its lifecycle: data quality monitoring, access governance, metadata and lineage, and alignment with Intuit's data compliance standards. Prepare and maintain clean, well\-documented data for both traditional BI consumption and AI/ML pipelines. * **AI\-Driven Innovation in Finance Reporting:** Identify and pilot where GenAI and agentic approaches can modernize SOX testing, financial reporting, and BI: automated control testing and anomaly detection, natural\-language and narrative\-driven reporting, AI\-assisted data quality and lineage tooling, and prompt\-to\-SQL or self\-service analytics for business users. Bring a critical eye for where AI creates real leverage in a regulated environment and where human review and audit trails remain non\-negotiable. * **Stakeholder Partnership \& Influence:** Act as the primary technical partner to Finance business stakeholders (FP\&A, Accounting, Revenue, Workforce Planning) and cross\-functional technology teams, translating ambiguous business needs into clear technical requirements and data\-driven recommendations, and translating technical constraints back into terms Finance leadership can act on. * **Technical Delivery \& Craft Leadership:** Design, build, and maintain BI solutions end to end using tools such as Qlik, Databricks, Tableau, SQL, and Python, from data exploration and modeling through visualization and automated pipeline delivery. As a Staff\-level individual contributor, set the craft standard for technical solution design, data quality, and documentation across the team, mentoring analysts and contingent workers and reviewing their work. **Qualifications** * 10\+ years of industry experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or technical reporting supporting Finance, Accounting, SOX/regulatory compliance, or another tightly controlled business function. * BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, Finance/Accounting, or equivalent practical experience * Data \& Analytics Craft Qualifications: + Proven strong SQL and data modeling skills, with working proficiency in Python for data pipelines, automation, or analysis. + Proven experience building and maintaining BI solutions and dashboards end\-to\-end, from data exploration and architecture through visualization and delivery, using tools such as Qlik(Sense), Tableau, Power BI, or similar. + Proven experience with cloud jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ The Intuit FLP (Finance, Legal, and Privacy) Tech team builds Intuit's core capabilities across enterprise finance, legal, and privacy applications. Within FLP Tech, the Finance Data \& Analytics team is the trusted source of truth for how Intuit's Finance organization sees its own business — from month\-end close and SOX\-certified financial reporting to workforce, revenue, and expense analytics used across the company. Finance data at Intuit is in the midst of a rapid shift toward AI\-assisted and agentic approaches to financial reporting, controls testing, and business intelligence. We are hiring a Staff Technical Data Analyst to help lead this shift. This is not a report\-writing role. You will own report and dashboard architecture and strategy across a large, SOX\-sensitive portfolio spanning Revenue, Expense, Workforce, and Compliance reporting, partnering directly with Finance, SOX/Internal Audit, and Data Engineering to make sure that portfolio is accurate, governed, and audit\-ready — while also pushing it forward: consolidating redundant reporting, modernizing the underlying data architecture, and identifying where GenAI and agentic tooling can remove manual effort from financial control work rather than just producing more dashboards. You are accountable for the outcome, not just the artifact. If a report is technically correct but doesn't survive an audit walkthrough, or a dashboard ships but nobody adopts it, that is your problem to solve. **Responsibilities** * **Report \& Dashboard Portfolio Ownership:** Own the architecture, roadmap, and health of a large\-scale reporting portfolio (SOX and non\-SOX) spanning multiple Finance domains. Maintain a single, authoritative view of what exists, who owns it, and where consolidation or retirement opportunities exist, and drive that consolidation rather than letting the portfolio grow indefinitely. * **SOX Control Design \& Compliance Reporting:** Design and maintain the data validation and control frameworks that keep SOX\-certified financial reporting accurate, traceable, and audit\-ready. Prepare and maintain clean, well\-documented data for both traditional BI consumption and AI/ML pipelines. * **AI\-Driven Innovation in Finance Reporting:** Identify and pilot where GenAI and agentic approaches can modernize SOX testing, financial reporting, and BI: automated control testing and anomaly detection, natural\-language and narrative\-driven reporting, AI\-assisted data quality and lineage tooling, and prompt\-to\-SQL or self\-service analytics for business users. jobs.title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer, Consumer Risk AI
jobs.description: **Overview** ------------ Intuit is looking for a Staff Machine Learning Engineer to own the data and platform layer beneath our consumer risk decisioning. This team builds the machine learning that decides, in real time, whether money moves — protecting customers from account takeover, first/third\-party fraud, and unauthorized transactions across Intuit Fintech products. You'll design and own the shared infrastructure every model on this team depends on: streaming and batch feature pipelines, the cross\-entity data path, training and evaluation frameworks, real\-time inference serving, and the handoff into our decision engine, across entire Fintech money product lifecycle — from risk screening/qualification of money\-in/out events, cashflow underwriting, account take\-over detection, to dynamic segmentation. provide actionable feedback to senior engineers and help them break work into pieces agents can execute reliably * Connect technical decisions to the metrics leadership tracks — loss basis points, approval rate, decision latency, hold release rate — define success up front, and drive the post\-launch iteration **Qualifications** * **Minimum** * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience * 8\+ years building production software, with substantial time on ML systems rather than ML research; prior experience leading an engineering effort across teams * Strong CS fundamentals — data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, system design — plus working ML fundamentals (classification, regression, feature engineering, model evaluation) * Proficiency in Python and SQL; production experience with Spark, Flink, or equivalent for streaming and batch data processing * Demonstrated ownership of a data or ML platform used by more than one team, including the operational load after launch * Experience deploying models to real\-time serving under hard latency budgets, and running them in production afterward * Cloud infrastructure depth in at least one major cloud, ideally AWS (including SageMaker or equivalent ML tooling). jobs.title: Fire Alarm Designer Consultant
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Throughout our worldwide network of experts, clients and communities, we are renowned for our leadership in fire protection engineering – a legacy of responsibility we have proudly upheld since 1939\. Today, our expertise extends broadly across closely related security and risk\-based fields – from accessibility consulting and risk analysis to process safety, forensic investigations, security risk consulting, emergency management, digital innovation and more. Our engineers and consultants collaborate to solve complex safety and security challenges, ensuring our clients can protect what matters most. For over 80 years, we have helped mitigate risks that threaten lives, property and reputations. Through technology, expertise and industry\-leading research, we remain dedicated to our purpose of making our world safe, secure and resilient. At Jensen Hughes, we believe that creating and sustaining a culture of trust, integrity and professional growth starts with putting our people first. Our employees are our greatest strength, and we value the unique perspectives and talents they bring to our organization. Our wide range of Global Employee Networks connect people from across the organization, supporting career development and providing forums for individuals to share experiences on topics they're passionate about. Together, we are cultivating a connected culture where everyone has the opportunity to learn, grow and succeed together. **Position Overview** Jensen Hughes is seeking highly experienced and motivated **Fire Alarm Designer Consultant** to join our team. This role will support a fast\-paced project through consulting, design, review, and field oversight activities at a large facility in Phoenix, AZ. The position requires technical depth, sound judgment, and the ability to interface effectively with clients. This role is responsible for the design, evaluation, and consulting of fire alarm and mass notification systems across a variety of project types. The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise, strong knowledge of applicable codes and standards, and the ability to lead projects and collaborate effectively with clients and multidisciplinary teams. **Key Responsibilities** **Design, Consulting, and Technical Oversight** * Lead and execute fire alarm and/or mass notification system design from concept through construction, including system layouts, device placement, riser diagrams, sequences of operation, and calculations (battery, voltage drop, etc.). * Develop detailed, code\-compliant fire alarm drawings, including shop drawings, specifications, and technical reports using REVIT, AutoCAD, and/or similar design industry tools. * Review architectural and engineering drawings to ensure life safety and fire code compliance. **Project Execution and Field Activities** * Act as the owner's representative for fire alarm systems during design, construction, and commissioning phases. * Conduct site assessments and field surveys to evaluate existing conditions and fire alarm installations. * Prepare and review design, shop drawing, and construction submittals for compliance with applicable codes, standards, and project requirements. * Support testing, commissioning, and acceptance activities, including preparation of test plans, witnessing tests, and documenting results. **Client, Contractor, and Team Coordination** * Coordinate and collaborate with engineers, architects, contractors, authorities having jurisdiction (AHJs), and internal project teams. * Interface directly with clients to communicate technical findings, recommendations, and project status. * Manage technical aspects of projects, including schedules, workload planning, and adherence to approved scopes of work. **Quality, Compliance, and Leadership** * Stay current on applicable codes, standards, and emerging technologies (e.g., NFPA 72, NFPA 70, IBC). * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior staff, including support for NICET development and training. **Minimum Requirements** * Progressive experience in fire alarm system design, consulting, or inspection * Proficiency with AutoCAD, or other industry design software **Preferred Qualifications** * NICET certification in Fire Alarm Systems; NICET Level II or higher is strongly desired * REVIT strongly desired * Proficiency with ASPIRE™ software * Strong working knowledge of NFPA codes, life safety standards, and local jurisdictional requirements * Experience with mass notification systems and integrated life safety solutions * Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present technically sound design strategies * Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving skills * Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting client and schedule commitments **Additional Considerations** * Candidates with significant industry experience in fire alarm system design, inspection, or code consulting are desired. **Relocation Assistance Provided** \#LI\-VM1 ***Jensen Hughes is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status.*** At Jensen Hughes, we embrace innovation and understand that people are increasingly using artificial intelligence (AI) tools like ChatGPT and other generative platforms to learn, prepare and communicate. We have provided some guidelines regarding the responsible use of AI in the recruitment process. Please click **here** to review. The security of your personal data is important to us. Jensen Hughes has implemented reasonable physical, technical, and administrative security standards to protect personal data from loss, misuse, alteration, or destruction. We protect your personal data against unauthorized access, use, or disclosure, using security technologies and procedures, such as encryption and limited access. Only authorized individuals may access your personal data for the purpose for which it was collected, and these individuals receive training about the importance of protecting personal data. Jensen Hughes is committed to compliance with all relevant data privacy laws in all areas where we do business, including, but not limited to, the GDPR and the CCPA. Additionally, our service providers are contractually bound to maintain the confidentiality of personal data and may not use the information for any unauthorized purpose. * Policy on use of 3rd party recruiting agency for direct placements Jensen Hughes will occasionally augment a recruiting search through agencies for certain positions when business conditions warrant. Jensen Hughes will not accept resumes, inquiries or proposals from recruiting agencies as an acceptable method to consider a candidate. 3rd party recruiting agencies must sign a standard Jensen Hughes agreement after being evaluated and accepted by a Human Resources or Talent Acquisition manager, or member of the talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and employees of Jensen Hughes are not authorized to accept resumes, engage in fee\-based searches through recruiting firms or sign a search agreement. Please note this policy does not apply to "staffing firms" or firms that are involved with hiring temporary staff. Any recruiting agency interested in being considered may contact our recruiting team at jensenhughesrecruiting.com.

jobs.description: **JOB DESCRIPTION** Job Description We have an exciting and rewarding opportunity for you to take your software engineering career to the next level. As a **Distributed Systems Engineer** at **JPMorganChase**, you'll serve as a seasoned member of an agile team to design and deliver trusted, market\-leading technology products in a secure, stable, and scalable way. You will be responsible for building and evolving critical backend platforms and services that operate reliably at scale across multiple systems, regions, and environments—supporting the firm's business objectives. We are seeking a dedicated professional who is a strong team player, self\-motivated, and driven to achieve engineering excellence on short timescales. This is an extremely hands\-on, delivery\-focused, technical position involving deep analysis, coding, testing, performance tuning, and close partnership with product, SRE/operations, and end users. Prior experience in financial services is desirable, but curiosity, strong fundamentals, and the ability to learn quickly are just as important. The role involves a high degree of teamwork, technical design reviews, and peer interaction. Job Responsibilities * **Executes software solutions**: leads design, development, and technical troubleshooting, thinking beyond routine approaches to build resilient distributed solutions and break down complex production problems. * **Builds secure, high\-quality production services**: develops and maintains low\-latency and/or high\-throughput services, background workers, and APIs with strong correctness and reliability guarantees. * **Designs for scale and reliability**: produces architecture and design artifacts for complex distributed applications (e.g., service decomposition, data consistency patterns, caching, failover) and ensures design constraints are met in implementation. * **Ensures operational excellence**: owns systems end\-to\-end including observability (metrics/logs/traces), incident response, capacity planning, and performance optimization. * **Works with large, diverse datasets**: gathers, analyzes, and synthesizes signals from production telemetry and business data to drive continuous improvement and to inform reliability and scalability work. * **Identifies systemic issues**: proactively detects hidden failure modes (hot partitions, thundering herds, cascading failures, backpressure gaps) and drives improvements to coding hygiene, testing strategy, and architecture. * **Collaborates across teams**: partners with platform, infrastructure, security, and dependent application teams to deliver well\-integrated capabilities and clear service contracts. * **Contributes to engineering communities**: participates in communities of practice and events that explore new and emerging technologies and raises the bar through mentoring and design/code review. * **Builds inclusive culture**: contributes to a team culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and respect. Preferred qualifications, capabilities \& skills * Strong technology generalist – experience building highly performant and resilient enterprise applications used within a high performance/realtime environment. * Experience working in a team with a strong software development process (build, test, deploy etc). * Experience in developing, debugging, and maintaining code in a large corporate environment with one or more modern programming languages and database querying languages * A desire to learn more about the Financial products. **ABOUT US** JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services and an industry\-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real\-world results and help move society forward. **Position Summary** The Data Governance Enablement Leader owns the strategy for how Johnson Controls governs its data. This role carries the governance assessment and playbook forward from findings into an operating reality, setting both the standards and the operating model that define how data is owned, managed, and trusted across the enterprise. This is an influence role, not a delivery role. The standards are set here; execution sits with the Data Platform, Engineering, and Architecture teams, and this role partners with them closely to make the model real without taking over their work. Success depends on adoption, which means the person in this seat spends as much time building buy\-in as building frameworks. That advocacy runs in two directions. Inside DA\&AI, the role builds a governance culture where good data practice is a default rather than a checkpoint. Across the business, it recruits and energizes the data owners and functional leaders whose participation the model depends on, and drives the change management that our assessment identified as the missing ingredient. The role also keeps us moving forward on capability, guiding governance tooling decisions and pushing where governance can be done better than it is today, including applying AI to master data management, stewardship, and data quality. **Key Responsibilities** **Core Responsibilities** * **Governance strategy.** Carry the governance assessment and playbook forward into a sequenced roadmap, and own the strategic direction and accountability of the program. * **Operating model and standards.** Use playbook to define how DA\&AI governs data: business data owner and steward roles, domain forums, decision rights, and the standards covering ownership, quality, classification, metadata, and lifecycle. * **Execution partnership.** Work with Data Platform, Engineering, and Architecture to translate standards into implementation, and hold to committed outcomes without owning delivery. * **Governance culture within DA\&AI.** Make governance a default behavior across the organization through training, reusable artifacts, and consistent internal advocacy. * **Business influence and change management.** Serve as the visible champion for governance across the business. Recruit data owners, build buy\-in with functional leaders, and drive the adoption the model depends on. * **Tooling and innovation.** Guide governance tooling decisions, including Microsoft Purview, and push new capability such as applying AI to master data management, stewardship, and data quality. * **Measurement and reporting.** Define what good governance looks like quantitatively and report progress to organizational and executive audiences. * **AI governance alignment.** Partner with the AI Enablement Leader, security, legal, and compliance so AI extends the enterprise data governance model. * **People leadership.** Build and develop the governance team as the program scales, and mentor stewards and data owners outside the reporting line. **Success Profile — What Does Success Look Like at 12 Months?** The governance playbook is in force rather than on a shelf, with named business data owners active across the first priority domains; DA\&AI treats governance as part of how work gets done instead of a review step; platform and engineering teams are building to a defined standard; and functions that once stood up their own shadow data operations now come to governance because it is the more trusted path. **Top 3–5 KPIs for the Team** Drafted for discussion. These are intended to measure governance outcomes rather than program activity, and should be finalized against available instrumentation and audit scope before the role is posted. * **Domain governance coverage**: percentage of priority data domains with a named business data owner, an active steward, and progress in governance artifacts in place. * Critical data element health: percentage of critical data elements with defined ownership, classification, and measured quality rules, with quality scorecards trending up quarter over quarter. * **Standards adoption:** percentage of Tier 1 data products and platform work assessed as conforming to published governance standards. * Business engagement: attendance and decision throughput in domain governance forums, and number of functions actively participating rather than nominally assigned. * **Governance maturity movement:** change against the baseline governance assessment, measured on a consistent maturity model. **Qualifications \& Experience** **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in information management, computer science, business, or a related field. Advanced degree or governance certification (CDMP, DGSP) welcome but not required. **Experience** * 10\+ years of professional experience in data management, governance, or data risk, including 3\+ years leading a governance function or program at enterprise scale. * Demonstrated experience standing up a federated governance model in a decentralized organization, including recruiting and enabling business data owners outside the reporting line. * Direct experience supporting or responding to audits of data controls, including control design, evidence management, and remediation ownership. * Experience in a matrixed environment where governance outcomes depend on teams the role does not own. * People management experience. **Technical Skills** * Working knowledge of enterprise governance and catalog platforms, with hands\-on familiarity with Microsoft Purview strongly preferred and exposure to comparable tools (Collibra, Alation) welcome. * Understanding of modern data platform architecture sufficient to set credible standards: cloud warehouses including Snowflake, lakehouse and Fabric patterns, metadata and lineage, and the practical limits of catalog coverage in a multi\-cloud estate. * Literacy in relevant regulatory and control frameworks, including SOX ITGCs, privacy regulation such as GDPR, and data classification schemes. Familiarity with Data / AI governance frameworks (DAMA, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act) is a plus. * Fluency in data quality measurement: rule definition, scorecarding, and tying quality metrics to business consequence. **Leadership Competencies** * Influence without authority, applied to senior business stakeholders who do not report to this role and may not want the accountability being assigned to them. * Willingness to hold a standard and say no to exceptions that would erode it, including when the request comes from a senior leader. * Genuine change leadership capability. The assessment named absent change management as a root cause, and this role is the correction. * Composure and credibility under audit scrutiny. * Judgment about scope. This role will be pulled toward doing the domains’ work for them and needs to resist it. * Clear written and verbal communication for audiences ranging from data engineers to the executive committee and external auditors. **Additional Information** ========================== **Work Location \& Arrangement:** Glendale, WI (Hybrid) **Travel:** Up to 10% domestic travel may be required. **Sponsorship:** Johnson Controls will not sponsor applicants for work visas or provide immigration\-related employment sponsorship for this position, now or in the future.

jobs.title: AVP - Tax Credit Investments, Capital Deployment and Asset Management
jobs.description: #### **Job Summary** The Assistant Vice President – Tax Credit Investments, Capital Deployment and Asset Management is a hybrid role that requires both a strategic and data\-driven mindset, with responsibilities spanning across process improvement and implementation, capital deployment, technical performance management, investor reporting, and data analytics. This role will report to the VP – Tax Credit Investments, Capital Deployment and Asset Management, and work closely with internal teams (finance, data, legal, IT) and external stakeholders to ensure strong returns and operational excellence across our portfolio. #### **Duties and Responsibilities:** * Complete the due diligence review for tax credit fundings, including but not limited to contract review, independent engineer report review, and appraisal review for mechanical completion and substantial completion tax credit financing fundings. * Review sponsorprovided financial models for accuracy and consistency with underwriting assumptions and due diligence, flagging discrepancies as needed. * Provide Investors with the documentation and analysis required for their review and approval. * Manage the Investor capital call process. * Work with the Tax Credit Investment team to identify inefficiencies, improve workflows, and implement stronger process and document retention practices. * Monitor performance and operations of solar and storage assets on an asneeded basis, using industrystandard asset management and monitoring platforms to track output and identify issues. Work with sponsors to understand performance issues and impacts on the financial performance of the investments. * Prepare and review monthly, quarterly, annual, and ad hoc reporting for investors and internal leadership, ensuring alignment with contractual obligations, financial covenants, and ESG commitments. * Coordinate investor data requests, audit support, and related reporting needs. * Develop and maintain dashboards, models, and automated reporting workflows to track asset performance, financial metrics, and compliance data. * Use data analytics and visualization tools to identify trends, flag anomalies, enhance portfolio intelligence, and support improved investment returns. * Collaborate with internal and external finance and accounting teams to review financial statements, compile budgets and forecasts, conduct variance analysis, and monitor credit underwriting and LLCA compliance. * Track PPA, operations and maintenance, land lease, and other contract obligations to ensure compliance and value maximization. * Support project valuations, refinancing, and mergers and acquisitions due diligence with operational insights. * Other duties as assigned. Minimum Education, Skills and Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or another related field. MBA, CFA, and/or CPA preferred. An equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a college degree. * Four or more years of related experience in renewable energy project finance, including familiarity with PPA structures, operational contracts, tax credits, and deal structuring. * Proven experience in building and presenting investorlevel reporting. * Detailoriented and analytical, with the ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with technical, financial, internal, and external stakeholders. * Demonstrated ability and commitment to using AI tools and related technology to streamline reporting, data analysis, and process workflows. * Proficient in financial modeling, valuation, and financial accounting principles. * Selfstarter with a strong sense of ownership and responsibility * Ability to effectively manage multiple deadlines and work in a fastpaced, rapidly changing environment. * Prior experience with Monday.com or investment management software preferred. #### **Position Routinely Interfaces with:** * Corporate investors and their advisors * External advisors and partners * All KeyState team members, including executive management and ownership #### **Compensation** KeyState offers a competitive compensation structure designed to reward performance, long\-term relationship development, and growth. Compensation includes: * Competitive base salary. * Performancebased incentive opportunities. * Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, vision, and retirement plan. Total compensation is commensurate with experience, education and qualifications. #### **Work Environment** This position can be based in KeyState’s Las Vegas or Denver office, or be remote based. At KeyState, we value all employees and job candidates as unique individuals and welcome the variety of experiences they bring to our company. We maintain a strict non\-discrimination policy and believe everyone should be treated equally regardless of race, sex, gender identification, sexual orientation, national origin, native language, religion, age, disability, marital status, citizenship, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law. #### **About KeyState** Founded in 1991, KeyState is a rapidly growing, privately held financial services firm specializing in providing tax advantaged investments to community banks. With over $18 billion in assets under management, KeyState has managed investment subsidiaries for community banks for over 35 years. In 2008, KeyState launched its captive management practice that grew to form and managing captives for over 100 companies across the US. In 2019, KeyState launched a renewable energy tax credit investment platform for community banks. KeyState helps community banks source, underwrite, and manage tax credit investments. To date, KeyState has raised and deployed approximately $1 billion in tax credit capital for community banks, financing over 200 renewable energy projects across the United States.

This role involves coordinating with various departments, analyzing project requirements, and ensuring that all estimates are aligned with company standards and client expectations. The Lead Estimator plays a crucial role in the bidding process, helping the company secure profitable projects while maintaining competitive pricing. **District Overview** --------------------- Mass. jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer, Application Security
jobs.description: **Kikoff: The Fintech Powering Financial Security at Scale** Kikoff is a profitable, pre\-IPO fintech company on a mission to empower everyone to achieve financial security. With record revenue growth in 2025 and a unicorn valuation, we've built a suite of products that help millions of people build credit, access liquidity, and save money. We're scaling fast. Join us if you want to build something meaningful and help millions of people move forward financially. **Why Kikoff:** This is a consumer fintech startup, and you will be working with serial entrepreneurs who have built strong consumer brands and innovative products. We value extreme ownership, clear communication, a strong sense of craftsmanship, and the desire to create lasting work and work relationships. Yes, you can build an exciting business AND have real\-life real\-customer impact. **About the Role** ------------------ Kikoff exists to help millions of people build credit. That only works if the products they use are safe. This role helps shape the Application Security pillar at Kikoff: how code gets written, reviewed, shipped, and defended across our web, mobile, and API surfaces. You will drive and help shape the application security roadmap. You define the strategy, sequence the work, and drive it to done. Engineers ship fast here, and increasingly with AI agents writing code alongside them. Your job is to make that speed safe by default. **In This Role, You Will** -------------------------- ### **Drive the Pillar** * Drive the application security roadmap: secure SDLC, code review, threat modeling, vulnerability management, and the pentest and bug bounty programs. * Set the standard for what secure code looks like at Kikoff and build the tooling that enforces it: SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, and dependency policy wired into CI with signal engineers trust. * Decide how AI\-generated code gets reviewed and gated. Design the controls for a codebase where agents are contributors. ### **Build \& Secure** * Build paved roads into the frameworks engineers use: authn/authz libraries, input validation, safe defaults for common patterns, so the secure way is the only way most engineers encounter. * Own security for our authentication and session layer: MFA design, account recovery, session management, and defenses against credential stuffing and account takeover. * Secure our APIs and mobile apps: authorization models, rate limiting, abuse controls, certificate pinning, and secure storage on device. * Secure the AI features we ship to customers: prompt injection defenses, tool permission boundaries, and data exposure controls for LLM\-backed flows. ### **Prove It** * Run the penetration testing and bug bounty programs. Triage, drive remediation, and close the loop with engineering. * Build vulnerability management that holds up in front of auditors: defined SLAs, tracked remediation, and evidence that stands on its own for PCI\-DSS, SOC 2, and IPO\-readiness controls. * Threat model new products and major features before they ship, not after. ### **Enable Engineering** * Be the security engineer product engineers actually want in their design reviews. Clear answers, fast turnaround, real fixes. * Stand up and run a security champions program so AppSec scales past one person. * Build internal tooling, including AI\-assisted review and triage, that multiplies the team's reach. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 6\+ years in security engineering with deep, hands\-on application security experience: secure code review, threat modeling, vulnerability triage, and remediation at scale * You write production code. Fluency in at least one of Ruby, Python, Go, or TypeScript, and comfort reading all of them * You have designed and shipped authentication and authorization systems, not just reviewed them. OAuth/OIDC, session management, MFA, account recovery * Hands\-on with modern AppSec tooling and the judgment to know when it is wrong: SAST, SCA, DAST, secrets scanning, CI/CD integration * Experience securing REST/GraphQL APIs and native mobile applications * You have run or built a pentest or bug bounty program * Comfortable in a fintech regulated environment: PCI\-DSS, SOC 2, or similar **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Securing LLM\-backed product features or agentic workloads in production * Fraud and abuse defense: bot detection, credential stuffing mitigation, device signals * Security champions or developer education programs you started, not inherited * Supply chain security depth: dependency provenance, artifact signing, build integrity * Consumer fintech or financial services background Base Range $268,000 \- $321,000 USD Equal Employment Opportunity Statement Kikoff Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to complying with all federal, state, and local laws providing equal employment opportunities and considers qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other legally protected class. .

jobs.title: Substation Designer
jobs.description: Overview: Kimley\-Horn's Chicago, Illinois (IL) office is seeking a Substation Designer with 15\+ years of experience to join the Power Delivery team. This is not a remote position. Responsibilities: The successful candidate will support the design, and execution of high\-voltage and medium\-voltage substation projects for utility, renewable energy, and industrial clients. Responsibilities include developing physical layouts, equipment arrangements, grounding systems, lightning protection systems, and construction drawing packages while coordinating closely with protection and control, civil, structural, and electrical disciplines. The ideal candidate is a self\-driven designer with strong technical skills, experience in substation design standards and industry practices, and the ability to manage multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.* Perform conceptual and detailed HV and MV substation physical/electrical design for utilities and substations, including basic layout, electrical arrangement, one\-line diagrams, three\-line drawings, plan\-section drawings, and grounding. * Perform engineering studies and calculations. * Perform quality control reviews on substation physical design projects. * Assume the role of technical lead on projects with limited guidance. * Create and review bills of materials for substation physical projects. * Develop and review proposals and scopes of work for smaller substation physical projects. * Support the continued professional development of less experienced engineers/designers, including technical guidance and training recommendations. Communicate effectively with internal teams and clients to meet project objectives. * Qualifications: * 15\+ years of relevant experience in substation design. * Preferred (but not required): Associates degree with an engineering or drafting concentration. * Proficiency with industry\-standard design software such as AutoCAD, MicroStation and inventor. * Experience with grounding studies, lightning protection studies, and lighting studies. **Salary Range: $105,000\-$140,000** Why Kimley\-Horn?: At Kimley\-Horn, we do things differently. People, clients, and employees are at the forefront of who we are. Clients know we prioritize achieving their goals and growing their success. Employees know our culture and approach to business are built on a desire to provide an environment for everyone to flourish. Our commitment to quality is only as good as the people behind it— that’s why we welcome and develop passionate, hardworking, and proactive employees. We take pride in how our employee retention, robust benefits package, and company values have led to Kimley\-Horn’s placement on the Fortune “100 Best Companies to Work” list for 19 years! *Key Benefits at Kimley\-Horn** Exceptional Retirement Plan: 2\-to1\- company match on up to 4% of eligible compensation (salary \+ bonus) and additional profit\-sharing contribution. * Comprehensive Health Coverage: Low\-cost medical, dental, and vision insurance options. * Time Off: Personal leave, flexible scheduling, floating holidays, and half\-day Fridays. * Financial Wellness: Student loan matching in our 401(k), and performance\-based bonuses. * Professional Development: Tuition reimbursement and extensive internal training programs. * Family\-Friendly Benefits: New Parent Leave, family building benefits, and childcare resources.

jobs.title: Production Planning Manager
jobs.description: **About L \& L Fabrication, Inc.** The leading provider of engineering, fabrication, and technical services in the Rocky Mountain region, distinguished by our uncompromising standards in quality, advanced innovation, and customer\-centric solutions. ### **Production Planning Manager** ### **Description** ***About L\&L Fabrication*** L\&L Fabrication is a Rocky Mountain region ASME\-certified pressure vessel and process equipment manufacturer serving the oil and gas industry. From our fabrication shops in Wyoming and Colorado, we build pressure vessels, heater treaters, separators, and process skids for a consistent regional customer base. We run a relationship\-driven operation — our customers come back because we deliver on our commitments and build equipment they can stake production on. We carry a high\-volume, high\-complexity active backlog across multiple facilities simultaneously. Getting the right work to the right shop at the right time — and telling Sales what we can actually commit to — is one of the most valuable things this role will do for the business. ***The Role*** We're looking for a Production Planning Manager to own production schedule visibility, capacity forecasting, and delivery commitment communication across our fabrication facilities. This is a newly created role — one that fills a real and immediate gap in how we run the business — and the right person will have a direct, measurable impact on our ability to grow. You'll be the bridge between our shop floors and our Sales team. You'll know how far each facility is booked out, where the constraints are, what we can realistically commit to and when, and you'll lead the daily conversations that keep production, procurement, and sales aligned around the same picture. This is a builder role. You'll be creating the planning system, the scheduling infrastructure, and the data discipline that L\&L needs to scale from here. The foundation exists — strong shop leadership, a Smartsheet\-based tracking platform, and an experienced engineering team — but the forward\-looking capacity and scheduling function needs an owner. That's this job. ***What You'll Do*****Production Scheduling \& Capacity Visibility*** Own the production schedule from outside sales commitments through internal shop execution across our Douglas, WY and Northern Colorado facilities. * Maintain accurate, real\-time visibility into how far each facility and key workcenter is booked out — weld booths, downstream stations, and assembly. * Track each job through the full production sequence: ¦ *Not Started ? Welding ? Hydro ? Sandblast/Paint ? Rigout ? Electrical ? Insulation ? Final QC ? Ready to Ship** Identify schedule risks, bottlenecks, late\-job exposure, and capacity constraints before they reach customers. * Validate job status, workcenter dates, part numbers, and scheduling assumptions in our scheduling platform daily. **Capacity Forecasting \& Level Loading*** Perform capacity forecasting across weld booths, welders, downstream workcenters, and material constraints at each facility. * Evaluate level\-loading opportunities between Douglas and our Northern Colorado facility to balance workload and protect delivery performance. * Monitor material readiness for long\-lead items — heads, shells, specialty components — against forecasted weld start dates. * Track empirical production performance using actual start and completion dates by workcenter to continuously improve forecast accuracy. * Review staffing, booth capacity, material readiness, and downstream workcenter needs against the forward schedule and flag gaps proactively.**Sales \& Leadership Communication*** Provide Sales with clear, realistic delivery time frames based on actual shop capacity and current backlog — not estimates based on gut feel. * Lead and support daily production scheduling meetings with production leadership, project management, and shop teams. * Communicate schedule changes, risks, and recovery plans early and accurately — to both internal teams and as supporting data for customer conversations. * Give leadership clear visibility into backlog, booked\-out capacity, and bottlenecks through consistent reporting. **Systems \& Continuous Improvement*** Own the day\-to\-day accuracy of scheduling data within our Smartsheet platform and help evolve the scheduling logic, forecasting views, and reporting tools as the business grows. * Improve coordination between Sales, production, procurement, and project management through better data and more disciplined scheduling processes.* Help evaluate and shape our technology direction as we grow — including whether and how scheduling and ERP tools evolve.### **Requirements** *What We're Looking For****Required**** 5\+ years of production planning, scheduling, or manufacturing operations experience in a job\-shop, make\-to\-order, or custom fabrication environment. * Experience in weld fabrication, pressure vessel manufacturing, industrial fabrication, or O\& gible based on company financial results and individual performance * Benefits: Health, dental, and vision insurance per company plan * Time Off: Paid time off per company policy * Mileage: Reimbursement for multi\-site travel Why this role matters: L\&L has the customer relationships, the engineering capability, and the production capacity to grow significantly from here. What we don't have yet is the production planning infrastructure to systematically translate that capacity into reliable delivery commitments. This person builds that. The impact is immediate, the role is visible to leadership, and the opportunity to shape how the planning function works at a growing fabricator is real. ***About L\&L Fabrication*** L\&L Fabrication is an ASME\-certified pressure vessel and process equipment fabricator with facilities in Douglas, WY and Northern Colorado. We serve the Rocky Mountain oil and gas industry with pressure vessels, heater treaters, separators, and process skids built to ASME code. Our team includes engineers, certified welders, QC inspectors, and production professionals who take pride in building equipment that operators rely on. We're a relationship\-driven company. Our customers come back because we build it right and deliver when we say we will. This role is about making sure that second part — delivering when we say we will — gets better every year. ***How to Apply*** Send your resume and a brief description of the production scheduling or capacity planning work you're most proud of to kvetter@lnlfab.com. We review applications on a rolling basis and will reach out to qualified candidates promptly. L\&L Fabrication is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and are committed to building a team that reflects the communities where we operate. *This job posting describes the general nature and level of work for this position and is not an exhaustive list of all responsibilities.***Benefits (Available following the Probationary Period)*** HSA and PPO Health Insurance plans * Dental and Vision Plans * Accident and Critical Illness Plans * 401k with up to a 5% safe harbor employer match * Life insurance * AD\&D policy provided by the organization and expandable * Ken Garff Ford – Fleet Vehicle access for purchase * Advocacy and partnership via Benefit Partner * Paid Leave/Paid Time Off Policy that is in alignment with CO\-FAMLI (CO ONLY) * Others added frequently. *Application Deadline: All applications must be submitted by****\[insert date, e.g., December 31, 2025]****.**IF VOID OF A FUTURE DATE ABOVE \-****APPLICATIONS ARE ACCEPTED ON AN ONGOING BASIS*** *How to Apply:** *Complete the application form available at this job board or at www.lnlfab.com/careers/* * *Submit your resume and any required or maintained certifications kvetter@lnlfab.com* * *For assistance: contact kvetter@lnlfab.com* *Internal Posting: This position is being posted internally and externally. All current employees will be notified of this opportunity on the same day it is posted. Employees interested in applying should follow the same application process outlined above.* *Post\-Selection Notice: Within 30 days of filling this position, all employees who will work with the selected candidate will receive written notice including:** *The candidate’s name* * *Previous job title and new job title* * *Information on how to express interest in similar future opportunities* *L\&L Fabrication, Inc. is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all applicants and employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.* **The pay range for this role is:** 80,000 \- 110,000 USD per year(Douglas) 80,000 \- 110,000 USD per year(Evans) 80,000 \- 110,000 USD per year(Loveland)

jobs.title: LSC/MSC Engineer
jobs.description: **Date:** 30 Sept 2026 **Location:** DE **Company:** LTTS Grid\-Side Converter Control Consultant with strong expertise in grid\-forming (GFM) and grid\-following (GFL) control strategies, MATLAB/Simulink\-based model development, and real\-time validation of converter controls for renewable\-energy and power\-electronics applications. This role focuses on the development, modelling, and validation of control algorithms for grid\-connected converters, including weak\-grid stability, synchronization, and grid\-code\-related performance. Key Responsibilities 1\. Grid\-Side Converter Control Development * Develop and refine grid\-forming control strategies, including VSM\-type control, droop control, and other voltage\-forming algorithms. * Design grid\-following control loops, covering active/reactive power control, current regulation, and sequence\-component\-based controllers. * Ensure converter stability and robustness under weak\-grid conditions, grid disturbances, and low short\-circuit\-ratio operation. 2\. Synchronization \& PLL Development * Develop and validate advanced PLL architectures (e.g., SOGI\-PLL, CDSC\-PLL, adaptive PLLs) for disturbed or weak grids. * Evaluate synchronization performance across various grid conditions including dips, unbalance, harmonics, and dynamic frequency changes. 3\. MATLAB/Simulink Modeling \& Simulation * Build and maintain detailed converter, network, and controller models in MATLAB/Simulink and related toolchains. * Conduct small\-signal stability analysis, impedance\-based assessments, harmonic studies, and transient simulations. * Use MIL/SIL/HIL workflows to ensure accuracy from model to implementation and support system\-level optimization. 4\. Real\-Time Validation \& Hardware\-in\-the\-Loop Testing * Validate control algorithms using real\-time simulators such as Typhoon HIL, dSPACE, OPAL\-RT, or RTDS. * Reproduce grid\-disturbance scenarios including islanding, fault ride\-through, harmonic distortions, frequency deviations, and resonance issues. * Verify robustness and compliance across a wide range of operating conditions. 5\. Weak\-Grid Engineering \& Stability * Analyze converter\-grid interactions, resonance behavior, and control\-loop sensitivity under weak\-grid conditions. * Develop mitigation strategies such as adaptive current control, virtual impedance, damping algorithms, and enhanced synchronization filters. * Support design decisions related to filter tuning, grid\-compliance behavior, and multi\-converter interoperability. 6\. System Integration \& Cross\-Functional Support * Collaborate with electrical, software, and system\-engineering teams on grid\-converter interfaces. * Support commissioning activities, troubleshooting, parameter tuning, and compliance\-driven testing. * Prepare high\-quality documentation, simulation reports, stability assessments, and validation packages for internal and external stakeholders. Required Skills \& Experience * Strong background in power electronics, grid\-connected converters, and renewable\-energy integration. * Expertise in grid\-forming and grid\-following control concepts, including dq0\-based current control and voltage\-forming control structures. * Proficiency in MATLAB/Simulink, model\-based development, and converter\-grid interaction modelling. * Experience using HIL/CHIL platforms for real\-time testing (e.g., dSPACE, RTDS, Typhoon HIL, OPAL\-RT). * Solid understanding of PLL systems, harmonic behavior, weak\-grid dynamics, and grid\-code\-related control functions. * Minimum 3 years of industry experience in converter control, power electronics, or grid\-integration engineering. Summary of Core Competencies The ideal candidate brings: * Strong knowledge of grid\-forming and grid\-following converter control strategies. * Expertise in MATLAB/Simulink modelling, analysis, and control\-algorithm development. * Experience with real\-time testing * Robust understanding of power electronics, control loops, and dynamic grid behavior. At least 3 years of relevant industry experience.

jobs.title: Shopify Frontend Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description: **Shopify Frontend Full Stack Engineer** About Last Bottle Wines Last Bottle Wines is a California\-based direct\-to\-consumer wine retailer operating more than 2 dozen Shopify storefronts across multiple brands — Last Bottle Wines, Last Bubbles, First Bottle, and 2Tier Trading. We move fast, operate lean, and obsess over the intersection of great wine, smart logistics, and exceptional customer experience. Our technology team builds and owns the systems that make that possible. The Role We're looking for a seasoned Shopify frontend full\-stack engineer who can own the storefront layer end\-to\-end — from Liquid/Hydrogen templates and custom Shopify Functions through backend integrations with our OMS (Linnworks), shipping platform (WeShip), and data infrastructure (Supabase / FastAPI / Prefect). You'll work directly with the Director of Technology Operations and be a key driver in our push to reduce agency dependency and bring more technical work in\-house. This is not an 'apply a theme and tweak CSS' role. You'll be architecting checkout extensions, building headless commerce features, writing macros, and shipping production code across a multi\-brand storefront estate. What You'll Own**Storefront \& Theme Development*** Own and evolve Liquid themes across all LBW Shopify Plus storefronts * Build and maintain Shopify Functions (discounts, shipping, payment customizations) * Develop Checkout Extensions using Shopify's UI Extensions framework * Implement and maintain metafield/metaobject schemas for product tagging across multiple brands * Coordinate multi\-storefront deployments with zero cross\-brand contamination **Headless \& API\-First Work*** Build and maintain Python and React middleware layers interfacing with the Shopify Storefront API and Cart API * Design and implement Shopify webhook consumers in FastAPI / Python * Maintain and extend GraphQL integrations with Shopify Admin API * Contribute to headless subscription infrastructure (Stripe\-based wine club) **Integrations \& Backend*** Extend Linnworks OMS integrations — macros, order sync, digital twin logic (Merge Order, SetOrderGeneralInfo patterns) * Contribute to the unified shipping integration platform (AfterShip, WeShip, Klaviyo event plumbing) * Write and maintain Python data pipelines for analytics and operational workflows * Participate in PostHog/Datadog/Supabase analytics instrumentation across storefronts **Technical Operations*** Own vendor security reviews and forensic audits of third\-party Shopify apps * Enforce and extend the multi\-brand product tagging schema and Shopify Function conventions * Document architecture decisions and maintain internal runbooks * Support DTC compliance tooling (CCPA/CPRA flows, state\-level checkout extensions) Requirements**Must\-Haves*** 4\+ years of Shopify theme development (Liquid, Dawn or equivalent base theme) * Strong JavaScript / TypeScript; React (hooks, functional components) * Shopify Plus experience — multi\-store, B2B, Checkout Extensibility * Shopify Functions development (GraphQL input/output, WASM constraints) * Python 3\.x for backend services and scripting (FastAPI a strong plus) * REST and GraphQL API design and consumption * Experience with headless commerce architectures (Storefront API, Cart API) * Supabase or PostgreSQL for data modeling and querying * Git\-based workflows, CI/CD, and production deployment discipline * Ability to read and write Shopify Admin API GraphQL mutations cold **Strong Pluses*** Linnworks OMS / WMS — macro development, SQL Server queries, API integrations * Python orchestration for data pipelines * Klaviyo event and flow architecture for transactional/behavioral email * AfterShip or similar tracking/returns platform integrations * React Native development for commerce applications * Stripe Subscriptions / Billing Portal integration * PostHog / Datadog analytics instrumentation and event schema design * DTC wine industry familiarity (compliance, carrier restrictions, age verification) * Monday.com automation or API usage **Who You Are*** You ship. You don't wait for perfect specs — you prototype, validate, and iterate. * You own your work across the full stack. Bugs don't belong to someone else's lane. * You read vendor documentation and API changelogs before asking for help. * You have strong opinions about code quality but pragmatic judgment about tradeoffs. * You communicate clearly in writing and don't need daily standups to stay aligned. Compensation \& Benefits * Base salary:$120,000\-$135,000 (Exempt) \+ Bonus potential * Benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, and 401K with company match * PTO: Paid Time Off (accrual starts upon employment) \+ 10 paid holidays * Remote\-first with optional Napa/Bay Area in\-person collaboration * Employee wine purchase program How to Apply Send a resume and a brief note covering: (1\) the most complex Shopify Plus integration you've shipped, (2\) your experience with multi\-storefront deployments, and (3\) any OMS or warehouse system integrations you've owned. Code samples or GitHub links welcome. We review applications on a rolling basis. No recruiters or staffing agencies, please.

jobs.description: Requisition ID 204453 Date posted 09/22/2026 Work Location Model On\-site Flex Work Location Waltham\-MA Work Country United States **About the Role** ------------------ We are seeking an experienced Computational Software Engineer to help develop the next generation of physics\-based semiconductor process simulation technologies. This position is based in Lam Research's Greater Boston area engineering office, where you will work alongside software developers, computational scientists, and semiconductor process experts developing advanced modeling solutions for next\-generation semiconductor manufacturing. This role focuses on the development of advanced feature\-scale simulation software that predicts the evolution of nanoscale semiconductor structures during plasma etch, deposition, and other manufacturing processes. You will work at the intersection of software engineering, computational physics, and semiconductor process technology. The successful candidate will contribute both to the scientific modeling of plasma\-surface interactions and to the design and implementation of high\-performance simulation software used by researchers, process engineers, and product development teams. This position requires a unique combination of strong software development skills and a deep understanding of the physical processes that drive feature evolution during semiconductor manufacturing. describing plasma\-surface interactions, surface chemistry, material transport, and profile evolution. * Translate physical theories, experimental observations, and mathematical models into robust, production\-quality software. * Collaborate with plasma physicists, process engineers, computational scientists, and product teams to improve model fidelity and predictive capability. * Develop numerical algorithms for geometry evolution, particle transport, surface reaction kinetics, and related multiphysics phenomena. * Optimize simulation performance for modern computing architectures, including multicore CPUs and GPU\-based systems. * Validate model predictions against experimental and metrology data. * Contribute to software architecture, testing frameworks, code reviews, and
