jobs.title: Software Development Engineer
jobs.description: **Software Development Engineer** Precision Analytical (PA) is the creator of the DUTCH Test, an innovative hormone test that creates better tools for healthcare professionals to explore hormone issues with their patients. PA exists to make it easier for patients and their healthcare providers to find answers to complex clinical questions. We are fully committed to our mission of providing the best diagnostic tools in functional medicine. This position is located in McMinnville, Oregon, in the beautiful Willamette Valley. This is a hybrid role. We are seeking candidates who can work effectively from both a home office and our McMinnville office or other worksites. **Compensation \& Benefits** At PA, we base our pay ranges on the market median of similar jobs, as determined by third\-party salary benchmark surveys. The salary range reflects the minimum to midpoint of the salary range to provide room for growth. Your individual pay will vary based on skills, experience, and internal equity. During your initial interview with the Talent partner, you can expect to have an open discussion about your pay expectations. **With a career at PA, you get:*** Market\-based competitive wage * Bonus potential * 401(k) with employer contribution * Medical, dental and vision insurance * Company\-paid life insurance * Wellness program * Onsite gym * Paid time off * Holiday \& Floating holiday * Casual work environment * Employee assistance program * Free DUTCH Tests * …and more! **About the Role** We're rebuilding our architecture from the ground up, and we're looking for a Software Development Engineer to help shape it. You'll design, build, and ship scalable cloud\-native applications with a focus on AWS serverless, event\-driven architecture, and TypeScript/Node.js, while drawing on solid experience with traditional application architectures too. **Who You Are** You're a hands\-on engineer with a curious streak. You've opened up a codebase, asked "why does it work like this?", and then actually gone and found out. You're equally comfortable with serverless and traditional architectures, and you know when each one is the right tool. You enjoy hard problems, ambiguous requirements don't rattle you, and you care about how your code connects to the business it serves. When you dig into an existing system, you can tell the difference between what the business actually needs and what someone bolted on years ago as a workaround. **What You'll Do** Most of your work will be building new systems, and those systems will need to integrate closely with our existing applications and platforms. That means designing clean, well\-defined integrations that keep our architecture flexible as it evolves. On our small team you won't be siloed: you'll have a hand in every stage of the software lifecycle, from shaping requirements to shipping to production. This role reports to the VP of Technology. **Major Duties and Responsibilities*** Help shape our new architecture from the ground up, choosing between serverless, containerized, and traditional approaches, and between monolithic and microservice designs, based on what each problem actually needs * Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable, cloud\-native applications using AWS and modern software development practices * Build serverless and event\-driven systems using AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, and Step Functions, as well as ECS and Docker containers * Apply distributed\-system patterns such as pub/sub, saga, idempotency, retries and dead\-letter queues, and CQRS to build reliable and resilient systems * Develop infrastructure as code using AWS CDK and/or SAM * Build backend services and applications using TypeScript/JavaScript and Node.js * Design and work with both relational SQL databases and NoSQL databases, including DynamoDB * Apply strong software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, algorithms, complexity analysis, software design patterns, SOLID principles, and separation of concerns * Use sound judgment when applying design patterns, recognizing when a pattern improves maintainability and when it introduces unnecessary complexity * Participate in Git\-based development and pull\-request workflows, including code reviews and collaborative problem solving * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and automated testing, including unit, integration, and characterization testing * Analyze existing applications and workflows to understand their business logic, identify the true business rules, and translate them into modern cloud\-native designs * Design integrations between new services and existing applications and platforms, including data synchronization and migration between database platforms * Monitor and troubleshoot applications using AWS observability tools such as CloudWatch and X\-Ray, along with structured logging and other appropriate practices * Apply sound IAM and cloud security fundamentals when designing and implementing AWS solutions * Collaborate with technical and non\-technical stakeholders to clarify requirements, explain trade\-offs, and make practical decisions * Stay current with emerging development tools, including AI\-assisted coding and AI application development, and apply them thoughtfully with appropriate review and testing * Contribute to LLM\-powered applications, including RAG pipelines, vector search, MCP servers, agent tooling, and evaluation of LLM output quality, as applicable to business needs * Contribute across the technology stack as needed, including frontend development, infrastructure, data, and direct interaction with users **Qualifications*****Required**** The ideal candidate will have 5\+ years of professional software development experience and a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field; equivalent education and experience may be considered * Hands\-on experience building AWS serverless and event\-driven applications, including Lambda, API Gateway, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions, ECS, and Docker * Experience designing and building with both serverless and traditional application architectures, and the judgment to know when each is the right fit * Strong experience with TypeScript/JavaScript, Node.js, SQL, and NoSQL databases such as DynamoDB * Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, complexity, software design patterns, SOLID principles, and separation of concerns * Experience with AWS CDK/SAM, Git, pull\-request workflows, CI/CD, and automated testing * Understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and resilient architecture, including pub/sub, idempotency, retries, dead\-letter queues, saga, and CQRS * Ability to work effectively with existing systems, including reverse\-engineering business logic and using characterization testing to capture current behavior ***Preferred**** Experience with React/Next.js, Python, Java, AWS observability and security, and software development in healthcare or other regulated industries * Experience integrating new cloud\-native services with established applications, including data synchronization and migration between platforms * Experience using AI coding tools effectively and critically reviewing generated code * Experience building LLM\-powered applications, including RAG, embeddings/vector search, MCP servers, agent tooling, and LLM evaluation * Familiarity with C\#/.NET, Angular, Azure, Jira, and Confluence **Work Environment** This position is in an office (or a home) environment with frequent use of a computer and related hardware. A person must be able to stand and/or sit; see, hear and talk; use hands to type, handle or feel tools or controls; use hands and arms to reach. Occasionally lifting/moving up to 30lbs is also required. In addition, this position may require a person to travel via car, airplane, and other modes of transportation to various sites including Precision Analytical locations, stores or vendor locations, training or meeting venues, or conferences. **EEO Statement** All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability, or any other factors prohibited by law.

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description: **Company Overview** Promise modernizes how government agencies and utilities support people in financial difficulty. We build technology that makes it simple for residents to receive benefits, engage with assistance programs, set up flexible payment plans, and stay on track—while helping agencies increase efficiency, recover revenue, and deliver services with dignity. Our mission is to transform public systems so they work better for everyone, especially the most vulnerable. Our team includes experts from companies like Palantir, Google, Stripe , and esteemed government leaders. We work hard and believe deeply in what we do. We're looking for excellent people to build innovative, resilient technology. Backed by over $50 million in funding from top investors – such as Reid Hoffman, Howard Schultz, Michael Seibel, Y Combinator, 8VC, The General Partnership, First Round Capital, Kapor Capital, XYZ Ventures, and Bronze Investments – Promise has been recognized as one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies of 2022,” “Forbes Next Billion\-Dollar Startups 2024,” and Y Combinator’s \#1 GovTech startup. **About the Role** As a **Deployment Strategist** at Promise, you own real world outcomes. You'll work hand in hand with government and utility customers to deeply understand their problems, then find solutions that actually deliver results. This is a hands\-on role that blends several skillsets: delivering an excellent customer experience, deeply understanding a real world problem, holding a bar for disciplined execution across the team, and driving business growth. The people who succeed here show up, get into the details, deliver, and leave customers who remember them. You'll need to operate comfortably without a lot of structure. We move fast and figure things out as we go. If you need a defined process handed to you before you can execute, this isn't the right seat. **What you'll do** * Own the customer relationship end to end, from implementation through renewal and expansion. Be the person the customer trusts and wants in the room, and the person internally who's easy to work with too. * Read the room, both the customer's team and your own. Understand who has influence, who's a blocker, and how to move a project forward politically as well as technically. * Get into the weeds of the customer's data and operations until you understand their business as well as they do. * Be technically fluent enough to partner closely with Forward Deployed Engineers on delivery and innovation. * Drive customer work through a lens of revenue growth. You should be able to explain the health of an account in financial terms, not just delivery or project status. * Run projects with real discipline. Track detail, hit milestones, and don't let things slip. * Surface what you're seeing in the field to influence product. You're close to the customer, which makes you a source of real signal. **What will help you succeed** * 3\-10 years in a role where you actually drove outcomes, not just managed process. Consulting, implementation, or customer\-facing delivery, ideally in SaaS, fintech, or govtech. * A track record of building things without being told to, and getting comfortable in ambiguity fast. If your background is a large, slow, highly structured organization, be honest with yourself about whether you'll thrive here. * Genuine likability. Customers and colleagues should want to work with you, not just respect your output. * Comfort with budgets and numbers. You should be fluent enough in revenue and account economics to make decisions with them, not just report them. * Willingness to travel and be onsite. Some of the best work here happens in person, and it's part of the job. * The instinct to want this exact role. We're looking for someone who wants to go deep on deployment and customer impact, not someone using this as a stepping stone into engineering or product. ### **Who Thrives at Promise** ### **You’ll love it here if:** * You are energized by **big, complex challenges** and the opportunity to solve them. * You want your work to have a real**, measurable impact** on people’s lives. * You **take ownership** and run toward problems, not away from them. * You value **clear, candid, and constructive communication.** ### **Promise is not for you if:** * You prefer **hierarchy and rigid structures.** We operate with **freedom and responsibility.** * You are **uncomfortable with change.** We move fast, adapt often, and expect agility. * You want a **typical corporate culture.** We are mission\-driven, ambitious, and direct. * You believe **efficiency means “doing less.”** We believe **efficiency means doing better.** ### **How We Enable Our People** * 100% paid health coverage * Flexible time off (take what you need) and sick leave * Lunch, snacks, and coffee provided in office * Company retreats * Hybrid work: we deeply value in\-person collaboration and are in\-office at least 3 days a week, but are flexible on what people need Promise is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against any applicant or employee because of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, genetic information, age, or military or veteran status. Additionally, the Company complies with applicable state and local laws governing non\-discrimination in employment in every jurisdiction in which it operates. Promise is committed to promoting diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We also provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities, pregnant individuals, and those with sincerely held religious beliefs, in accordance with applicable laws. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accommodations@joinpromise.com. Promise engages in US government contracts and restricts hiring to US persons, which includes US citizens and permanent residents (e.g., Green Card holders). Additionally, candidates must reside in the US. Promise participates in E\-Verify. To learn more, view E\-Verify Participation Notice and Right to Work Notice. Compensation Range: $150K \- $210K

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Immuware) - Remote, US
jobs.description: **Location** ------------ Remote \- US **Employment Type** ------------------- Full time **Location Type** ----------------- Remote **Department** -------------- Technology **Deadline to Apply** --------------------- August 25, 2026 at 12:00 AM CDT **Compensation** ---------------- * $120,000\.00 \- $140,000\.00 $120K – $140K The posted range represents the typical compensation range for this role. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, location, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, and alignment with market data. Additional benefits are shared as part of the job posting. Propelus® simplifies workforce compliance management across healthcare. Our innovative technology and strategic partnerships empower millions of professionals, their employers, and regulators to work together, creating a connected and efficient healthcare ecosystem. As a trusted leader for over 20 years, Propelus has focused on bringing more good into the lives of the people and organizations serving healthcare. We deliver seamless compliance solutions to millions. We leverage market\-leading technology and essential data to simplify complex operations, reduce risk, and champion a safer, healthier, and happier workforce. **About the Role:** ------------------- Immuware's customers, including Employee Health nurses; occupational health managers; and compliance professionals, work in one of the most requirement\-heavy environments in healthcare IT. Regulations shift. Organizational structures change. New workflows emerge. Each of these changes often means hands\-on work is needed inside their Immuware environment. The **Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)** exists to meet that need. *You are both technically driven and a proactive, friendly, and compelling person.* You will be embedded in the post\-sales customer experience, you are *not* an account management, *not* executing billable project work, and *not* break\-fix support. You show up on customer calls, quickly understand the technical needs of a health\-system nurse manager and what they are trying to accomplish, and provide the polished product quickly, ensuring a positive experience. **What You'll Do:** ------------------- As our **Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)** you will be the proactive technical resolution of customer problems end to end: From meticulously understanding the clients needs and proactively building those solutions, you ultimately serve as the bridge between customer needs and internal product and engineering teams. You're measured on customer outcomes, not on activity. *This role partners closely with our Customer Success Managers, who own the overall customer relationship, strategy, and commercial outcomes.* ### **Technical Solutioning \& Building** * **Lead regular** (often weekly) **technical working sessions** with customers to address actively evolving needs driven by regulatory changes, organizational shifts, and workflow updates. * **Identify, configure, script, and write code to solve customer needs:** workflow setup, rule\-building, field configuration, user and role management, reporting, data corrections, integrations, and small platform changes. * **Translate complex Employee Health requirements** (OSHA compliance, state\-specific immunization mandates, system credentialing workflows, and the like) into solutions that actually work for our clients, in the Immuware platform. * **Question their requirements and requests:** Serving as the techncial expert, professionally challenge requests that don't serve the customer's real goal, and choose the simplest solution that solves the underlying problem to improve efficiency operationally. * **Thoroughly document your solution** designs in Notion, while updating live items in Jira, to ensure they are clear, well\-scoped bug reports and feature requests that are repeatable and transferable to enable engineering efficiency. * **Generalize your work:** Turn one\-off fixes into reusable templates, decision trees, or product improvements so the next customer benefits. * **Triage** net\-new module or record\-type additions that need a formal Letter of Work (LOW) and/or an ARR change (expansion) to CSMs and Professional Services. ### **Customer Partnership** * **Serve as the technical counterpart to CSMs** on customer calls: CSMs handle the relationship; you independently handle "how do we make it work." * **Navigate internal client change:** working alongside the CSMs, lead deeper, in\-depth customer education beyond basic platform navigation, run workflow specific walkthroughs, and re\-train as staff turnover and organizational change creates knowledge gaps. * **Serve as the technical expert:** build trusted\-advisor relationships with power users and technical contacts at customer organizations. + Proactively identify configuration gaps or risks before they turn into escalations, and execute solutions to maintain  the expenses and experiences you value most. * **Employee Assistance Programs:** provides **24/7/365 support** by phone and online — family clinical counseling, legal \& financial services, plus child and elder care referrals. * **Carrot Fertility \& Hormonal Support:** Inclusive hormonal health, fertility, and family\-building benefits with **funds toward eligible care**. * **Beyond Med:** A licensed **discount plan organization (DPO)** giving you access to elective care like acupuncture, dermatology, fertility, GLP\-1, and more — at discounted rates. * **Spot Pet Insurance:** A financial safety net for your furry family. Get reimbursed for emergencies, lab fees, behavior, x\-rays, surgeries, cancer, and more. **LATAM (Costa Rica and Colombia) Employees:** * Your health is our top priority! We cover 100% of employee health insurance premiums. Our plans include national and international coverage, so you're protected no matter where you are. * **Propelus Flex Club**: Our flexible benefits platform gives you monthly points to redeem on what you need most. Plus, you'll get access to exclusive discounts just for being part of our team. (Details are country specific) * **Generous PTO:** + **National Holidays (Colombia):** 18 days + **National Holidays (Costa Rica):** 12 days + **Birthday Holiday**: Your birthday deserves celebrating! You get **1 paid day off during your birth month**, separate from your PTO. + **Volunteer Time Off:** 16 hours available to you, that allow you to make an impact on causes that are meaningful to you. + We've got you covered with a life insurance policy, paid 100% by the company. You can also add your beneficiaries at an exclusive, discounted rate. + **Carrot Fertility \& Hormonal Support:** Inclusive hormonal health, fertility, and family\-building benefits with **funds toward eligible care**. **Benefits and Perks for ALL Propelus employees include but are not limited to:** A remote first company, global and distributed, with two office locations for those nearby who want a change of scenery. * A remote first company, global and distributed, with two US office locations for those nearby who want a change of scenery, and one in CO and CR. * Employees celebrating their 10 and 20 year work anniversary are eligible to take a trip sponsored by Propelus within one year of their 10th and 20th anniversary date. * Awarded one of BuiltIn's 2025 Best Places to Work and honored as a Silver Stevie® Award Winner in the 2025 Stevie Awards For Great Employers. * Professional development allowance to help you grow in the ways that mean the most to you. * **Typical Interview Process:** * Interview \#1: Brief intro screen with our People Ops team * Interview \#2: Introduction with the Hiring Manager * Interview \#3: Team Panel * Interview \#4: Alignment interview with Senior Leadership If you don’t move forward to the next round, we’ll make sure you know as soon as possible. Tips for applicants: Focus on your application. At Propelus, everyone has an equal opportunity based on their merit. Reaching out to the team or providing referrals will not change your chances. We work remotely and communicate asynchronously, so writing is a key skill at Propelus. Please answer the application questions with your own thoughtful responses. Replies like "See resume" or N/A won't lead to an interview. Have some fun with it, we actually read these! *We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at Propelus. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Candidates from all backgrounds are encouraged to apply.* *Full\-time positions are scheduled to work 40 hours per week, M\-F unless required otherwise by projects. Part\-time positions are scheduled to work a maximum of 30 hours per week. Equipment, benefits, and perks are not provided to part\-time or temporary employees.* Compensation Range: $120K \- $140K

jobs.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Prophetic Software is not able to sponsor employment visas now or in the future. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without current or future sponsorship to be considered for this role.** **About Prophetic:** Real estate development is a multi\-billion\-dollar industry that has run on fragmented data, manual processes, and gut instinct for decades. Prophetic is changing that. We're building the AI\-native platform that enables homebuilders, developers, and investors to find, analyze, and act on land opportunities from a single system — powered by proprietary technologies that process billions of data points across all 50 states. We are the market leader in our space, and our customers don't just use the product — they love it. We're not making teams more efficient. We're changing how they operate. Prophetic is scaling fast — demand is outpacing our ability to hire, and we're just getting started. This is a once\-in\-a\-lifetime team: sharp, low ego, deeply collaborative, and obsessed with building the best product in the industry. You'll own features end\-to\-end, from database to UI, and ship code that supports customers making million\-dollar land acquisition decisions. **What You'll Do:** * Build and ship full\-stack features across our core platform using modern backend and frontend frameworks. * Design and optimize database schemas for geospatial queries across large datasets. * Write production\-quality code that deploys through our CI/CD pipeline. * Collaborate with product, design, and account management to translate customer needs into shipped features. * Use AI tooling as part of your daily development workflow — our engineers approach writing code. * AI\-first.Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and on\-call rotation. **What You Need:** * 3\+ years of professional software engineering experience with Python and TypeScript/React, or similar. * Strong experience with relational databases and RESTful API design. * Comfort working across the full stack — you can build a backend endpoint and the frontend component that consumes it. * Experience shipping features in a production environment with CI/CD pipelines. * Comfort with AI development tooling. * Strong sense of product ownership. Familiarity with a fast\-paced startup environment. **Nice to Have:** * Experience with geospatial data (parcel data, map layers, or simiar). * Experience with major cloud platforms.Background in proptech, real estate, or construction technology. **Why Prophetic:** * The team. Our customers make million\-dollar decisions on our platform. Your work matters immediately. * AI\-native product and AI\-native workflows. Leadership shares the financials, the strategy, and the hard calls with the whole team. * High growth, high demand. The product works, customers love it, and we are hiring to keep up. No shortage of opportunity here. * Flexibility. Remote, hybrid, or in\-office with a great Portland, OR headquarters. * Self\-starters who thrive in ambiguity. We're a startup. If you need someone to tell you what to do every morning, this isn't the place; if you come alive solving hard problems with smart people, it is. **Benefits (US\-based Full\-time):** * 100% medical, dental \& vision insurance coverage for you; 30% coverage for dependents * Competitive salary and meaningful early\-stage equity * Unlimited PTO * Hybrid/Remote stipend * In\-office perks: snacks, drinks, coffee, ping\-pong table, and more — plus cuddles from Olive, our in\-office Doberman! * Budget for intra\-office travel * 2–3 annual team meetups in person **How We Work:** These four themes are how we think, build, and lead: * Truth — Say the hard thing. We get the details right. * Velocity — Speed compounds. Waiting doesn't. We ship daily and launch features every two to three weeks. * Ownership — Own it, then solve it. We own outcomes, not tasks. If something's broken, we fix it. EEO: Prophetic Software is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants, and we make employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran or military status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. jobs.title: Critical Operations Manager
jobs.description: **Who we are:** =============== As a global leader in digital infrastructure, QTS designs, builds and operates advanced data centers that support strategic AI, cloud and digital transformation initiatives. We are driven by a mission to connect the world for good and our people make it possible. Every single day, the creativity, dedication and genuine care for our communities are what push us forward and make this a truly special place to be. The Critical Operations Manager is responsible for the Data Center facility technical strategy, continuous improvement, and development support. This role will support the electrical, mechanical, FLS (Fire, Life, Safety), and DCIM (Data Center Infrastructure management) platforms, and building and housekeeping items from a site operations standpoint. This role will collaborate with the Engineering Manager on technical operations and daily facility needs. This role will own the strategic projects and continuous improvement site items. This leader should have experience with mechanical and electrical data center infrastructure, codes, regulations, required and applied safety standards and practices, as well as data center remote hands and customer support. This role will oversee the teams who perform preventative and corrective maintenance on critical mechanical and electrical equipment. This role will suggest, plan, and implement measures that increase the energy efficiency of the facility. This role requires on\-site work hours to support a 24X7X365 data center environment and is not eligible for remote and/or hybrid work. **Essential Duties And Responsibilities \-** Other duties may be assigned. * Maintain, establish, and implement facility policies, procedures and organizational structure within the boundaries established by senior management team and corporate policy while ensuring no contradiction in federal, state, and local operating regulations or laws. * Develop and maintain efficient maintenance matrixed operations utilizing maintenance governance, standards utilizing in\-house staffing and vendor support to provide 100% up\-time of all mechanical, electrical, life safety, monitoring, and control systems. This includes, but is not limited to, developing, and coordinating maintenance agreements, maintenance procedures, testing procedures, inspections, reporting, and accounting practices. * Development of emergency response planning, response management and reporting of incident and emergency situations for all mechanical, electrical, associated controls and plumbing systems. * Develop, direct, and monitor short\-term and long\-range business plans consistent with overall profit and growth objectives of the company that establishes operations standards for cost control, waste reduction, quality, safety, and an environmentally friendly community partner. * Manage and oversee the execution of building and site cleanliness and preservation operations. * Development and management of an effective operating and capital budget. * Oversee operations budget to ensure compliance with organizational expenditure requirements. * Partner with Development, Sales, Implementation, and Solutions Engineers to deploy and maintain customer environments. * Conduct Sales and Customer tours and audits. * Ensure the pro\-active delivery of corporate services support, power services, COT (Critical Operations Technicians) headcount projections, planning, budgeting, capital projects, maintenance, and business continuity/disaster recovery. * Help negotiate improvement project contracts as needed on leased and owned real estate. * Confer with professional operations staff subject matter experts (SME’s) to find resolution to operational problems, develop and authorize operational procedures and approve all major estimates. * Utilize comparative evaluations between mechanical, electrical, and controls systems performance and key performance indicators to monitor the effectiveness of operational programs through benchmarking and the utilization of best practices. * Ensure facilities’ mechanical, electrical, controls, monitoring, and fire\-life safety systems compliance with all governmental regulatory operating guidelines. * Obtain and keep current all necessary licenses, permits and certifications as required. * Supervise, train, develop and coach employees. * Works with direct reports to establish performance goals, monitors progress, and advises on ways to enhance their professional development and success. * Facilitate Data Center space and cable plant design, implementation, and maintenance. * Ensure teams performing equipment installs, managing tickets, communicating, completing tasks pertaining to computer hardware and/or software, and all incidents are resolved in a timely manner. **Basic Qualifications** ------------------------ * Five or more years workplace or professional equivalent experience. * Five or more years people leadership experience. **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Seven or more years data center environment or professional equivalent experience. * Five or more years people leadership experience in a data center environment. * Bachelor or Master degree in Business, Engineering, Architecture, Military Schooling, or professional equivalent experience **Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities** ------------------------------------ * Exceptional customer service * Ability to analyze the operation of various systems, determine the cause of any problems or malfunctions and take corrective action as required. * Ability to manage complex situations during off management hours \- single point of contact. * Strong written, verbal, and interpersonal skills * Ability to effectively lead a team environment. * The ability to acquire and apply job\-related knowledge within set guidelines and expectations. * Position may involve frequent typing, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, bending, reaching and lifting. Lifting requirements may range from 10 lbs. \- 50 lbs. on a regular basis, with heavier weights done in conjunction with other individuals or lifting aids. **Total Rewards****:** ---------------------- * 25 days annual leave * 5,250 EUR training bursary * Company car scheme \- eligibility required * Pension scheme with Allianz * Occupational disability allowance * Voluntary health insurance * Voluntary pet insurance * This position in bonus and equity eligible The duties and responsibilities described here are not exhaustive and additional assignments, duties, or responsibilities may be required of this position. Assignments, duties, and responsibilities may be changed at any time, with or without notice, by QTS in its sole discretion. We provide individuals with disabilities reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment in accordance with applicable law. Please contact us to request an accommodation on TalentAcquisition@QTSDataCenters.com

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, paid time off, and retirement plan.* **Work Requirements:** This role is considered an on\-site position located in **Cupertino, CA, USA OR San Diego, CA, USA** * You must be able to commute to and from the location with your own transportation arrangements to meet the required working hours. * Shop floor environment, which may include but not limited to extensive walking, and ability to lift up to 40 lbs. **Benefits begin on day one:** * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance * Employer paid Life Insurance, Short\- \& Long\-Term Disability **Work Experience** **About the Role** You'll be the day to day owner of build promotion, deployment coordination, and incident triage for a major release. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - Data Cloud
jobs.description: **About Rippling** Rippling is the first way for businesses to manage all of their HR \& IT—payroll, benefits, computers, apps, and more—in one unified workforce platform. By connecting every business system to one source of truth for employee data, businesses can automate all of the manual work they normally need to do to make employee changes. Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can just click a button and set up a new employees’ payroll, health insurance, work computer, and third\-party apps—like Slack, Zoom, and Office 365—all within 90 seconds. Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1\.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes. We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses. **About the Role:** The Data Cloud team is building an end\-to\-end analytics and business intelligence system for our customers and will replace their need for Data Lakes, Data Warehouses and data pipelines. We are building systems for ingestion, transformation, lineage, data catalogs and visualization. jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer- Safety Experience
jobs.description: San Mateo, CA, United StatesEngineeringID: 44385 Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators. At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there. A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone. **WHY SAFETY?** At Roblox, we strive to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and the Safety organization’s mission is to become the leader in civil immersive online communities. We systematically detect, remove, and prevent problematic content and behavior, and we make Roblox accounts secure and free from compromise. We cover a broad area of the tech spectrum, including machine learning, classifiers for 3D models, experimentation, automation, detection workflows, and AI\-powered text filters. Aligned and partnering with product teams, we use this toolbelt to discover new opportunities, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build safety products, and measure the impact on our community of users and developers. In doing so, we keep Roblox safe, civil, and inclusive, and we foster positive relationships between people around the world. **WHY Safety Experience?** Safety is paramount at Roblox, and it shows up in everyday human moments. A rating left on a game. The words a Customer Care agent chooses when replying to a report. Whether a suspended account feels like a fair call or an arbitrary one. How fast someone gets back into an account they thought was gone for good, guided by an agentic Customer Care experience. Every one of these moments runs through systems we build: our tools, our data pipelines, our audit trails. We are looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Safety Experience team within the Trust \& Safety organization. In this role, you will revolutionize Roblox users' perception of safety by developing agentic applications and complex technical solutions at scale. **You Will:** * Design and build agentic workflows and technical solutions for both customer facing applications and internal use cases. * Stay familiar with recent trends in LLMs and develop innovative solutions and features for the chatbot, while optimizing for cost. * Influence the team's roadmap and long\-term strategy in collaboration with product, operations, and other cross functional stakeholders to develop the next generation of safety experience. * Provide technical leadership, influencing decisions within and beyond the pod * Mentor junior engineers to strengthen their technical skills and support their professional growth. **You Have:** * A Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or a related field, with a minimum of 8 years of hands\-on experience. A graduate degree is highly preferred. * Proven experience developing innovative solutions using LLMs is required. * Extensive experience with modern programming languages such as C\#, Java, Python, or similar, with a strong emphasis on writing efficient, maintainable, and scalable code. * In\-depth knowledge of contemporary software design patterns, including microservice architecture, RESTful APIs, and Remote Procedure Calls (RPC), with a proven track record of building robust and scalable systems. * Demonstrated ability to develop end\-to\-end solutions for complex technical challenges, collaborating across multiple teams from conception through to launch. * Proven experience developing innovative solutions using LLMs is highly desirable. * Prior experience in machine learning is helpful. **You Are:** * **A Technical Leader:** You have initiated and facilitated challenging technical solutions. Your technical expertise influences product direction. You foster a culture of technical excellence. * **Versatile:** You're a jack of all trades and you are comfortable with several languages and technologies already; you are adaptable in any situation. You are resourceful, and take a creative and strategic approach to solving hard problems. * **Analytical**: Excited to investigate large, ambiguous problems, and quantify the problems and the solutions. * **User Oriented:** You always start with the needs of the user, whether they are Roblox users or internal engineers before architecting a solution. * **Team Oriented:** You lift up your peers and find ways to make the team stronger. For roles that are based at our headquarters in San Mateo, CA: The starting base pay for this position is as shown below. The actual base pay is dependent upon a variety of job\-related factors such as professional background, training, work experience, location, business needs and market demand. Therefore, in some circumstances, the actual salary could fall outside of this expected range. This pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. All full\-time employees are also eligible for equity compensation and for benefits as described on **this page**. Annual Salary Range $295,250—$345,040 USD Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted). jobs.description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Job Description **Position Overview** As a Senior Software Engineer at Rockwell Automation, you will work on FactoryTalk Optix, industry\-leading visualization software, known for its flexibility and ease\-of\-use. These applications can be deployed to various targets, including OptixPanels, ASEM 6300 industrial computers or user\-provided machines running Optix Runtime Tools on either Windows or Linux. You will be a key player in subsystem design, implementation, and testing. You will play an active role in all the stages of the development lifecycle and support your team throughout the process. You will also help ensure that developed products meet requirements and are within total quality management standards. You will collaborate with multiple global teams. You will also perform intermediate\-level software testing tasks including test development, planning, scheduling, and execution. When you join our software development group, you become part of a team that believes in knowledge sharing and collaboration and that is committed to using reliable and well\-thought\-out engineering and software development practices (such as Agile/SCRUM and SAFe) and technology to overcome any challenge. We are looking for someone who will utilize a diverse set of technical backgrounds and opinions by fostering a team\-oriented environment and the use of open and direct communications, integrity, and respect. You will also seek knowledge of new developments in software engineering, computer engineering, and test automation fields and will identify and pursue career development opportunities. You will report to a Software Engineering Manager. **Your Responsibilities:** * Collect, contribute to and document requirements for a feature and its components, ensuring the information required to develop software and corresponding test cases are contained in the specifications * Develop new subsystem designs or contribute to existing ones ensuring they meet the established requirements * Implement and document code that meets the requirements of the software design * Develop and execute detailed unit test plans; report, analyze, debug and correct anomalies * Participate in reviews of documents, designs, code, test cases and user documentation * Estimate, plan, develop, and execute test suites, test cases and automated tests to ensure appropriate functional test coverage is attained * Ensure documented test cases and specifications validate documented software requirements * Perform product testing, reporting on problems encountered and documenting test results for follow\-up * Determine the origin and cause of anomalies identified * Build relationships and interact with peers to ensure assigned tasks are prioritized * Initiate or contribute to software development capability improvements in software development practices, development tools, and test automation * Perform research and explore new avenues to solve challenges by utilizing the latest technologies and standards * Communicate and convey design concepts, both verbally and in writing * Work with complex control system concepts * Mentor other engineers on the team **The Essentials \- You Will Have:** * Bachelor's Degree or equivalent years of relevant work experience * Legal authorization to work in the US is required. **The Preferred \- You Might Also Have:** * Typically requires 4 years of relevant technical experience * Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent * Experience in a software product development environment * Experience with C\+\+, C\# and Typescript programming languages * Experience with Qt, .NET, and React frameworks * Experience creating, configuring and managing container infrastructure (Kubernetes, Helm, Docker) * Experience designing, developing, and maintaining applications that leverage MariaDB, including database schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning. * Experience using AI Models for design, debugging and implementation * Experience creating or updating GitHub Actions * Experience with Visual Studio and Visual Studio Code IDEs * Experience documenting and reviewing designs * Familiarity with Linux/WSL **What We Offer:** * Health Insurance including Medical, Dental and Vision * 401k * Paid Time off * Parental and Caregiver Leave * Flexible Work Schedule where you will work with your manager to enjoy a work schedule that can be flexible with your personal life. * To learn more about our benefits package, please visit at www.raquickfind.com . This position is part of a job family. Experience will be the determining factor for position level and compensation. *At Rockwell Automation we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right person for this or other roles.* \#LI\-Hybrid \#LI\-LifeAtRok \#LI\-SB1 We are an Equal Opportunity Employer including disability and veterans. If you are an individual with a disability and you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation during the application process, please contact our services team at \+1 (844\) 404\-7247\. Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, Hardware Design (AI2540)
jobs.description: **Job Title: Staff Engineer, Hardware Design** **Job Location: San Jose, CA (This position requires a full\-time, on\-site presence in our San Jose, CA office)** **Job ID: AI2540** **Job Description:** We are seeking a Staff ASIC Design Engineer with deep expertise in RTL design and ground\-up block\-level silicon development. The ideal candidate will own complex design blocks from microarchitecture and RTL implementation through verification support and silicon bring\-up. This position offers the opportunity to shape and influence the design architecture and methodology of SiMa's silicon in a fast\-paced startup environment. **Areas of Focus:** * Own microarchitecture definition and RTL implementation of complex blocks from concept through silicon. * Drive ground\-up block design, owning each block from specification and microarchitecture to RTL, integration, and bring\-up. * Develop high\-quality, synthesizable RTL (Verilog/SystemVerilog), including custom logic, protocol adaptation, and data\-path optimizations. * Define block\-level interfaces, microarchitectural trade\-offs, and design specifications. * Collaborate with verification, physical design, architecture, and firmware teams to ensure each block meets functional, timing, power, and area targets. * Drive block\-level synthesis, timing closure, and DFT readiness. **Key Requirements:** * Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field. * 5\+ years of experience in ASIC design, with a strong focus on block\-level RTL design and silicon development. * Proven track record of ground\-up block design, taking blocks from microarchitecture and RTL through to working silicon. * Expert\-level RTL design skills (Verilog/SystemVerilog), with hands\-on experience in synthesis, timing closure, and DFT concepts. * Strong understanding of microarchitecture trade\-offs, data\-path and control logic design, and block\-level optimization for power, performance, and area. **Nice to Have:** * Experience designing hardware for machine learning / AI accelerators. * Experience designing hardware for complex algorithms * Experience integrating blocks into larger SoCs. * Exposure to firmware or driver development **Personal attributes:** Can\-do attitude. Strong team player. Curious, creative and good at solving problems. Execution and results\-oriented. Self\-driven, Thinks Big and is highly accountable. Good communication skills. The annual salary for this position ranges from $136,900 \- $219,000\. The actual annual salary offered will depend on several factors, including \- among others \- job\-related skills, experience, technical expertise, qualifications, work location, and business needs. The annual salary range for this position is subject to change and may be adjusted in the future. In addition to base salary, this role is also eligible for private company equity, and a comprehensive package of employee benefits. Please note that the salary ranges listed for U.S. roles reflect base salary only and do not include equity or other forms of compensation. **EEO Employer:** SiMa is an equal opportunity employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, Veteran status, or any other protected classification.

jobs.title: R&D Test Operations Supervisor
jobs.description: **Building the people that build the world.** With platforms in HVAC and Detection and Measurement, SPX Technologies builds innovative solutions that enable a safer, more efficient, sustainable world. Through our RiSE talent development framework, we Reach, Identify, Strengthen, and Engage our employees to support them in their continued development. We’re a global company of problem solvers, collaborators, and innovators, and our businesses build solutions that impact the world. As part of HVAC Cooling, SPX Cooling Technologies is a leader in high quality industrial HVAC equipment used to cool large facilities like hospitals, data centers, and power plants. With cooling towers, fans, and refrigeration units, companies rely on brands like Marley, Recold, and SGS to provide comfort and mission critical and industrial cooling solutions. **How you will make an Impact (Job Summary)** SPX is a diverse team of unique individuals who all make an impact. As a Test Operations Supervisor, you will be responsible for leading the day\-to\-day planning, scheduling, coordination, and execution of R\&D testing activities to ensure personnel, equipment, facilities, and customer priorities are aligned for safe, efficient, and successful test execution. This role directly supervises Engineering Technicians, owns the Master Test Schedule, and coordinates staffing, test resources, equipment availability, and facility capacity across multiple projects. Working closely with Project Engineers, the Engineering Manager – R\&D Test Center, Maintenance \& Capital Projects Manager, and other stakeholders, the supervisor proactively resolves resource and scheduling conflicts, maintains test readiness, and communicates operational impacts. Success in this role requires strong people leadership, technical and operational judgment, customer focus, and a continuous improvement mindset focused on safety, schedule performance, resource utilization, and test execution. This role promotes innovation and continuous improvement in testing operations, develops technical capability within the team, and supports changes in equipment, controls, materials, and test methods that improve facility capability and performance. **What you can expect in this role (Job Responsibilities)** While each day brings new opportunities at SPX, your core responsibilities will be: * Test Planning, Scheduling \& Capacity * Develop, maintain, and communicate the Master Test Schedule, establishing daily, weekly, and monthly priorities based on customer requirements, business objectives, project needs, available personnel, equipment, and facility capacity. * Partner with Project Engineers and other stakeholders to understand test scope, requirements, timing, resource needs, facility readiness, and expected outcomes. * Plan and allocate technicians, test cells, laboratory space, equipment, instrumentation, and other resources required to execute scheduled testing. * Monitor schedule performance, capacity, and facility utilization; proactively identify conflicts, delays, and constraints and implement recovery or mitigation plans to maintain commitments. * Team Leadership \& Workforce Management * Provide direct supervision, daily work direction, prioritization, and workload management for Engineering Technicians supporting testing operations. * Organize and assign technician resources based on workload, technical skills, certifications, project requirements, and testing priorities while maintaining appropriate staffing and coverage. * Lead performance management, coaching, mentoring, training, cross\-training, employee development, and workforce planning to strengthen team capability and support succession needs. * Promote a culture of safety, accountability, teamwork, customer focus, engagement, and continuous improvement while partnering with Human Resources and leadership as appropriate. * Test Execution, Facility Readiness \& Stakeholder Coordination * Serve as the primary operational point of contact for test scheduling and resource planning, coordinating with Project Engineers, Engineering Technicians, facility resources, customers, and leadership to support successful test execution. * Ensure personnel, materials, equipment, instrumentation, engineering direction, and facility requirements are available and ready prior to testing; resolve gaps before they affect project schedules. * Coordinate testing schedules with maintenance activities, calibration requirements, capital projects, facility modifications, and planned outages to minimize disruption and maintain test capacity. * Communicate schedule status, resource availability, customer impacts, operational risks, and recovery plans in a timely manner while balancing customer expectations with facility capabilities and business priorities. * Operational Excellence, Equipment Readiness \& Continuous Improvement * Establish and maintain standard work and safe operating practices that support consistent, efficient, and *Required Experience \& Skills** * 5–8\+ years of experience in testing operations, engineering laboratories, manufacturing/industrial operations, product development, or a similar technical environment. * 2\+ years of demonstrated leadership or supervisory responsibility. * Strong leadership and employee development skills with the ability to direct, coach, mentor, and develop technical personnel. * Strong planning, scheduling, capacity planning, and organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple projects and competing business demands. * Technical aptitude and working knowledge of testing operations, laboratory workflows, engineering test requirements, equipment, instrumentation, materials, and facility resource needs. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and decision\-making skills with the ability to anticipate operational constraints and resolve scheduling and resource conflicts. * Effective written, verbal, and presentation communication skills with the ability to manage customer expectations and communicate across technical, operational, and leadership audiences. * Demonstrated commitment to safety, quality, accountability, customer focus, continuous improvement, and operational efficiency. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and familiarity with project scheduling, resource planning, ERP, SharePoint, or other work management and tracking tools. * Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced, hands\-on laboratory and testing environment and support test setup or operation when business needs are required. **Ideal Experience \& Skills** * Experience in HVAC, industrial, laboratory, or product testing environments and experience directly supervising Engineering Technicians preferred. * Experience with equipment calibration programs, preventive maintenance coordination, project/resource planning systems, and continuous improvement initiatives preferred. **Education \& Certifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Engineering Technology, Operations Management, Industrial Technology, Business Management, or a related discipline preferred; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered. **Travel \& Working Environment** * Onsite office environment, Monday – Friday * The position may require working occasionally outside normal work hours. * Lifting up to 70 pounds. * Bending and stooping. * Ability to communicate effectively verbally. * Working at heights less than 50 feet above ground. * Work with exposure to bad weather and/or excessive heat. **How we live our culture** Our culture is at the center of what we do and, more importantly, who we are. Whether you are an individual contributor or you lead a large team, each of us leads at SPX. **What benefits do we offer?** We know that the well\-being of our employees is integral. jobs.title: Electrical Designer
jobs.description: Overview: The semiconductor industry is experiencing one of the largest periods of growth and transformation in its history, and Tool Install design sits at the center of it. At SSOE, we design systems that connect some of the world's most advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment to the facilities that power tomorrow's technologies. From tool hookups and utility systems to subfab design, cleanroom modifications, and equipment integration, our work directly impacts the production of next\-generation chips used in AI, data centers, autonomous vehicles, consumer electronics, and advanced computing. Recognized as one of the industry's leading semiconductor design firms, SSOE combines deep technical expertise with a culture built on innovation, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Here, you'll work alongside some of the brightest minds in engineering, leverage cutting\-edge digital and AI\-enabled tools, and contribute to projects that are shaping the future of technology. If you're looking for meaningful work, technical challenges, and a place where your ideas matter, you'll find it at SSOE. As an **Electrical Designer** at SSOE, you'll work alongside experienced engineers, project managers, and multidisciplinary design teams to develop electrical designs for tool installations, power distribution, cleanroom environments, and facility upgrades that enable next\-generation technology manufacturing. In this role, you will be involved in electrical design, focusing on low to medium voltage environments. The ideal candidate possesses experience with distribution panel loading, short circuit analysis, voltage drop calculations, conduit and conductor sizing, and cable tray fills. You will have access to industry\-leading tools, collaborative leadership, and a firm culture consistently recognized as a Great Place to Work. Join us in shaping innovative design\-build projects with a relentless commitment to quality, efficiency, and collaborative excellence. AI and Innovation: At SSOE, we don’t just talk about the future, we build it. As a leader in industry AI adoption, we empower our team to work smarter by providing responsible access to the industry leading AI Large Language Models, vibe\-coding platforms, and securely integrating advanced tools into every role. From day one, you’ll receive the training and support needed to leverage AI as a core tool for enhancing productivity, sparking creativity, and streamlining complex workflows. Responsibilities: * Develop detailed electrical design drawings and technical documentation that support areas such as process equipment installation design packages, tool hookup design, subfab rack and lateral design, and cleanroom and facility modification support. * Determine conduit, conductor, and wire sizing, meticulously accounting for current loads and environmental variables. * Assess cable tray fills methodically to guarantee proper cable management, organization, and future scalability. * Perform detailed short circuit calculations to accurately determine fault currents, select appropriate protective devices, and ensure system safety and reliability. * Perform precise voltage drop calculations to ensure electrical system stability and compliance with industry standards. * Ensure all electrical designs strictly adhere to pertinent local, state, and national electrical codes and regulations. * Apply established electrical design techniques, such as load flow analysis and fault current calculations, and exercise discernment in adapting and modifying design concepts as needed. Uphold quality control by adhering to company and team electrical design standards and industry best practices. * Will work with other Designers, Sr. Engineers, Project Managers, and other stakeholders on specific assigned objectives, complex features, and aid in deriving possible solutions to unusual problems. * Foster collaboration, communication, strategy, and support within your team, multidisciplinary groups (Mechanical, Structural, Process/Chemical, Architectural, etc.), and inter\-company teams to optimize efficiency, quality, and resource allocation. Qualifications: * High school diploma or GED is required. An Associate degree in engineering or architectural fields is preferred. * Demonstrated proficiency in AutoCAD is required. Experience with other tools such as Revit, ETAP, SKM PowerTools, and/or EasyPower is a plus. * Ability to produce power distribution schematics, panel schedules, lighting and grounding plans, and other system diagrams aligned with industry standards and client criteria. * Proficient in interpreting electrical one\-line diagrams, creating construction documents, and collaborating within multidisciplinary project teams. * Knowledge of electrical codes and standards (e.g., National Electric Code, NFPA, etc.). * Salary Range: $50,000 \- $100,000/year depending on location, education, experience, and any certifications that are directly related to the position. * Benefits: Includes comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, life insurance, 401K retirement savings plan (with company matching), opportunities for professional development and training (including support for relevant licensure \& certifications), and generous PTO \& paid holidays. Join us at SSOE, where your expertise will thrive in a dynamic and collaborative environment. SSOE doesn't just hire talent, we invest in it. If you're passionate about innovation, career progression, and eager to make a significant impact, we invite you to apply and become a part of our forward\-thinking team. \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.title: Electrical CAD/BIM Designer
jobs.description: #### **Electrical CAD/BIM Designer** At Salas O’Brien we tell our clients that we’re engineered for impact. This passion for making a difference applies just as much to our team as it does to our projects. That’s why we’re committed to living our values every day: inspiring, achieving, and connecting as shared owners of our success with a focus on a sustainable future. Building for the long\-term means that all of our team members can expect to work on amazing projects with a people\-first approach to problem solving. It also means that each member of our team has truly limitless potential to build a unique, meaningful, and high\-impact career—and they’ll receive great total rewards along the way. #### **About Us** Founded in 1975, Salas O’Brien is an employee\-owned engineering and professional services firm focused on achieving impact for our clients, our team, and the world. We know that tomorrow’s requirements are today’s opportunities, and we are here to design lasting solutions for pressing challenges. We work across a variety of industries providing integrated engineering and consulting services. Our specialized experience includes design for data centers, healthcare, science and technology, high\-rise buildings, clean energy, education, and other building types as well as structural and building sciences, infrastructure asset management, advanced robotics, and more. jobs.title: Senior Principal AI Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: SambaNova is a leader in next\-generation AI infrastructure, delivering a full\-stack inference platform for customers worldwide. At the core of SambaNova's technology is the RDU (Reconfigurable Dataflow Unit) — a chip built on a dataflow architecture rather than the traditional GPU model. Its decode performance is especially strong for agentic workloads like multi\-turn agents, code generation, and long\-running applications. RDUs are packaged into SambaRack, rack\-scale hardware that lets customers deploy state\-of\-the\-art models with better performance, greater energy efficiency, and faster time to value. We are looking for a Senior Principal AI Solutions Engineer: a hands\-on technical leader who sets the technical direction for our solutions portfolio and still builds. This is someone who can go from a customer problem to a polished, working, agentic application in days, and then harden it for production. You will work across the whole modern AI stack: open\-weight models, agent frameworks and tool use, self\-improving evaluation loops, multimodal and voice pipelines, and the front end that makes it all usable by knowledge workers. You will lead hands\-on engagements with our most strategic customers, mentor and raise the bar for the wider solutions team, and feed what you learn back into the platform. **Responsibilities** **Build agentic and self\-improving systems** * **Agentic AI Architecture:** Design and build single\- and multi\-agent systems with planning, tool and function calling, MCP, memory, and long\-running workflows that are reliable enough for production • **Self\-Improving Systems:** Build feedback loops that make agents better over time, including automated evals, LLM\-as\-judge, trace\-driven prompt and program optimization (e.g. DSPy\-style), synthetic data generation, and fine\-tuning from production signals * **Evaluation and Observability:** Set up eval harnesses, tracing and guardrails so customers can measure quality, cost and latency, and trust what they deploy **Get the most from open models** * **Open\-Weight Model Expertise:** Choose, adapt and combine open models (e.g. Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, gpt\-oss, Gemma, GLM) for customer use cases, including LoRA/PEFT fine\-tuning, distillation and model routing * **Performance and Benchmarking:** Benchmark end\-to\-end solutions, not just tokens per second, and show where fast inference changes what an application can do * **Model Integration:** Validate new models and capabilities on SambaNova's platform stack and report gaps to Product and Engineering **Ship full\-stack vertical solutions** * **Front\-End and Product Build:** Build polished, usable web applications (e.g. React/Next.js, TypeScript) that non\-technical knowledge workers can adopt, not just notebooks and APIs * **Vertical Knowledge Work:** Build domain solutions for areas such as financial services, legal, healthcare, public sector and research: document analysis, research agents, RAG and knowledge assistants, report generation and workflow automation * **Multimodal Solutions:** Build vision\-language and document\-understanding pipelines (OCR, charts, forms, images, video) combined with agentic reasoning * **Audio and Voice:** Build real\-time voice agents and audio pipelines (ASR, TTS, speech\-to\-speech, streaming and turn\-taking) where low latency is the product **Lead with customers and shape the platform** * **Solutions Technical Strategy:** Set the technical direction for the solutions portfolio: which agentic, multimodal and vertical patterns we invest in, the shared frameworks and components we build, and the engineering standards they meet * **Technical Leadership and Mentorship:** Act as the senior technical authority across solutions engineering; review designs, mentor engineers and lift the quality of everything the team ships * **Executive Engagement:** Act as the trusted technical advisor to customer CTOs and AI leaders on architecture, build\-versus\-buy and scaling AI across the enterprise * **Customer Engagement:** Lead technical discovery, workshops, hackathons and hands\-on co\-builds with strategic customers, from prototype to production * **Reference Architectures:** Publish reference architectures, starter kits, open\-source examples and best\-practice guides that scale beyond each engagement * **SambaStack Tooling:** Develop tooling and automation for SambaStack deployment, management and integration * **Product Feedback:** Feed what you learn in the field (model requests, feature gaps, developer experience) into the model roadmap and platform priorities * **Thought Leadership:** Represent SambaNova through demos, talks, blogs and community contributions **Requirements** **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Statistics or a related field * 8\+ years (IC5\) or 10\+ years (IC6\) of industry experience in software, ML or solutions engineering, including 3\+ years building LLM\-based applications that reached production * Proven experience building agentic systems: tool and function calling, multi\-agent orchestration and frameworks such as LangGraph, CrewAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK or equivalent • Hands\-on experience with open\-weight models: serving, prompting, fine\-tuning (LoRA/PEFT) and evaluation • Strong full\-stack skills: expert Python plus modern front\-end development (TypeScript, React/Next.js), APIs and cloud deployment * Experience designing evals and benchmarks for LLM applications, covering quality, latency and cost • Excellent customer communication, with the ability to lead workshops and explain architecture to both executives and engineers * A track record of technical leadership across teams: setting architecture direction, mentoring senior engineers and owning outcomes for strategic accounts **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience building self\-improving or learning systems: prompt/program optimization, RL from feedback, synthetic data pipelines or continual fine\-tuning * Experience building real\-time voice agents (e.g. LiveKit, Pipecat, WebRTC) and working with speech models (ASR/TTS) * Experience with multimodal and vision\-language models and document\-understanding pipelines • Domain experience in one or more knowledge\-work verticals (financial services, legal, healthcare, public sector, scientific research) * Familiarity with inference frameworks (vLLM, SGLang, TensorRT\-LLM) and hardware\-aware performance tuning * Experience with MCP, RAG at enterprise scale, and agent security and guardrails • Open\-source contributions, public demos or technical content in the AI community **Submission Guidelines** Please note that in order to be considered an applicant for any position at SambaNova Systems, you must submit an application form for each position for which you believe you are qualified. **EEO Policy** SambaNova Systems is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard basis of age (40 and over), color, disability, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, national origin/ancestry, race, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding), sexual orientation, and any other applicable status protected by federal, state, or local laws. **Benefits Summary for US\-Based, Full\-Time Employment Positions** SambaNova offers a competitive total rewards package, including the base salary, plus equity and benefits. We cover 95% premium coverage for employee medical insurance, and 77% premium coverage for dependents and offer a Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contribution. We also offer Dental, Vision, Short/Long term Disability, Basic Life, Voluntary Life, and AD\&D insurance plans in addition to Flexible Spending Account (FSA) options like Health Care, Limited Purpose, and Dependent Care. Our library of well\-being benefits available to you and your dependents includes a full subscription to Headspace, Gympass\+ membership with access to physical gyms, One Medical membership, counseling services with an Employee Assistance Program, and much more.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer – CNC & Automation
jobs.description: Sesto Synergy designs and manufactures custom wedding rings in our Rochester workshop. As we grow, we are looking for a hands\-on Manufacturing Engineer to help develop new products, improve our machining processes, and build smarter, more automated production systems. This is not a traditional desk engineering role. You will work directly with CNC machines, CAD/CAM, tooling, electronics, software, and our production team to turn ideas into reliable manufacturing processes. What You’ll Do Your role will combine **CNC manufacturing, product development, process improvement, and automation.** * Design custom rings and components using CAD * Create CAM programs and program CNC lathes for custom and new products * Develop tooling, fixtures, workholding, and machining processes * Set up, prove out, troubleshoot, and optimize CNC programs * Improve feeds, speeds, cycle times, quality, and process reliability * Take new designs from concept through prototype and production * Develop and improve production stations and equipment * Automate manual manufacturing processes * Integrate lasers, scanners, cameras, sensors, motors, and other equipment * Build solutions using Raspberry Pi, microcontrollers, PLCs, or similar hardware * Use software, networking, APIs, and AI tools to improve manufacturing systems * Own technical projects from problem identification through implementation and ongoing support Once a process is established and repeatable, production operators can take over routine machine operation. Your focus will remain on **developing, improving, and troubleshooting the process.** Who We’re Looking For You may come from manufacturing engineering, CNC programming, machining, mechatronics, robotics, mechanical engineering, automation, or a similar technical background. Experience with several of the following is valuable: * CNC lathe programming and G\-code * Fusion 360 or similar CAD/CAM software * CNC setup, tooling, workholding, feeds, and speeds * CAD and mechanical design * Precision machining and prototyping * Robotics or industrial automation * Raspberry Pi, Arduino, PLCs, sensors, motors, or controls * Python, networking, APIs, or internal software tools * AI\-assisted coding and development tools You do **not** need to know everything on day one. We care more about someone who can understand a problem, learn what is needed, build a practical solution, and take ownership of making sure it works reliably. A bachelor's degree is welcome but not required. Associate degrees, technical programs, machining experience, co\-ops, personal projects, and demonstrated industry experience are all valuable. We are ideally looking for someone with **2–5 years of hands\-on experience**, but proven ability matters more than years on a résumé. Why Sesto Synergy At Sesto Synergy, you won't be limited to one narrow engineering function. You will have the opportunity to work across **CNC machining, product development, automation, robotics, electronics, software, and AI** while seeing your projects implemented directly on the production floor. As the company grows, this role has the opportunity to develop into a key technical leadership position responsible for our manufacturing processes, automation, and production technology. Pay: $63,000\.00 \- $79,000\.00 per year Work Location: In person
