By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it's what we show up for every day. The Solution Lifecycle team is looking for a curious, growth\-minded Senior Software Engineer I to work on building the next generation of our platform while tackling meaningful distributed systems challenges alongside a talented engineering team. You will collaborate closely with product managers and fellow engineers through code reviews and architectural discussions. You will also work on the core infrastructure of Smartsheet, focusing on the reliability, stability, and scale of our foundational systems. This role is a perfect fit for a developer who has the software engineering basics down and wants to fast\-track their skills at the intersection of generalist backend engineering and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). This team practices mob programming for the majority of the workday. We operate through collective code ownership, meaning you'll be collaborating in real\-time with teammates most of the time—not working solo on isolated tasks. We focus on building high\-quality software while adhering to rigorous operational best practices. If you are passionate about continuous learning and ready to dive into the core foundation of our platform, we want to hear from you. #### **You Will:** * **Build Next\-Generation Backend Services:** Design and build scalable back\-end services for Smartsheet's next\-generation applications, solving complex distributed systems challenges while partnering closely with product management and other key stakeholders. * **Contribute to Core Infrastructure:** Help build and maintain the core infrastructure that serves as the backbone for Smartsheet. Maintain and scale a robust environment that ensures the foundational reliability, stability, and performance expected by all of our users. * **Contribute to Database \& Infrastructure Reliability:** Dive deep into system internals. With team support, you will contribute to managing and upgrading large\-scale database infrastructure, maintaining complex replication topologies, and automating core operations using AWS, Golang, MySQL, Terraform, Temporal, and GitLab\-CI. * **Collaborate via Mob Programming:** Work closely with the team every day in a real\-time development environment. Actively participate as both a driver and a navigator, asking questions, sharing ideas, and contributing directly to the team's collective code ownership.Take part in code reviews and architectural discussions as you work with other software engineers and product managers * **Practice High\-Quality Engineering:** Use Test\-Driven Development (TDD) to ensure our foundational systems are resilient before they ever touch production. Beyond the code, you will be an active participant in our team book clubs and psychologically safe retrospectives to help continuously elevate how we work. * **Use AI tools:** Actively use AI tools to improve personal and team efficiency across coding, testing, design, and troubleshooting, exploring AI integration opportunities within team processes and features, and coaching others on effective AI use * **Participate in On\-Call Rotations:** Share responsibility for operational health of our systems as part of a supportive on\-call rotation. You'll be ramped in gradually with experienced teammates available to help. #### **You Have:** * **Foundational Coding Skills:** 5 \+ years of experience and proficiency in at least one modern programming language. Go experience is a plus but not required—we'll teach you. Java, Kotlin or Python backgrounds translate well. * **Database \& Infrastructure:** 3\+ years of experience with cloud technologies (AWS, Azure, etc.) A strong desire to learn Infrastructure as Code (Terraform) and an eagerness to understand database internals and reliability (MySQL) * **Backend development:** 5\+ years software development experience building highly scalable, highly available applications. Experience developing, documenting, and supporting REST APIs * **Collaborative Mindset:** A genuine interest in team\-centric engineering practices. You should be comfortable (or eager to become comfortable) working in a mob programming environment the majority of the day, writing test\-driven code, and sharing system ownership. * **Problem Solving:** A critical thinker who enjoys troubleshooting complex technical problems and wants to understand how large\-scale systems maintain stability and scale. * **Communication:** Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the confidence to ask questions, participate in group discussions, and think out loud with your team. * **AI tools:** 1\+ year professional experience leveraging AI to improve personal productivity in service of building complex SaaS feature sets * **Education:** A BS or MS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical industry experience) * **US Work Eligibility:** Legally eligible to work in the U.S. on an ongoing basis **Get to Know Us:** At Smartsheet, your ideas are heard, your potential is supported, and your contributions have real impact. You'll have the freedom to explore, push boundaries, and grow beyond your role. We welcome diverse perspectives and nontraditional paths—because we know that impact comes from individuals who care deeply and challenge thoughtfully. When you're doing work that stretches you, excites you, and connects you to something bigger, that's magic at work. Let's build what's next, together. **Equal Opportunity Employer:** Smartsheet is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer committed to fostering an inclusive environment with the best employees. It is our policy to provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants in accordance with applicable laws in the US, UK, Australia, Germany, Costa Rica, Japan, Bulgaria, India, and Singapore. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know. \#LI\-Remote

jobs.title: Executive Editor, Science News Media Group
jobs.description: Society for Science is dedicated to expanding scientific literacy, access to STEM education and scientific research for more than 100 years. As a nonprofit 501(c)(3\) membership organization, our mission promotes the understanding and appreciation of science and the vital role it plays in human advancement: to inform, educate, and inspire. We are best known for our award\-winning magazine, *Science News*, our world class science research competitions and our outreach and equity STEM Programs making sure that every young person can strive to become an engineer or scientist. The Society is looking for an Executive Editor to support Science News Media Group. We value strong analytical and interpersonal skills, and the ability to contribute to a fast\-paced environment as an individual and as part of a team. To perform the job successfully, this candidate must be a visionary journalist who can play a leadership role in building the next iteration of our independent news organization and advancing our mission of connecting the public with accurate, engaging news of the latest in science, medicine and technology – a mission that is more important now than ever before. **Position Overview** --------------------- The executive editor is a creative thinker and problem solver who can develop innovative approaches in a rapidly changing news ecosystem and inspire a talented team of journalists to implement them. The executive editor plays a lead role in our daily news operations, coordinating editorial coverage across SNMG products and platforms, and working closely with writers, editors, designers, and producers to make coverage decisions. The ideal candidate knows how to engage audiences across internal and third\-party platforms and how to maximize engagement on each platform. The role also includes leading staff in developing special projects and major news event coverage. The executive editor manages newsroom processes to ensure that our workflows and policies align with SNMG editorial and business goals, and works with the editor in chief, publisher, business and advancement teams to support SNMG revenue goals. The executive editor works to unite teams towards our shared goals and to maintain our exceptional standards of accuracy as a trusted, unbiased source of the latest news in science, and how science helps us understand ourselves and the world around us. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Direct news coverage on multiple platforms, including print, digital, video and other multimedia, and social media * Set short\- and long\-term content goals and lead the newsroom in achieving those goals * Edit print, digital and multimedia stories as needed; ensure content is inclusive and reflective of our diverse audiences * Identify and implement innovative approaches to our journalism and storytelling that engages people with distinctive, high\-value content that answers questions they didn't know they wanted to ask * Work with the editor in chief and senior management team to establish an editorial strategy that aligns with the SNMG mission and the goals of growing audience and increasing loyalty * Oversee the implementation of the editorial strategy * Ensure that our content engages with audiences on the platforms and products that they prefer for getting news and information * Supervise managers and other staff members as appropriate * Leverage content alignment across our subject verticals and across properties, including Science News, Science News Explores and Science News Learning. * Support the editor in chief and publisher on funding proposals, ensuring that they align with SNMG editorial goals, and reporting to funders as needed * Support the publisher and business team in developing a business strategy and products that align with SNMG editorial goals * Uphold our exacting standards of accuracy, integrity and transparency * Identify opportunities to innovate around our mission **Qualifications** ------------------ * 10 years or more of leadership experience in a news organization * 7 years or more in digital media publishing * Substantial experience developing and editing multiple products and storyforms, including news, features and multimedia * Proven management/leadership track record * Experience developing and managing budgets * Direct experience in change management * Experience covering science, medicine and technology, or a strong interest/knowledge of the fields * Editorial strategy * Content strategy and implementation * Excellent editorial judgment, writing/editing skills * Understanding of digital media, visual journalism and multimedia, including emerging trends * Experience covering science, medicine and technology, or a strong interest/knowledge of the fields. * Ability to manage multiple projects concurrently in an extremely fast\-paced environment * Proficient at interpreting data and providing actionable recommendations based on learnings * Excellent communication and interpersonal  – 3:00 p.m. EST. Some light travel may be necessary for this position. **Salary** ---------- The salary range is $143,428 – $161,356\. **Physical Demands** -------------------- The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands and fingers to operate a computer and other office equipment. **Additional Information** -------------------------- Society for Science has mandated the COVID\-19 vaccine for employees coming into the office and attending Society events. Exceptions to the vaccine requirement may be provided to individuals for religious beliefs or medical reasons. **How to Apply** ---------------- To be considered for this position please upload a professional resume and cover letter that articulates your vision for the future of print journalism. Please apply through ApplicantPro. **Other Duties** ---------------- Please note this job description is not designed to cover every duty, responsibility and activity that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice. **Science News** ---------------- For more than a century, Science News journalists have covered advances in science, medicine and technology for the general public. We were founded as an independent nonprofit in 1921 by newspaper magnate E.W. Scripps and zoologist W.E. Ritter, who wanted to improve the quality and accuracy of science journalism and remain true to that vision today. Our mission is to provide independent, unbiased coverage of science and give people the tools to evaluate the news and the world around them. We connect with audiences through our print magazines–Science News and Science News Explores–and their associated websites–ScienceNews.org and SNExplores.org. While Science News is targeted to adults, Science News Explores (which launched online in 2003 and as a print magazine in 2022\) makes science accessible for young people ages 9 and up. Additionally, teachers and students in nearly 6,000 high schools read us in print and online through the Science News Learning program. Science News is published by the Society for Science, a nonprofit 501(c)(3\) organization dedicated to expanding scientific literacy, effective STEM education and scientific research through its award\-winning publications and world\-class science education competitions. **Society for Science** ----------------------- Founded in 1921, the Society for Science (Society), is a champion for science, dedicated to expanding scientific literacy, effective STEM education, and scientific research. Through its world\-class competitions, including the Regeneron Science Talent Search, the Regeneron International Science and Engineering Fair, the Thermo Fisher Scientific Junior Innovators Challenge, and its award\-winning magazines, Science News and Science News Explores, the Society, a nonprofit 501(c)(3\) membership organization, is focused on promoting the understanding and appreciation of science and the vital role it plays in human advancement: to inform, education, and inspire. **EEO Statement** ----------------- The Society is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer Society for Science \& the Public is committed to equal employment opportunity. In order to provide equal employment and advancement opportunities to all individuals, the Society does not discriminate against employees or applicants for employment on any legally recognized basis, including but not limited to: veteran status, race, color, religion, gender, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identify or expression, ancestry, national origin, disability, personal appearance, family responsibilities, matriculation, political affiliation, age and/or any other categories protected by the laws of the United States or the District of Columbia.

reporting * Exposure to simulation software, digital twin concepts, data visualization, predictive modeling, AI/ML concepts, SQL, Python, BI tools, or similar analytical methods * Experience working distribution environment **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in industrial engineering, systems engineering, robotics, computer engineering, information systems, * Must be 21 years old or older at the start of the program * Interest in solving operational problems through engineering, process improvement, technology, data, and practical solution design * jobs.title: Senior Manager, Recommendation Algorithms
jobs.description: ### **About Stitch Fix, Inc.** Stitch Fix (NASDAQ: SFIX) Stitch Fix is redefining retail by combining human creativity with advanced data science and Generative AI. As we build the future of personalized shopping, we're equally committed to building yours. We believe in investing in our team as much as our technology. Join us to be a trendsetter in the industry and help us redefine what's possible for our clients, while we help you reach your full potential. **About the Role** ------------------ The Recommendation Algorithms team powers personalized shopping experiences across Stitch Fix, using machine learning and AI to help clients discover items and outfits they'll love. The team turns model outputs, inventory, client context, and business objectives into relevant recommendations, rankings, search results, and personalized assortments across Fix and Freestyle. As the **Senior Manager, Recommendation Algorithms**, you will lead a team of Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers responsible for the strategy, development, and production performance of these client\-facing personalization systems. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Merchandising, Enterprise Analytics, and other Algorithms teams to improve recommendation quality, evolve our technical approach, and deliver measurable client and business impact. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * **Lead** the strategy and execution of client\-facing personalization across recommendations, ranking, search, discovery, outfits, and similar\-item experiences, balancing relevance, diversity, freshness, inventory availability, client context, and business objectives. * **Shape** the roadmap with Product, Engineering, Design, Merchandising, Analytics, and Algorithms partners, making thoughtful tradeoffs across client experience, stylist needs, inventory objectives, recommendation quality, and system complexity. * **Drive** rigorous experimentation and measurement through offline evaluation and online A/B testing, using metrics such as engagement, selection, keep rate, items sold, revenue, margin, and client satisfaction to guide decisions and improve outcomes. * **Own** the end\-to\-end algorithm lifecycle, from opportunity sizing and modeling through experimentation, production deployment, monitoring, and operational support, while partnering with Engineering to build scalable, reliable, observable, and explainable recommendation systems. * **Advance** how the team uses AI and emerging technologies, including generative AI and LLM\-based evaluation, to improve semantic understanding, recommendation and outfit quality, model evaluation, and team productivity while fostering a culture of technical excellence, ownership, learning, and collaboration. **About You** ------------- This is what you'll need to succeed in this role from day one. * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics, Operations Research, or another quantitative field; Master's degree or PhD preferred. * 5\+ years of experience designing and deploying machine learning solutions, ideally within recommendation systems, search, ranking, personalization, e\-commerce, or retail, with strong applied knowledge of areas such as candidate generation, scoring, ranking, retrieval, diversification, contextual personalization, search relevance, or multi\-objective optimization. * 2\+ years of experience as a technical lead or people manager, with a demonstrated ability to develop strong technical talent, lead through others, and build a culture of ownership and technical excellence. * Strong technical foundation in production machine learning, including the ability to write and review production\-grade code, ideally in Python, and experience with cloud infrastructure, distributed data systems, scalable ML architecture, experimentation, offline evaluation, and production monitoring. * Experience designing and interpreting A/B tests and evaluation frameworks, with the ability to connect model performance to client and business outcomes and communicate technical concepts, uncertainty, and tradeoffs to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Demonstrated ability to build trust and influence roadmaps across Product, Engineering, Analytics, Merchandising, and other cross\-functional teams. * Working knowledge of generative AI, AI\-assisted development tools, and emerging AI/ML approaches, with sound judgment around when these technologies add value alongside traditional machine learning and human expertise. **You'll love working at Stitch Fix because you will…** * Fuse human creativity and styling expertise to redefine personalized retail. * Set a high bar for our craft and drive measurable impact across fashion, tech, and data science. * Actively leverage AI and modern tech to evolve how work gets done. * Lead with innovation, think boldly, and aren't afraid to challenge conventional retail norms. * Win together in a collaborative, low\-ego environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated. * Be client obsessed by putting our customers at the heart of every decision to deliver unmatched personalization and trust. * Support our team with competitive compensation packages, comprehensive benefits, and meaningful career jobs.title: Automation Engineer III - Cruise Operations
jobs.description: TAIT partners with artists, brands, IP holders and place makers to bring culture\-defining, never\-before\-seen experiences to life. With a legacy of innovation spanning over 45 years, TAIT has grown from pioneering in rock ‘n’ roll concert staging to setting the global standard for extraordinary live events and experiences through cutting\-edge technology, precision engineering, and creative design. TAIT’s 20 global offices have developed iconic productions and experiences in over 30 countries, all seven continents, and even outer space for renowned performers, theme parks, exhibits, and venues across the globe, including partnerships with Taylor Swift, Cirque Du Soleil, Royal Opera House, Nike, NASA, Bloomberg, Google, Beyoncé, and The Olympics **Position Purpose** The Automation Engineer is a hands\-on, technically focused role responsible for the ongoing service, maintenance, troubleshooting, upgrades, and operational support of automation and control systems across live entertainment environments. This position ensures that show automation, motion, and safety systems remain reliable, safe, and fully functional throughout ongoing operations. A Level III is distinguished from Level II by advanced independent ownership of complex or high\-risk scopes, broader client and cross\-functional leadership, and consistent mentorship, standards ownership, and technical decision\-making. A key part of this role is supporting scheduled and reactive maintenance periods onboard cruise vessels, including working during limited\-access windows, shipboard maintenance periods, and other times when systems are taken offline for inspection, repair, testing, and upgrades. The Automation Engineer III must be comfortable working in time\-sensitive environments where access to systems may be limited and the ability to quickly diagnose and resolve issues is critical to maintaining operational readiness. Automation Engineers support systems beyond initial delivery—responding to operational issues, diagnosing faults, performing preventative maintenance, and implementing upgrades that improve reliability and system capability over time. The role requires strong technical judgment, problem\-solving skills, and the ability to work effectively in fast\-paced, time\-sensitive environments. The role partners closely with onboard teams, shoreside operations, Achieve teams, Engineering, Project Management, and client technical teams to resolve issues, minimize downtime, maintain system health, and implement improvements. The position requires strong technical judgment, hands\-on troubleshooting ability, clear communication, and a willingness to travel on short notice, including internationally and onboard cruise ships. An Automation Engineer operates at the intersection of technology, engineering, and live entertainment—ensuring complex automation and motion systems perform safely and reliably in environments where precision and uptime are critical. **Essential Responsibilities \& Accountabilities** * Provide on\-call and emergency technical support to client partners, responding to system faults, operational issues, and disruptions * Perform rapid triage and troubleshooting remotely and onsite to identify root causes and restore system functionality * Diagnose and resolve faults across automation, control systems, networks, drives, and safety systems * Plan and execute scheduled and reactive onsite service visits, including inspections, preventative maintenance, repairs, load testing, and system validation * Maintain and troubleshoot automation, control, mechanical, electrical, and electromechanical systems * Troubleshoot and repair mechanical systems, including rigging, gearboxes, brakes, alignment, and related equipment * Identify equipment wear, system degradation, recurring issues, and emerging risks, taking proactive action to prevent failures and minimize disruption to cruise operations. * Independently lead assigned cruise automation scopes from planning and testing through commissioning and final validation, including medium\-to\-large or moderate\-to\-high\-risk upgrades. Provide technical direction, coordinate cross\-functional support, and escalate only when risk, scope, or business impact requires broader leadership alignments * Deliver system upgrades, software updates, patches, Navigator and iQ updates, retrofits, and configuration changes in accordance with TAIT standards and client requirements * Validate system upgrades through structured testing to ensure compatibility with live operational environments before systems return to service. * Prepare and maintain accurate service documentation, test reports, commissioning records, redlines, system updates, and client\-facing service records. * Coordinate with Engineering, Capability, Project Management, and client technical teams to support system performance and ongoing service requirements * Communicate technical information, risks, resource needs, scope gaps, and service owing level of education and experience, or equivalent combination. Additionally, the following certifications, knowledge, skills, or physical requirements are necessary for the position. * GED or High School Diploma required * 7\+ years of technical experience in field applications, mechanical system maintenance, automation installation, controls, or a related technical discipline * Demonstrated ability to independently own complex technical scopes, make sound decisions in ambiguous or high\-pressure environments, and provide guidance to less experienced engineers or integrators. * Experience troubleshooting or installing entertainment automation systems on cruise ships, in theme parks, theaters, or similar live entertainment environments is a plus. * Demonstrated experience with two or more of the following mechanical or electrical systems, controls, electromechanical systems, rigging, and hydraulics. * Strong troubleshooting and problem\-solving skills. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Ability to communicate effectively with clients, onboard teams, shoreside operations, Engineering, Project Management, and other technical stakeholders. * Ability and willingness to work scheduled and reactive maintenance periods, including shipboard maintenance windows, limited\-access periods, and other non\-standard operating hours as required by the client. * Willingness to sail with and accept accommodations onboard cruise ships during maintenance periods. * Ability and willingness to travel with short notice and for potentially extended periods, including approximately 120 days per year of domestic and international travel, depending on client and market requirements. * Must have the right to work in the United States. * Willingness to relocate to Orlando, FL. * Working Conditions and Physical Effort The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. The employee is required to frequently walk, bend, climb, push, pull, twist, squat, stoop, and kneel each day. Specific requirements are: * Must be able to stand for extended periods of time * Must be able to lift or move 70 lbs. with or without assistance. * Must be able to pull or push 140 lbs. Work conditions of the role: Work conditions may involve moderate exposure to unusual elements such as dirt, dust, fumes, unpleasant odors, and/or loud noises. Work environment involves some exposure to hazards or physical risks which require following basic safety precautions. * Must be able to wear and properly utilize appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE) to work within or visit areas where required. This includes, safety glasses, reflective vest, ear plugs, safety toed shoes, and other PPE as required by the location * Ability to work in “entertainment conditions” including a wide variety of working places such as shops, backstage, catwalks at height, construction areas, theme parks, and cruise ships. **TAIT Benefits:** * Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance plans * Health Savings Account (HSA) with employer contributions (HDHP plans) * Flexible Spending Accounts (Medical \& Dependent Care) * Employer\-paid life insurance with optional supplemental coverage * Employer\-paid Short\-term with optional long\-term disability insurance * 401(k) retirement plan with company match * Paid parental leave * Employee Assistance Program (EAP) * Wellness stipends * Voluntary benefits (e.g., accident, critical illness) * Paid vacation and 12 holidays \#LI\-NT1 TAIT is an equal opportunity employer fully committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic as outlined by international, national, state, or local laws.

jobs.title: Security
jobs.description: TEECOM hires by discipline, not by open requisition. We are growing — multiple teams across the US, UK, and India are actively hiring to grow their teams. When you apply here, you are applying to TEECOM for a role in Security (SEC). Rather than interviewing for a single posted role, you will go through a structured Discipline Assessment that establishes your level and demonstrated capability. Once your level is determined, TEECOM's recruiting and leadership teams match your profile to the best available opening on a team that fits your skills, experience, and goals. Roles span Designer II through Principal, Senior Consultant. Your level — and your title — are determined by your assessment, not by the role you apply to. If you have meaningful experience in more than one discipline, apply to your primary discipline and tell your recruiter about your secondary discipline(s) during your Introduction Call. You may be scheduled for a separate Discipline Assessment for each one. ### **Security at TEECOM** TEECOM's Security practice designs physical security systems for complex, high\-profile facilities across a wide and growing range of industries, campuses, and building types. Systems include video surveillance (IP camera systems), electronic access control, intrusion detection, security communications, visitor management, and integrated security platforms. Security designers at TEECOM produce detailed construction documents, specification sections, coordination memos and basis of design reports, and support projects through construction administration and system acceptance testing. You will coordinate closely with architects, IT, door hardware specifiers, security system manufacturers, mechanical, and electrical engineers, and with client security operations and IT teams. Work often requires understanding how security systems integrate with building networks, fire/life safety systems, elevators, power infrastructure, and IT/OT environments. At more senior levels, you will lead security system design strategies, develop or support security system standards, perform system assessments, mentor junior designers, manage client relationships, and contribute to growing TEECOM's Security practice. ### **What We're Looking For** We hire at all levels — the strongest security candidates are continuously learning, curious about how physical and digital systems evolve, and take ownership of delivering designs that hold up in complex, real\-world environments. If you don’t have everything on this list yet, that’s expected — TEECOM develops people through structured documentation, mentorship, and real project work. * Experience designing electronic and physical security systems across a range of facility types and industries * Familiarity with leading platforms (Lenel, Software House, Genetec, Milestone, Axis, Bosch, Commend, Zenitel, and similar) * Ability to produce construction documents — device layouts, device schedules, system diagrams, panel layouts and elevations, details, and Division 28 specification sections * Understanding of IP networking as it applies to security systems — VLANs, PoE, bandwidth and storage estimation * Understanding of electrified door hardware and interface to access control systems * Familiarity with NFPA 72, UL standards, and applicable physical security codes and standards * Familiarity with vehicle gates, barriers, and parking control systems. * Experience with intrusion detection, visitor management, or integrated security command centers — preferred * Degree in any four\-year engineering discipline, computer science, technology management, or a related technical field — or equivalent hands\-on experience * ASIS PSP (Physical Security Professional) or CPP (Certified Protection Professional) certification — preferred * PE license (electrical preferred) — plus * Experience with Revit for security systems documentation * Ability to manage your own work independently across multiple concurrent projects * TEECOM covers exam fees and study materials for certifications relevant to your discipline, pays a one\-time bonus when you pass, and funds all continuing education — including conference attendance. Salary is determined by your assessed level. TEECOM publishes full salary bands for every level on the TEECOM careers page — review them before your assessment so you know where you might land and what growth looks like from there. TEECOM is a fully remote consulting firm. We hire across all US states, the UK, and India. Our projects span the globe — some roles involve international travel, so share your comfort level with your recruiter. If you're ready to be assessed on your own merits and matched to the right team, apply here. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description: **JOB SUMMARY** The Urban Planner I or II position performs advanced professional and administrative work in the field of urban planning under the general supervision of the Director of Planning. The Urban Planner I or II exercises independent judgment in the interpretation and application of planning principles, zoning regulations, subdivision regulations, and related ordinances. re\-zonings, annexations, special exception applications, variances, and related development proposals for compliance with applicable Town ordinances, policies, regulations, and planning objectives. * inquiries, development concerns, and zoning\-related issues utilizing sound professional judgment, customer service skills, and conflict resolution techniques. * Communicates effectively, both orally and in writing, with professionals and non\-professionals regarding planning, zoning, and development matters. * Represents the Planning Department at interdepartmental meetings, regional committees, jobs.description: By clicking the “Apply” button, I understand that my employment application process with Takeda will commence and that the information I provide in my application will be processed in line with Takeda’s Privacy Notice and Terms of Use. I further attest that all information I submit in my employment application is true to the best of my knowledge. **Job Description** ------------------- **Title:** **Technical Product Owner, AI\-native Small Molecule Discovery** =========================================================================== **Location: Cambridge, MA** =========================== **Reports to:** Head of Research, PharmSci and Labs DD\&T **Key Partners:** Product Lead (Business Lead), AI\-native Small Molecule Discovery teams, and external partner engineering squads. **This role is 100% dedicated to Takeda R\&D's Labs of Tomorrow Program**. **About the role:** =================== As the Technical Product Owner, you will be the technical delivery counterpart to the Business Lead for Takeda's next\-generation small molecule discovery AI\-native software products. You will be day\-to\-day technical leader for Takeda's Small Molecule discovery product family, working in direct partnership with the Business Lead to convert scientific and business intent into an executable technical roadmap. This role owns the backlog, architecture direction, and delivery cadence for the development squads building AI\-native small molecule discovery capabilities, ensuring what gets built is technically robust, scalable, well\-integrated with the broader Labs of Tomorrow ecosystem, and delivered in a way that enables the scientific and business value the Business Lead is accountable for. You will combine strong technical product ownership discipline (backlog management, sprint planning, release management, stakeholder translation) with genuine chemistry fluency; enough to shape the redesign of small molecule processes into AI\-first workflows alongside the business, converse credibly with medicinal chemists, computational chemists, and structural biologists, and make sound technical trade\-offs that respect the underlying scientific method rather than working from a purely IT lens. You will operate at the product\-team leadership level, working side\-by\-side with the Business Lead as a single aligned leadership pair, providing day\-to\-day direction to engineers, data scientists, ML scientists, and technical leads, and interfacing with other Technical Product Owners across the Labs of Tomorrow portfolio to ensure architectural coherence and reuse across the suite of products. **How will you contribute****:** ================================ * Own and maintain the technical backlog and delivery roadmap for the Small Molecule discovery product family, translating the Business Lead's strategic vision and prioritized capabilities into epics, user stories, and technically sequenced releases. * Partner with the Business Lead as a single accountable pair, jointly owning outcomes: the Business Lead is accountable for scientific/business value and adoption; the Technical Product Owner is accountable for technical feasibility, delivery quality, timeline, and platform integrity. * Work with a team of Product Owners to translate re\-imagined AI\-native discovery workflows into clear technical requirements, acceptance criteria, and system designs in partnership with architects, engineers, data scientists, and ML scientists. * Support use case level Scrum Masters for sprint planning, backlog grooming, story writing, and release management for the development squad(s), ensuring the team has clear, well\-specified, de\-risked work at all times, and that individual use cases within the product family are aligned. * Make and own technical trade\-off decisions (build vs. buy, sequencing, technical debt vs. new capability, integration approach) within the intent and priorities set by the Business Lead and Labs of Tomorrow leadership. * Ensure technical solutions are grounded in real laboratory and computational chemistry workflows — validating that what is built reflects how chemists, structural biologists, and computational scientists actually work, not just how requirements were documented. * Own integration and architectural alignment with adjacent platforms (ELN/LIMS, compound registration, HTE, automated synthesis, assay data platforms, scientific data lakes/data models) in coordination with enterprise architecture and other product teams. * Manage technical risk, dependencies, and blockers across engineering, data, ML, and infrastructure workstreams, escalating and resolving with DD\&T, Computational Science, and external delivery partners as needed. * Define and track engineering KPIs (velocity, quality, technical adoption/usage telemetry, system performance, reliability) that complement the Business Lead's scientific and business value metrics, feeding a shared, integrated view of product health. * Collaborate with our external tec re product or platform end to end. * Strong grounding in Agile/Scrum delivery: backlog management, story writing and acceptance criteria, sprint planning, release management, and cross\-functional ceremonies. * Hands\-on technical background (prior coding, data engineering, or scientific computing experience) sufficient to engage credibly with software engineers, computational scientists, data scientists, and ML scientists on design and trade\-off discussions. * Working knowledge of modern software architecture, cloud platforms, data platforms, and AI/ML system design principles as applied to scientific software. * Experience translating ambiguous scientific or business requirements into clear, buildable technical specifications. * Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to partner effectively with a Business Lead/Product Lead as a joint leadership pair and to manage technical stakeholders across engineering, data science, and infrastructure teams. * Experience directing external technology/development partners, holding them accountable to technical scope, timeline, and quality. * Strong communication skills, able to translate between scientific stakeholders, business leadership, and technical delivery teams. * Ability to operate effectively in a complex, matrixed environment, influencing without direct authority. **Preferred:** * Experience with scientific software platforms such as ELN/LIMS, compound registration systems, high\-throughput experimentation (HTE) platforms, automated synthesis systems, or assay data platforms. * Exposure to cheminformatics tools, molecular data standards (e.g., SMILES, SDF, InChI), scientific data models, or AI\-ready scientific data practices. * Experience with AI/ML\-enabled discovery applications, including predictive modeling, generative chemistry, or agentic AI workflows. * Prior experience working in a laboratory automation or digital lab environment. * Relevant certifications in Agile/Scrum product ownership (e.g., CSPO, SAFe POPM). **Takeda Compensation and Benefits Summary** We understand compensation is an important factor as you consider the next step in your career. We are committed to equitable pay for all employees, and we strive to be more transparent with our pay practices. **For Location:** Boston, MA**U.S. Base Salary Range:** $177,000\.00 \- $278,080\.00 The estimated salary range reflects an anticipated range for this position. The actual base salary offered may depend on a variety of factors, including the qualifications of the individual applicant for the position, years of relevant experience, specific and unique skills, level of education attained, certifications or other professional licenses held, and the location in which the applicant lives and/or from which they will be performing the job. The actual base salary offered will be in accordance with state or local minimum wage requirements for the job location. For information about our benefits, please click here. **EEO Statement** *Takeda is proud in its commitment to creating a diverse workforce and providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, parental status, national origin, age, disability, citizenship status, genetic information or characteristics, marital status, status as a Vietnam era veteran, special disabled veteran, or other protected veteran in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws, and any other characteristic protected by law.* **Locations** ------------- Boston, MA**Worker Type** --------------- Employee**Worker Sub\-Type** -------------------- Regular**Time Type** ------------- Full time**Job Exempt** Yes It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

jobs.title: ArcGIS Developer in Brooklyn NY – Local Candidates Only
jobs.description: **Job Title:** ArcGIS Developer – Local Candidates Only (contract) **Location:** Hybrid – Brooklyn, NY **Schedule:** Monday to Friday, Tuesday through Thursday on\-site, 35 hours **\*All interviews will be on\-site** **\*Candidates must be able to interview at their own expense** **Job Summary:** Looking for a highly skilled ArcGIS Developer to design, build and maintain enterprise grade geospatial applications. **Mandatory Skills / Experience** * 5\+ years of professional experience in software development with a focus on GIS * **ArcGIS Enterprise:** Deep understanding of Portal for ArcGIS, GeoEvent Server, ArcGIS Server, and Data Store. * **Application Development:** Build and deploy interactive web mapping applications using the **ArcGIS Maps SDK** for **JavaScript** and **Java, Spring Boot** * **Python:** Advanced scripting for geoprocessing * **SQL:** Proficiency in writing complex spatial joins and queries **Desirable Skills / Experience** * **ArcGIS API for Python:** Experience using this for "DevOps for GIS"—automating user management, content audits, and cloning environments between Dev, Test, and Production. * **ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript (4\.x):** Mastery of the 4\.x series, particularly creating custom widgets and handling 3D visualizations. * **Web Frameworks:** Proficiency in **Spring Boot,** **React**, **Angular**, or **Vue.js** is highly desirable. Most modern ArcGIS web apps (built with the Maps SDK for JS) are integrated into these frameworks. Job Types: Full\-time, Contract Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * ArcGIS: 2 years (Required) * JavaScript: 2 years (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Brooklyn, NY 11201

jobs.title: Sales Enablement & RFP Specialist
jobs.description: **ABOUT THE ROLE:** As a Sales Enablement \& RFP Specialist, you will own end\-to\-end RFP responses for prospects while helping to build the enablement resources, wikis, and onboarding tools that power our global Sales Engineering team. With primary focus on the RFPs for the AMER region and providing additional support EMEA and APAC during peak volumes, you will help prospects understand the full capabilities of our Loyalty and Promotion platform. In this role, you are a deal champion who highlights our unique differentiators and clearly articulates why our solution commands enterprise\-grade investment through the RFP responses. You must be based on the US East Coast, ideally within commuting distance of one of our hubs: New York or Boston. **ABOUT THE TEAM:** You'll report to our Senior Enablement Manager and support scaling our RFP operations and Sales Engineering enablement as our business expands through both organic growth and the integration of our parent company's ecosystem. You'll be joining at a pivotal moment to help shape our content architecture, AI drafting strategies, and cross\-functional workflows. **ONCE YOU ARE HERE YOU WILL:** * Own end\-to\-end RFP, RFI, and security questionnaire responses for prospects * Transform standard RFP requirements into compelling value narratives that highlight our Loyalty and Promotion platform's unique competitive advantages, ensuring every response positions us as the high\-value strategic partner * Support RFP response across AMER, EMEA, and APAC when volume requires extra hands * Using internal tools and knowledge base with complementary AI tools like Claude, Gemini, and ChatGPT as part of your workflow and for speed and accuracy, before Sales Engineers and Account Executives layer in their depth from real prospect conversations * Build and maintain enablement resources, including our Sales Engineering wiki, internal tool documentation, and onboarding materials * Partner with Sales Engineers, Account Executives, Account Managers, Product Marketing, and Business Value Consultants to get RFP content and positioning right * Shape how we answer new RFP questions as our platform integrates with our parent company's technology **WHAT WE NEED YOU TO BRING TO THE TABLE:** * You value accuracy, speed, and a high work ethic * Bring hands\-on experience responding to RFPs, RFIs, and security questionnaires * Frame every response around value creation, highlighting Unique Selling Points (USPs), ROI, and key differentiators to justify enterprise deal sizes * Use AI tools like Claude, Gemini, or ChatGPT with a deep understanding of their capabilities and limitations * Experience digesting and understanding technical product details (APIs, integrations, data security) and translating them into clear, customer\-facing copy. * Experience managing multiple RFPs at once across different industries and stakeholders, under competing deadlines and shifting priorities **WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU:** * $1,200 annual learning budget * Manage your own time off with our flexible PTO policy * $350 home office setup budget, a $50 monthly home office allowance * Freedom to work from abroad for up to 90 days worldwide * WeWork On\-Demand access for flexible workspace solutions * Mental health support with nilo.health * Choose from top\-tier Medical, Dental, and Vision plans (Blue Cross Blue Shield MA, MetLife, VSP) * Build your savings with our 401(k) plan, including a 100% company match on your contributions up to 4% * We provide 100% company\-paid Life Insurance, Short\-Term, and Long\-Term Disability coverage **WHY YOU SHOULD WORK FOR US:** * **The right attitude:** modern methods and a diverse, creative workspace with an open and international culture * **Everyone for the product:** Together we create a flexible, highly scalable product with state\-of\-the\-art technologies. We can only succeed if everyone works as a team * **Healthy Growth:** Growing our company means growing everyone in the team. We love to share knowledge and learn * **A great environment:** Flexible and family\-friendly environment, bright and easily accessible offices, modern software and hardware * **High flexibility degree:** Prefer to work early or late at night? Do you have to pick up your children from kindergarten? Do you prefer working abroad? We believe in results and motivated employees **Do you want this job?** We'd love to hear from you! Apply directly via the form below. *Talon.One is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. We do not make employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religious belief, ethnic origin, nationality, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws or prohibited by company policy. As an employer we strive for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibit harassment of any kind.* Find out more about our Candidate Privacy Policy.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer II
jobs.description: Division Electrical Engineering Primary Work Location Brookfield, WI Job type Regular Time type Full time Job Post From 2026\-09\-29 ### **Job Details** ##### **Job Description** **Job Description:** ***Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S.; sponsorship is not available for this position at this time.*** **INNOVATE WITHOUT BOUNDARIES!** At Milwaukee Tool we firmly believe that our People and our Culture are the secrets to our success – so we give you unlimited access to everything you need to create disruptive new technologies and solutions on our electrical engineering teams. Our Engineering Team is responsible for giving life to the batteries, motors, and electronics that power solutions changing the lives of our users. Every developmental phase of these critical components happens in\-house under the watch of this team. We continue to invest in electrical engineering resources to design and develop leadership in electronic capabilities; something unique within the industry. And we’re pushing the limits in firmware engineering, power electronics, embedded systems, machine learning, and the use of artificial intelligence. Behind our doors you’ll be empowered every day to own it, drive it, and do what it takes to design and develop the biggest breakthroughs in the industry. Meanwhile, you’ll have the support and resources of the fastest\-growing brand in the construction industry to make it happen. Year after year, our team continues to make significant breakthroughs in the industry. We’re just getting started. To learn more about our story click HERE. The Electrical Engineer II will independently design, prototype, test, and troubleshoot embedded electronic systems for low\- to mid\-complexity projects. This role will collaborate with global engineering teams, product managers, test engineering, and suppliers to deliver robust, cost\-effective, and manufacturable designs. The engineer will apply platform and reuse principles, make data\-driven technical decisions, and support platform designs from concept through qualification and release. **You'll be DISRUPTIVE through these duties and responsibilities:** * Independently design, prototype, test, and troubleshoot embedded electronic hardware and supporting firmware for low\- to mid\-complexity product and platform projects. * Develop analog and digital circuits that may include microcontrollers, power supplies, sensors, communication interfaces, protection circuits, and signal\-conditioning functions. * Create and review schematics, support PCB layout, perform circuit simulations, and apply sound design practices for signal integrity, noise, reliability, cost, and manufacturability. * Develop engineering requirements, test plans, procedures, and test cases for electronic components, printed circuit board assemblies, subsystems, and complete electronics platforms. * Use laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, power supplies, electronic loads, data\-acquisition systems, power analyzers, spectrum analyzers, network analyzers, and protocol analyzers as applicable. * Conduct experiments, analyze data using appropriate statistical methods, document results, and draw concise, logical conclusions that guide design decisions. * Perform root\-cause analysis and resolve hardware, firmware\-interaction, test, and platform integration issues with urgency and disciplined problem solving. * Evaluate technical tradeoffs and recommend solutions that balance performance, user needs, schedule, cost, reliability, regulatory compliance, and reuse capability. * Collaborate with component suppliers and manufacturing partners to select components, address availability or quality concerns, and support successful platform launches. * Work with cross\-functional and global teams to incorporate platform\-based design approaches and reusable technical solutions across product categories. * Track assigned work to project schedules, surface risks early, and communicate status, decisions, and recommendations to technical teams and management. * Prepare agendas, facilitate technical reviews, document decisions and action items, and deliver clear presentations to technical and non\-technical audiences. * Provide technical guidance to junior engineers and technicians while modeling Milwaukee Tool culture and engineering best practices. * Build and maintain knowledge of Milwaukee Tool development and manufacturing processes to support efficient, high\-quality designs. * Support design qualification to applicable safety, EMC, wireless, and product standards based on the scope of the design. **What TOOLS you'll bring with you:** * Bachelor of Science degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field. * 2\+ years of experience in electrical or embedded hardware design, development, validation, or a closely related engineering role. * Working knowledge of embedded systems, analog and digital circuit design, PCBA design and manufacturing, and electronics verification and validation fundamentals. * Experience with schematic\-capture, PCB\-layout, and circuit\-simulation tools. * Ability to select components, review datasheets, perform engineering calculations, and translate system needs into component\- and circuit\-level requirements. * Experience using standard electronics laboratory equipment and applying structured troubleshooting methods. * Working knowledge of C programming for microcontrollers and jobs.title: Director, AI Systems Solutions Engineering
jobs.description: **About Tensordyne** Tensordyne is building a new class of AI inference system designed for high\-performance, power\-efficient deployment of the world's most demanding generative AI workloads. Our platform combines purpose\-built silicon, new AI math, optimized scale\-up networking, and memory architecture into a tightly integrated system purpose built for large\-scale AI inference. We work with hyperscalers, neoclouds, frontier model developers, enterprises, and infrastructure partners operating at the leading edge of AI. As Tensordyne moves from system development into silicon bring\-up, customer validation, beta deployments, and production rollout, we are building the technical customer organization that will sit directly between our engineering teams and the companies deploying the platform. We are looking for an exceptional technical leader to help build and lead that function. **The Role** Tensordyne is hiring a **Director of AI Systems Solutions Engineering** to own and grow our most important technical customer engagements. This is a senior, highly technical role for someone who understands modern AI infrastructure from model architecture through accelerator hardware, distributed inference, serving software, and datacenter deployment — and who can credibly engage with the engineers and architects building the next generation of AI platforms. You will work directly with frontier model builders, hyperscalers, neoclouds, developers, infrastructure partners, and strategic customers as they evaluate and deploy Tensordyne systems. You will also build and lead a small team of exceptional Sales and Solutions Engineers responsible for customer benchmarking, technical evaluation, NPI, model enablement, AI DC architecture, and production deployment. This is not a traditional pre\-sales engineering role. The team will operate at the frontier of a rapidly changing technology landscape, working with constantly evolving new models and requirements. The right person will be equally comfortable in a customer architecture review, helping prioritize product capabilities and roadmaps, and leading a technical evaluation with hyperscalers and frontier AI companies. **What You Will Own** * **Strategic technical customer engagements:** Own the technical relationship with key customers and partners from initial architecture discussions through benchmarking, evaluation, integration, deployment, and expansion. * **Technical evaluation strategy:** Define how Tensordyne demonstrates system performance across KPI's like throughput, tokens/sec/user, ttft, memory utilization, power efficiency, system density, model accuracy/quality, and other relevant inference metrics. * **AI workload and model architecture engagement:** Work with customers and model developers to understand current and emerging HW and model architectures, serving requirements, context lengths, parallelism strategies, model topology, quantization approaches, and inference optimization requirements. * **Benchmarking and competitive analysis:** Maintain a technically rigorous understanding of Tensordyne performance relative to leading GPU and AI accelerator platforms. Ensure customer\-facing comparisons are credible, reproducible, current, and aligned with real deployment requirements. * **Model enablement and optimization:** Partner with compiler, runtime, kernel, systems, and SDK teams to bring important customer models and workloads onto the Tensordyne platform and identify opportunities for performance improvement. * **Forward deployment:** Lead technical PoCs, remote evaluations, on\-premises beta deployments, integration programs, and production readiness efforts with strategic customers. * **Customer\-to\-product feedback loop:** Translate recurring customer requirements into clear priorities for the SDK, compiler, runtime, inference server, model support, orchestration, networking, observability, and system architecture teams. * **Technical market intelligence:** Stay deeply current on model architectures, inference techniques, accelerator roadmaps, serving frameworks, competitive systems, benchmarking methodologies, and changes in the AI infrastructure market. * **Team leadership:** Help recruit, develop, and lead a small team of elite Sales/Solutions Engineers capable of independently managing sophisticated technical engagements with the world's most demanding AI infrastructure customers. * **Scalable technical GTM:** Turn early customer engagements into repeatable benchmarks, evaluation frameworks, reference architectures, deployment playbooks, documentation, demos, and technical collateral that can support a rapidly growing customer base. **What We Are Looking For** We are looking for a proven AI systems leader with substantial technical depth and strong judgment. You should bring: * Deep understanding of modern AI inference systems, including LLM and multimodal architectures. * Strong knowledge of AI accelerator and system architecture, including compute, memory hierarchy, interconnect, parallelism, and distributed inference. * Experience reasoning about inference performance across latency, throughput, memory bandwidth, utilization, batching, context length, prefill, decode, and system scaling. * Hands\-on familiarity with modern AI frameworks and serving environments such as PyTorch, vLLM, SGLang, Triton, or comparable systems. * Experience jobs.title: Account Executive — SEO / AEO / AI Search
jobs.description: Account Executive — SEO / AEO / AI Search **Remote \| Full\-Time \| Uncapped Commission** If “SEO” is the only acronym you understand, this probably isn't your job. ChiropracticResults is looking for a salesperson who understands where search is going. You should already understand the difference between: **SEO** — ranking websites in traditional search. **AEO** — getting brands surfaced inside answer engines. **GEO** — increasing the likelihood that AI systems mention, cite, source and recommend a business. You do **not** need to be the person implementing schema, building citations or running technical audits. But you absolutely need to understand the ecosystem well enough to have an intelligent conversation with a business owner about it. Because that's what we sell. And we're not looking for someone who can sell anything to anybody. We're looking for someone who can determine which chiropractic practices deserve to own their market. What ChiropracticResults Is Building ChiropracticResults is creating a national discovery and authority platform for chiropractic. Patients aren't only searching: **“chiropractor near me”** anymore. They're asking: **“Who's the best chiropractor for migraines in Indianapolis?”** **“Who should I see for sciatica?”** **“What's the best pediatric chiropractor near me?”** And increasingly, they're asking ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI, Perplexity and other answer engines. We help great chiropractic practices become more visible inside that new discovery ecosystem. Our goal isn't to sign every chiropractor in America. We want the **right doctor in each market**. One star in every town. What You'll Be Selling Depending on the practice and program, ChiropracticResults can include: * Optimized ChiropracticResults profiles * AI visibility monitoring * SEO, AEO and GEO strategy * Third\-party citations and authority * Verified patient outcomes * Condition\-specific authority * “Best Chiropractor” editorial content * AI mentions and sourcing * Reputation and social proof * Voice and answer\-engine discovery * Local search visibility * Competitive visibility tracking * Advertising * Results Assurance campaigns But don't think of this as selling a checklist of marketing services. You're selling **market position**. We want our clients to become the obvious answer when someone — human or AI — asks: **“Who should I go to?”** You Need To Understand This World We're not hiring someone who needs SEO explained during onboarding. You should already have a working understanding of concepts like: * Organic search * Local SEO * Google Business Profiles * Backlinks and citations * Domain and topical authority * Search intent * Branded vs. non\-branded search * Local Pack visibility * Reviews and third\-party validation * Structured data/schema * AI Overviews * Generative search * LLM citations * AI mentions * Entity authority * Answer\-engine optimization * Generative\-engine optimization * Zero\-click and clickless search You don't need to be an SEO engineer. You **do** need to understand these concepts well enough to explain them to a doctor without hiding behind jargon. Your Job You'll talk with chiropractic practice owners who have expressed interest in ChiropracticResults or who we've identified as potential fits. You'll: * Conduct discovery and sales calls with practice owners * Understand their current SEO and digital marketing strategy * Evaluate their competitive market * Identify gaps in their AI/search visibility * Explain SEO, AEO and GEO opportunities simply * Show practices where they're being outranked, out\-mentioned or ignored * Present the appropriate ChiropracticResults program * Follow up relentlessly but intelligently * Maintain an organized sales pipeline * Close qualified practices * Build long\-term relationships inside chiropractic * Protect geographic markets from poor\-fit clients And yes: Sometimes your job is to tell someone **we're not taking them**. You'll Probably Be Great At This If... You've sold SEO, digital marketing, SaaS, advertising or another consultative B2B service. You're curious. You understand digital marketing beyond Facebook leads. You actually pay attention to what Google and AI are doing. You've played with ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or other AI tools enough to understand how dramatically discovery is changing. You can talk strategy with a business owner. You ask great questions. You're competitive. You follow up. You don't need someone reminding you to make calls. You can hear “no” without melting down. And when you know something will genuinely help a business, you're comfortable asking them to buy it. Experience We'd Love Previous sales experience is strongly preferred. Experience selling any of the following is especially valuable: * SEO services * Local SEO * Digital marketing * AEO / GEO / AI search services * Marketing agency services * SaaS * Reputation management * Digital advertising * Healthcare marketing * Chiropractic products or services If you've previously worked at an SEO, website or digital marketing agency and understand how those services are sold, we especially want to talk to you. This Is NOT For You If... You think SEO means “putting keywords on a website.” You've never heard of AEO or GEO and have no interest in learning. Your entire understanding of digital marketing is Facebook lead ads. You need a manager chasing you around all day. You hate follow\-up. You think sending three emails counts as a sales process. You blame leads every time you miss quota. You need every prospect to like you. You'd rather discount something than explain why it's valuable. Or you're looking for a comfortable sales job where doing the minimum keeps you employed. That's not this. How We Think About Sales We care about revenue. We care about closing. But we also care deeply about **who we let onto the platform**. A bad client isn't a win just because their credit card went through. We're increasingly treating our markets almost like real estate. There are desirable markets. There are limited opportunities. There are applications. There are standards. And we want great practices occupying those markets. Your responsibility is both to **sell the opportunity and protect the property.** Uncapped earning potential for high performers. This role is designed for someone who wants their income tied directly to their ability to create revenue. About ChiropracticResults ChiropracticResults is building a new kind of chiropractic discovery platform centered around real doctors, verified patient outcomes, local authority and visibility across both traditional and AI\-powered search. We're a small company. We move fast. There's very little corporate bullshit. Good ideas can become real things quickly. And great performance gets noticed. How To Apply Don't send us a five\-paragraph cover letter written by ChatGPT. Send your résumé and answer these: **1\. In your own words, what's the difference between SEO, AEO and GEO?** **2\. A chiropractor says: “My website company already does SEO and AI.” What would you ask them next?** **3\. What do you think happens to traditional Google search over the next three years?** **4\. What's the most expensive thing you've ever sold?** **5\. Tell us about a sale you lost that you probably should have won. What happened?** **6\. A prospect says, “I need to think about it.” What's your next question?** **7\. What's something you've gotten unusually good at because you became obsessed with it?** We're looking for the person behind the résumé. Show us who that is. Pay: $120,000\.00 \- $250,000\.00 per year Benefits: * Flexible schedule * Paid time off People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply Work Location: Hybrid remote in Zionsville, IN 46077

Must possess; ability to collaborate with department heads, administrators, board members, physicians, managers, nurses, and employees. Must exhibit strong organizational and time management skills in daily activity. Ability to read financial reports and facilitate cost management process. Strong communication skills, use of diplomacy and clarity in all communications. Must possess high ethical standards with respect to discretion and regard for confidentiality, the ability to prioritize, plan, direct and allocate time to perform several departmental activities collectively and respond efficiently and effectively. The ability to accurately forecast cost and schedules for completion of tasks. Abiding commitment to basic ethical and legal principles. Strong project management skills. **Essential Functions:** 1\. Responsible for integrating the mission, vision, values of Guthrie into the facility planning process throughout Guthrie Lourdes Hospital and its associated properties. 2\. Manage day to day operations of maintenance, engineering, construction, safety, waste and emergency management. 3\. Responsible for developing and directing a comprehensive, consistent Facility management program for all locations within the Guthrie Lourdes Hospital and properties. a. Review and approve architectural and engineering standards for design of projects. b. Coordination and control of preliminary budgeting, planning, estimating, bidding, negotiating, implementation and management of construction, renovation, and site development projects. c. Possess working knowledge and keeps current on all applicable codes and regulations including but not limited to; ADA, IBC, Life Safety, NFPA AIA, all relevant building codes, EPA, FJC, OSHA, CDC, CMS. 4\. Assures adherence with all regulatory compliance initiatives including but not limited to; NY DOH, NYS DOS, The Joint Commission, OSHA and HIPPA. Provides leadership for the Environment of Care and Life Safety Chapters. 5\. Assure that testing and inspections are completed and documented (e.g., monthly generator test, fire protections system test). 6\. Ensure that healthcare facility and facility staff permits, licenses, and certificates are maintained, recorded, and current (e.g., boilers, elevators, and heliport). 7\. Possess and understanding of the operation and maintenance of; a. HVAC and refrigeration systems and equipment b. steam and hot water generation systems c. medical gas and vacuum systems d. electrical distribution systems e. emergency power supply systems f. fire protection systems g. water and sanitary systems h. safety and security systems i. medical equipment j. building envelope systems (e.g., roof, windows, exterior walls) 9\. Supervises General Maintenance/Boiler Operator staff, including daily assignment and scheduling of their work. 10\. Possess working knowledge and keeps current of all applicable codes and regulations including but not limited to; ADA, BOCA, IBC, PA Life Safety, NFPA, and JCAHO. **Other Duties:** 1\.
